war: Sinmulod hira ha Jerusalem ngan sinmaka han kwarto nga inuokyan nira Pedro, Juan, Santiago, Andres, Felipe, Tomas, Bartolome, Mateo, Santiago nga anak ni Alfeo, Simon nga bayani, ug Judas nga anak ni Santiago.

en: And in these days Peter stood up in the midst of the brethren, and said (and there was a multitude of persons gathered together, about a hundred and twenty),
war: Agsob hira magkatitirok hin pag-ampo kaupod an kababayen-an, pati hi Maria nga iroy ni Jesus, ngan an iya kabugtoan nga kalalaken-an.

en: Brethren, it was needful that the scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spake before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to them that took Jesus.
war: Paglabay hin pira ka adlaw, nagkaurosa an mga magtinuohon nga may mga syento baynte ngatanan. Tinmindog hi Pedro ngan nagyakan,

en: For he was numbered among us, and received his portion in this ministry.
war: “Mga kabugtoan ko, kinahanglan matuman an Kasuratan diin an Espiritu Santo nga nagyakan pinaagi kan David, nagtagna mahitungod kan Judas nga amo an naggiya han mga nagdakop kan Jesus.

en: (Now this man obtained a field with the reward of his iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
war: Kaapi ini hi Judas han amon hugpo, kay ginpili hiya nga kabahin han amon buruhaton.”

en: And it became known to all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch that in their language that field was called Akeldama, that is, The field of blood.)
For it is written in the book of Psalms,
war: Nakapalit hi Judas pinaagi han kwarta nga kinarawat niya tungod han maraot niya nga buhat, hin uma diin nahulog hiya nga tuwad ngan namatay; naburit an iya tiyan ngan nahigawas an iya mga tinae.

en: Let his habitation be made desolate,
war: Nakabati hiunong hini an ngatanan nga mga umurukoy ha Jerusalem, sanglit ginngaranan nira adto nga uma ha ira kalugaringon nga pinulongan, Akeldama nga an kahulogan, “Uma hin Dugo.”)

en: And let no man dwell therein:
war: “Kay iginsurat ha basahan han mga Salmo,

en: and,
war: ‘Magin binayaan unta an iya urokyan,

en: His office let another take.
war: waray unta mag-ukoy dida hini.’

en: Of the men therefore that have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and went out among us,
war: Ngan iginsurat liwat,

en: beginning from the baptism of John, unto the day that he was received up from us, of these must one become a witness with us of his resurrection.
war: ‘May-ada unta lumiwan han iya katungdanan.’

en: And they put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
war: 21-22 “Sanglit kinahanglan tumampo ha amon in usa ka tawo nga saksi han pagkabanhaw han Ginoo nga Jesus. Kinahanglan usa hiya han amon hugpo sulod han bug-os nga panahon nga kaupod pa namon an Ginoo nga Jesus, tikang han pagbunyagi ha iya ni Juan ngada han pagbayawa ha iya ngadto ha langit.”

en: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, who knowest the hearts of all men, show of these two the one whom thou hast chosen,
war: Sanglit igintuboy nira in duha nga lalake: hi Jose nga an ngaran Barsabas (gintawag liwat nga Justo), ngan hi Matias.

en: And when the day of Pentecost was now come, they were all together in one place.
war: Han pag-abot na han adlaw han Pentecostes, nagkatitirok an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon ha usa nga dapit.

en: And suddenly there came from heaven a sound as of the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
war: Tigda la nga nagdaguhob tikang ha langit in sugad hin makusog nga alipuros ngan nakapuno ini han bug-os nga balay diin hira nagkakalingkod.

en: And there appeared unto them tongues parting asunder, like as of fire; and it sat upon each one of them.
war: Ngan nakakita hira hin sugad hin mga dila nga kalayo nga hinmugdon ha kada usa ha ira.

en: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
war: Napuno hira ngatanan han Espiritu Santo, ngan nagtikang hira pagyakan hin iba nga mga yinaknan, sumala han iginpayakan ha ira han Espiritu.

en: Now there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under heaven.
war: Nag-uokoy didto ha Jerusalem in mga Judiyo nga mag-inampoon, mga tawo nga tikang ha magkalainlain nga mga nasod han kalibutan.

en: And when this sound was heard, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speaking in his own language.
war: Han pakabati nira hini nga aringasa, nagtitirok in kadam-an nga mga tawo. Nahipausa hira ngatanan, kay nakabati an tagsa ha ira nga nagyayakan an mga magtinuohon han tagsatagsa nga yinaknan han mga namamati.

en: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying, Behold, are not all these that speak Galilæans?
war: Nagsiring hira ha dako nga paghipausa, “Diri ba mga taga-Galilea ini ngatanan nga nagyayakan?

en: And how hear we, every man in our own language wherein we were born?
war: Naunan-o man nga nakabati kita ngatanan ha ira nga nagyayakan han aton tagsa nga kalugaringon nga yinaknan?

en: Parthians and Medes and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, in Judæa and Cappadocia, in Pontus and Asia,
war: Dinhe ha aton may mga taga-Partia, taga-Media, taga-Elam, mga umurukoy ha Mesopotamia, ha Judea, ha Capadocia, ha Ponto, ngan ha Asia,

en: in Phrygia and Pamphylia, in Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and sojourners from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
war: ha Frigia, ha Pamfilya, ha Ehipto, ngan ha mga dapit han Libya hirani ha Cirene; mga taga-Roma an iba ha aton,

en: Cretans and Arabians, we hear them speaking in our tongues the mighty works of God.
war: mga Judiyo ngan mga Hentil nga nakabig ha tuluohan han mga Judiyo; mga taga-Creta ngan mga taga-Arabia an pipira ha aton—kundi nakabati kita ngatanan ha ira nga nagyayakan han aton kalugaringon nga mga yinaknan mahitungod han orosahon nga mga butang nga ginbuhat han Dyos!”

en: And they were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
war: Ha ira paghipausa ngan kagupong, naggiparopakiana hira, “Ano ba an karuyag sidngon hini?”

en: But others mocking said, They are filled with new wine.
war: Kundi an mga magtinuohon gin-intrimisan han iba ha ira ngan nagsiring, “Mga hubog ini nga mga tawo!”

en: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spake forth unto them, saying , Ye men of Judæa, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and give ear unto my words.
war: Niyan tinmindog hi Pedro upod an onse nga mga apostoles ngan nagyakan ha ira ha dako nga tingog, “Mga igkasi ko Judiyo, ngan kamo ngatanan nga nag-uokoy ha Jerusalem, pamatii ako niyo ngan tugoti ako hin pagsumat ha iyo kon ano an karuyag sidngon hini.

en: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose; seeing it is but the third hour of the day;
war: Diri hubog ini nga mga tawo sugad han iyo paghunahuna, kay alas nuybe pa la ha aga yana.

en: but this is that which hath been spoken through the prophet Joel:
war: Kundi amo ini an iginsiring han manaragna nga hi Joel:

en: And it shall be in the last days, saith God,
war: ‘Amo ini an akon pagbubuhaton

en: I will pour forth of my Spirit upon all flesh:
war: ha kataposan nga mga adlaw, nasiring an Dyos:

en: And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy,
war: Ibububo ko an akon Espiritu ha ngatanan nga mga tawo.

en: And your young men shall see visions,
war: Mananagna an iyo mga anak nga kalalaken-an

en: And your old men shall dream dreams:
war: ngan mga anak nga kababayen-an;

en: Yea and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days
war: makakakita hin mga panan-awon an iyo batan-on nga kalalaken-an,

en: Will I pour forth of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy.
war: ngan mag-iinop an iyo lagas nga kalalaken-an.

en: And I will show wonders in the heaven above,
war: Tinuod, bisan ha akon mga oripon

en: And signs on the earth beneath;
war: nga kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an

en: Blood, and fire, and vapor of smoke:
war: ibububo ko an akon Espiritu hadto nga mga adlaw ngan ipapasangyaw nira an akon mensahe.

en: The sun shall be turned into darkness,
war: Magbubuhat ako hin mga milagro ha langit,

en: And the moon into blood,
war: ngan mga urosahon dinhe ha tuna.

en: Before the day of the Lord come,
war: Makakamay-ada dugo, kalayo, ngan madakmol nga aso;

en: That great and notable day :
war: magsisirom an adlaw,

en: And it shall be, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
war: ngan magpupula an bulan sugad hin dugo,

en: Ye men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God unto you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him in the midst of you, even as ye yourselves know;
war: nga diri pa maabot an makaaramdok

en: him, being delivered up by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye by the hand of lawless men did crucify and slay:
war: ngan mahimayaon nga Adlaw han Ginoo.

en: whom God raised up, having loosed the pangs of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
war: Ngan onina matatalwas

en: For David saith concerning him,
war: an bisan hin-o nga magsangpit han Ginoo hin pakibulig.’

en: I beheld the Lord always before my face;
war: “Mga igkasi ko taga-Israel, pamatii niyo ini nga mga pulong! Usa nga tawo hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret, kanay dyosnon nga gahom iginpadayag ha iyo pinaagi han ngatanan nga mga milagro ngan mga urosahon nga ginbuhat han Dyos pinaagi ha iya. Maaram kamo ngahaw hini, kay nahinabo ini dinhe ha iyo.

en: For he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
war: Ginbuot han Dyos ha iya kalugaringon nga paglarang nga igtubyan hi Jesus ngada ha iyo; ngan ginpatay hiya niyo pinaagi hin pagtugoti niyo han mga makasasala nga igraysang hiya ha kros.

en: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced;
war: Kundi ginbanhaw hiya han Dyos ngan iginawas hiya tikang han gahom han kamatayon, kay diri gud mahihimo nga magarongan hiya han kamatayon.

en: Moreover my flesh also shall dwell in hope:
war: Kay nagsiring hi David mahitungod ha iya:

en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul unto Hades,
war: ‘Dayuday hinkit-an ko an Ginoo

en: Neither wilt thou give thy Holy One to see corruption.
war: ha akon atubangan;

en: Thou madest known unto me the ways of life;
war: haraniay hiya ha akon ngan diri ako pagsasamokon.

en: Thou shalt make me full of gladness with thy countenance.
war: Sanglit malipayon gud ako,

en: Brethren, I may say unto you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us unto this day.
war: ngan tugob hin pagrayhak an akon mga pulong;

en: Being therefore a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins he would set one upon his throne;
war: ngan ako, bisan kon may pagkamatay,

en: he foreseeing this spake of the resurrection of the Christ, that neither was he left unto Hades, nor did his flesh see corruption.
war: makakapahuway nga puno hin paglaom,

en: This Jesus did God raise up, whereof we all are witnesses.
war: kay diri mo ako babayaan didto han tuna han mga patay;

en: Being therefore by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he hath poured forth this, which ye see and hear.
war: diri ka matugot nga madunot ha lubnganan an imo matinumanon nga surugoon.

en: For David ascended not into the heavens: but he saith himself,
war: Iginpakita mo ha akon an mga agianan tipakadto ha kinabuhi;

en: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
war: ngan magpupuno ha akon hin kalipay an imo pakig-usa ha akon.’

en: Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
war: “Kabugtoan: kinahanglan magyakan ako ha iyo hin dayag mahitungod han aton bantogan nga ginikanan, hi Hadi David. Namatay hiya ngan iginlubong, ngan hahani pa ha aton an iya lubnganan ngada yana nga adlaw.

en: Let all the house of Israel therefore know assuredly, that God hath made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom ye crucified.
war: Manaragna hiya ngan maaram hiya han iginsaad han Dyos ha iya: nagsumpa an Dyos nga hihimoon niya nga hadi in usa han mga tulin ni David, sugad nga hadi hi David.

en: Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and the rest of the apostles, Brethren, what shall we do?
war: Hinbaroan nga daan ni David an pagbubuhaton han Dyos, sanglit naghimangraw hiya mahitungod han pagkabanhaw han Mesiyas ha iya pagsiring:

en: And Peter said unto them, Repent ye, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ unto the remission of your sins; and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
war: ‘Waray hiya pagpabay-i didto ha tuna han mga patay,

en: For to you is the promise, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call unto him.
war: waray madunot an iya lawas didto ha lubnganan.’

en: And with many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, Save yourselves from this crooked generation.
war: Ginbanhaw han Dyos ini ngahaw nga Jesus, ngan mga saksi kami hini ngatanan.

en: They then that received his word were baptized: and there were added unto them in that day about three thousand souls.
war: Igin-undong hiya ngadto ha tuo han Dyos ngan kinmarawat han Espiritu Santo tikang ha iya sumala han iginsaad niya; ngan ini nga iyo hinkikit-an ngan hinbabatian yana, amo ini an iya hatag nga ginbubo niya ha amon.

en: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread and the prayers.
war: Kay diri hi David amo an sinmaka ha langit, lugod nagsiring hiya,

en: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
war: ‘Nagsiring an Ginoo ngadto han akon Ginoo:

en: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
war: Lingkod didi ha akon tuo,

en: Now Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour .
war: Usa ka adlaw kinmadto ha Templo hira Pedro ug Juan alas tres ha kulop, an takna han pag-ampo.

en: And a certain man that was lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
war: May didto usa ka tawo nga lulid tikang han iya katawo nga nakada han ginngangaranan nga “Matahom nga Aragian.” Gindadara hiya kada adlaw ngada hini nga aragian basi makilimos han mga tawo nga napakadto ha Templo.

en: who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, asked to receive an alms.
war: Han pakakita niya kanda Pedro ug Juan nga nasulod, nakilimos hiya ha ira.

en: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him, with John, said, Look on us.
war: Tinutokan hiya nira ngan nagsiring hi Pedro, “Siplat ha amon!”

en: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something from them.
war: Sanglit sinmiplat hiya ha ira nga naglalaom nga lilimosan hiya.

en: But Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but what I have, that give I thee. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Pedro ha iya, “Waray gud ako kwarta, kundi ihahatag ko ha imo an aadi ha akon: ha ngaran ni Jesu-Cristo nga taga-Nazaret, ginsusugo ko ikaw, buhat ngan lakat!”

en: And he took him by the right hand, and raised him up: and immediately his feet and his ankle-bones received strength.
war: Ngan kinaptan ni Pedro an tuo nga kamot han lulid ngan binuligan niya hin pagtukdaw. Nagmakusog dayon an mga tiil ngan mga mukobuko han lulid;

en: And leaping up, he stood, and began to walk; and he entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
war: linmukso hiya, tinmindog, ngan nagtikang hin paglakat. Niyan inmupod hiya ha ira ngadto ha Templo nga naglalakat ngan nagluluksolukso ngan nagdadayaw han Dyos.

en: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
war: An ngatanan nakakita ha iya nga naglalakat ngan nagdadayaw han Dyos;

en: and they took knowledge of him, that it was he that sat for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
war: ngan han pakakilala nira nga amo ini hiya an makililimos nga paralingkod didto han “Matahom nga Aragian” han Templo, nahipausa gud hira ngatanan han nahinabo ha iya.

en: And as he held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
war: Samtang nagunit pa an lulid kanda Pedro ug Juan, nahipausa an ngatanan nga mga tawo, ngan ini hira nagdadlagan ngadto ha ira didto han ginngangaranan nga “Balkon ni Solomon.”

en: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this man? or why fasten ye your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him to walk?
war: Han pakakita ni Pedro han mga tawo, nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Mga taga-Israel, kay ano nga nahipausa man kamo hini, ngan gintututokan man kami niyo? Hunahuna ba niyo nga nakapalakat kami hini nga tawo tungod han amon kalugaringon nga gahom o pagkadyosnon?

en: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Servant Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied before the face of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
war: An Dyos ni Abraham, ni Isaac, ngan ni Jacob, an Dyos han aton kaapoy-apoyan amo an naghatag han dyosnon nga kadungganan ha iya surugoon nga hi Jesus. Kundi igintubyan hiya niyo ngadto han mga punoan, ngan ginsalikway hiya niyo ha atubangan ni Pilato, bisan kon human na hi Pilato paglarang nga kabuhian hiya.

en: But ye denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted unto you,
war: Baraan ngan matadong hiya, kundi ginsalikway hiya niyo, ngan iyo lugod pinangaro kan Pilato nga buhian niya an usa nga kriminal.

en: and killed the Prince of life; whom God raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
war: Ginpatay niyo an Burabod han Kinabuhi, kundi ginbanhaw hiya han Dyos, ngan mga saksi kami hini.

en: And by faith in his name hath his name made this man strong, whom ye behold and know: yea, the faith which is through him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
war: An gahom han iya ngaran amo an nakaupay hini nga tawo. Ini nga iyo hinkit-an ngan hinbaroan nahimo pinaagi han pagtoo ha iya ngaran. An pagtoo kan Jesus amo an nakaupay ha iya sugad han iyo hinkit-an.

en: And now, brethren, I know that in ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
war: “Ngan yana, kabugtoan ko, maaram ako nga nahimo niyo ngan han iyo mga pangulo an iyo ginbuhat kan Jesus, tungod han iyo katapang.

en: But the things which God foreshowed by the mouth of all the prophets, that his Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
war: Daan na ginpahibaro han Dyos hadto pa nga panahon pinaagi han ngatanan nga mga manaragna, nga kinahanglan mag-antos an iya Mesiyas, ngan natuman ini ha sugad nga paagi.

en: Repent ye therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, that so there may come seasons of refreshing from the presence of the Lord;
war: Sanglit pagbasol kamo ngan balik kamo ngadto ha Dyos, basi pasayloon niya an iyo mga sala.

en: and that he may send the Christ who hath been appointed for you, even Jesus:
war: Kon buhaton niyo ini, maabot ha iyo an panahon han espirituhanon nga kusog tikang han Ginoo, ngan ipapadara niya hi Jesus nga amo an Mesiyas nga iya na ginpili para ha iyo.

en: whom the heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, whereof God spake by the mouth of his holy prophets that have been from of old.
war: Kinahanglan magpabilin hiya ha langit ngada han pag-abot han panahon hin pagbag-o han ngatanan nga mga butang, sugad han iginpasabot han Dyos hadton una pa nga mga panahon pinaagi han iya baraan nga mga manaragna.

en: Moses indeed said, A prophet shall the Lord God raise up unto you from among your brethren, like unto me; to him shall ye hearken in all things whatsoever he shall speak unto you.
war: Kay nagsiring hi Moises, ‘Magpapadara ha iyo an Ginoo nga iyo Dyos hin manaragna nga tikang ha iyo kalugaringon nga katulinan, sugad han iya pagpadara ha akon. Kinahanglan pamatian niyo an ngatanan nga iya igsusumat ha iyo.

en: And it shall be, that every soul that shall not hearken to that prophet, shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.
war: An diri magtuman han igyayakan hadto nga manaragna, igbubulag hira tikang han katawhan han Dyos ngan pupuohon hira.’

en: Yea and all the prophets from Samuel and them that followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.
war: Nagpasabot liwat mahitungod hini yana nga mga adlaw an mga manaragna nga may-ada mensahe, pati hi Samuel ngan an ngatanan nga sinmunod ha iya.

en: Ye are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with your fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
war: An mga saad han Dyos pinaagi han iya mga manaragna iginpahinungod ha iyo, ngan nakaangbit kamo han ginsabotan nga ginhimo han Dyos ngan han iyo mga kaapoy-apoyan. Sumala han iginsiring niya kan Abraham, ‘Tatagan ko hin kaupayan an ngatanan nga katawhan han tuna pinaagi han imo mga tulin.’

en: Unto you first God, having raised up his Servant, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your iniquities.
war: Sanglit ginpili han Dyos an iya surugoon ngan gin-una hin pagpadara ngada ha iyo, hin pagpakaupay ha iyo pinaagi hin pagpabaya ha iyo han iyo magraot nga mga ginawian.”

en: And as they spake unto the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them,
war: Han nagyayakan pa ha mga tawo hira Pedro ug Juan, nagkaabot in kapadian, an pangulo han mga gwardya han Templo, ug in mga Sadusiyo.

en: being sore troubled because they taught the people, and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
war: Napungot hira kay an duha nga mga apostoles nagtinutdo han mga tawo nga nabanhaw hi Jesus, ngan nagpamatuod ini nga may pagkabanhaw an mga patay.

en: And they laid hands on them, and put them in ward unto the morrow: for it was now eventide.
war: Sanglit gindakop hira ngan ginpriso ngada han pagkasunod nga adlaw kay tikagab-i na adto.

en: But many of them that heard the word believed; and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
war: Kundi tinmuo in damo han nagpakabati han mensahe, ngan inmabot na hin mga 5,000 an mga tawo.

en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers and elders and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem;
war: Han pagkabuwas nagkatirok didto ha Jerusalem an mga pangulo nga Judiyo, an katigurangan, ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod.

en: and Annas the high priest was there , and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest.
war: Nakigkita hira han Labaw nga Padi nga hi Anas, ngan kan Caifas, kan Juan, kan Alejandro, ngan han iba pa nga mga sakop han panimalay han Labaw nga Padi.

en: And when they had set them in the midst, they inquired, By what power, or in what name, have ye done this?
war: Ginpaatubang ha ira an mga apostoles ngan ginpakianhan nira, “Gin-unan-o niyo hin pagbuhat hini? Ano an iyo gahom, ngan kanay ngaran an iyo ginamit?”

en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders,
war: Binmaton hi Pedro nga puno han Espiritu Santo, “Mga pangulo han mga tawo ngan mga katigurangan:

en: if we this day are examined concerning a good deed done to an impotent man, by what means this man is made whole;
war: kon ginpapakianhan kami yana mahitungod han maupay nga amon ginbuhat hini nga lulid, ngan kon naunan-o nga naupay na hiya,

en: be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even in him doth this man stand here before you whole.
war: kinahanglan masayod kamo ngatanan ngan an ngatanan nga mga tawo ha Israel, nga ini nga tawo nga natindog ha iyo atubangan naupay na pinaagi han gahom han ngaran ni Jesu-Cristo nga taga-Nazaret, nga iyo iginraysang ha kros, kundi ginbanhaw han Dyos.

en: He is the stone which was set at nought of you the builders, which was made the head of the corner.
war: Amo ini hi Jesus an hinnanabihan han Kasuratan nga nasiring:

en: And in none other is there salvation: for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, wherein we must be saved.
war: ‘An bato nga gintamay niyo nga mga magtirindog hin balay,

en: Now when they beheld the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
war: nahimo lugod nga labi ka importante nga bato.’

en: And seeing the man that was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
war: Hiaagian an katalwasan pinaagi gud la ha iya. Kay ha bug-os nga kalibutan waray lain nga ngaran nga iginhatag han Dyos ha mga tawo, nga sadang makatalwas ha aton.”

en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
war: Nahipausa an mga sakop han Labaw nga Hukmanan han kaisog nga ginpakita nira Pedro ug Juan, ngan han ira kasayod nga ordinaryo la ini nga mga tawo nga waray mga hibaro. Nasabtan nira nga mga kaupod-upod ngay-an hira ni Jesus.

en: saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been wrought through them, is manifest to all that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
war: Kundi waray gud nira sadang igriwa kay nakita hira han tawo nga naupay na nga natindog upod nira Pedro ug Juan.

en: But that it spread no further among the people, let us threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
war: Sanglit ginpagawas hira han ruwang han Labaw nga Hukmanan ngan naghirohimangraw hin hira la,

en: And they called them, and charged them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
war: ngan naggiparopakiana, “Aanhon man naton ini nga mga tawo? Maaram an ngatanan nga mga umurokoy ha Jerusalem nga ini nga talagsaon nga milagro ginbuhat nira ngan diri kita makakalirong hini.

en: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it is right in the sight of God to hearken unto you rather than unto God, judge ye:
war: Kundi basi diri mahisamwak ini nga butang ngadto han mga tawo, pagdidid-an ta ini hira hin paghimangraw bisan kan kanay han ngaran ni Jesus.”

en: for we cannot but speak the things which we saw and heard.
war: Sanglit iginpatawag liwat nira an duha nga mga apostoles ngan gintugon nga diri na gud hira magyakan o magtutdo han ngaran ni Jesus.

en: And they, when they had further threatened them, let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people; for all men glorified God for that which was done.
war: Kundi binmaton hira Pedro ug Juan, “Kamo ngahaw an paghukom kon hain an matadong ha atubangan han Dyos: pagsugot ba ha iyo o pagsugot ba han Dyos?

en: For the man was more than forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was wrought.
war: Kay diri kami kapupugngan hin pagyakan han amon hinkit-an ngan hinbatian.”

en: And being let go, they came to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said unto them.
war: Tungod hini gindid-an hira hin mahigpit han Labaw nga Hukmanan, ngan katapos, ginbuhian hira. Nakasabot hira nga waray gud nira mahihimo hin pagkastigo ha ira, kay nagdadayaw han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga tawo tungod han nahinabo.

en: And they, when they heard it, lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, O Lord, thou that didst make the heaven and the earth and the sea, and all that in them is:
war: Sobra na hin 40 ka tuig an edad han tawo nga ginbuhatan hini nga milagro hin pagtambal.

en: who by the Holy Spirit, by the mouth of our father David thy servant, didst say,
war: Han pagbuhii na ha ira, binmalik hira Pedro ug Juan ngadto han ira hugpo ngan ginsumatan nira ini hira mahitungod han iginsiring han labaw nga kapadian ngan han katigurangan.

en: Why did the Gentiles rage,
war: Han pakabati nira hini, nag-urosa hira hin pag-ampo sa Dyos: “Agaron ngan Magburuhat han langit, han tuna, han dagat, ngan han ngatanan nga aada ha ira!

en: And the peoples imagine vain things?
war: Nagyakan ka pinaagi han Espiritu Santo, pinaagi kan David nga amon ginikanan, nga imo surugoon, han iya pagsiring,

en: The kings of the earth set themselves in array,
war: ‘Kay ano nga napungot an mga Hentil,

en: And the rulers were gathered together,
war: kay ano nga naghunahuna an mga tawo hin mga butang nga waray kapulsanan?

en: Against the Lord, and against his Anointed:
war: Nag-andam an kahadian han tuna,

en: for of a truth in this city against thy holy Servant Jesus, whom thou didst anoint, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel, were gathered together,
war: ngan nagkatirok an mga punoan

en: to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel foreordained to come to pass.
war: kontra han Ginoo ngan han iya Mesiyas.’

en: And now, Lord, look upon their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants to speak thy word with all boldness,
war: Kay ha tinuod nagkatirok dinhe hini nga syudad hira Herodes ug Poncio Pilato kaupod han mga Hentil ngan han mga tawo han Israel kontra kan Jesus, an imo baraan nga Surugoon nga imo ginhimo nga Mesiyas.

en: while thou stretchest forth thy hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of thy holy Servant Jesus.
war: Nagkaurosa hira hin pagbuhat han bisan ano, nga pinaagi han imo gahom ug pagbuot, imo na nga daan ginlarang nga mahinanabo.

en: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken wherein they were gathered together; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
war: Ngan yana, Ginoo, kitaa an ira mga pagtarhog nga ira ginhimo, ngan ihatag ha amon nga imo mga surugoon an kamaisog hin pagpasangyaw han imo mensahe.

en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and soul: and not one of them said that aught of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
war: Ipadapat an imo mga kamot hin panambal, ngan itugot nga buhaton unta an mga urosahon ngan mga milagro pinaagi han ngaran han imo baraan nga Surugoon nga hi Jesus.”

en: And with great power gave the apostles their witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
war: Kahuman nira pag-ampo, nabay-og an dapit nga ira ginkatirokan. Napuno hira ngatanan han Espiritu Santo ngan nagtikang hira hin pagwali nga madasigon han mensahe han Dyos.

en: For neither was there among them any that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
war: An hugpo han mga magtinuohon usa la ha hunahuna ug kasingkasing. Waray usa ha ira nga nasiring nga tag-iya hiya han iya mga butang, kundi nag-angbitay hira han ngatanan nga mga butang nga ira naaangkon.

en: and laid them at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto each, according as any one had need.
war: Upod in dako nga gahom nagsaksi an mga apostoles han pagkabanhaw han Ginoo nga hi Jesus, ngan ginpakaupay gud han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon.

en: And Joseph, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of exhortation), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
war: Waray usa dida han ira hugpo in nagkikinahanglan. Adton may mga uma o mga balay, iginbabaligya ini, gindadara an kwarta nga palit hini,

en: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
war: Kundi may usa ka tawo nga ginngaranan nga Ananias kanay asawa ginngaranan nga Safira. Nagbaligya hiya hin iya hiagi,

en: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
war: kundi gin-ibanan niya an kwarta nga palit hini para ha iya kalugaringon, ngan inuyonan ini han iya asawa. An salin ginhatag niya ngadto han mga apostoles.

en: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thy heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro ha iya, “Ananias, kay ano nga tinmugot ka nga madaog ka ni Satanas ngan magbuwa ka han Espiritu Santo pinaagi hin pag-iban han kwarta nga palit han hiagi?

en: While it remained, did it not remain thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thy power? How is it that thou hast conceived this thing in thy heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
war: San-o mo igbaligya an hiagi, ikaw an tag-iya hadto, ngan kahuman mo igbaligya, imo gihapon an kwarta. Sanglit kay ano man nga nakahunahuna ka hin pagbuhat hin sugad? Diri mga tawo an imo ginbuwaan kundi an Dyos!”

en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down and gave up the ghost: and great fear came upon all that heard it.
war: Han pakabati gud la hini ni Ananias, natumba hiya ngan namatay. Duro an kahadlok han ngatanan nga nagpakabati hini.

en: And the young men arose and wrapped him round, and they carried him out and buried him.
war: Dinmaop an mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an, ginputos an iya lawas, gindara hiya ha gawas, ngan iginlubong.

en: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
war: Pag-agi hin mga tulo ka oras, sinmulod an iya asawa, kundi diri hiya maaram han nahinabo.

en: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much. And she said, Yea, for so much.
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro ha iya, “Pagsumati ako: amo ba la ini an bayad han iyo hiagi nga iyo ginbaligya?”

en: But Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to try the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them that have buried thy husband are at the door, and they shall carry thee out.
war: “Oo,” binmaton hi Safira, “amo la ito.”

en: And she fell down immediately at his feet, and gave up the ghost: and the young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Pedro ha iya, “Kay ano nga ginsarihan man niyo nga duha an Espiritu han Ginoo? Aada pa yana ha porta an mga tawo nga naglubong han imo bana, ngan hira liwat an magdadara ha imo.”

en: And great fear came upon the whole church, and upon all that heard these things.
war: Natumba hiya dayon ha tiilan ni Pedro ngan namatay. Sinmulod an mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an ngan hinkit-an nira nga patay na hiya. Gindara hiya nira ha gawas ngan iginlubong sapit han iya bana.

en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people: and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
war: Duro gud an kahadlok han bug-os nga singbahan ngan han ngatanan nga nagpakabati hini.

en: But of the rest durst no man join himself to them: howbeit the people magnified them;
war: Ginbuhat han mga apostoles dida han mga tawo in damo nga mga milagro ngan mga urosahon. Nagkatirok an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon didto han Balkon ni Solomon.

en: and believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women:
war: Waray taga gawas han hugpo nga nagpasipara hin pagtampo ha ira bisan kon hitaas an pagtahod ha ira han mga tawo.

en: insomuch that they even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that, as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some one of them.
war: Kundi nagtikadamo an mga tawo nga nahidugang han ira hugpo—kadam-an nga kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an nga tinmoo han Ginoo.

en: And there also came together the multitude from the cities round about Jerusalem, bringing sick folk, and them that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
war: Tungod han ginbuhat han mga apostoles, iginggawas an mga magsakit ngadto han kadalanan, ngan ginpahigda hira ha mga bantayaw ngan mga banig, basi ha paglabay ni Pedro, malambongan na man la in bisan pira ha ira.

en: But the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy,
war: Ngan nagkaabot in damo nga mga tawo tikang han kaburubungtohan nga hirani ha Jerusalem, dara an ira mga magsakit ngan an may-ada magraot nga espiritu, ngan nagkauupay ini hira ngatanan.

en: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public ward.
war: Niyan an Labaw nga Padi ngan an ngatanan niya nga mga kaupod nga mga sakop han hugpo han mga Sadusiyo naawa hin duro han mga apostoles, sanglit nagkaurosa hira hin pagpugong ha ira.

en: But an angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them out, and said,
war: Gindakop nira an mga apostoles ngan iginsulod ha prisohan.

en: Go ye, and stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this Life.
war: Kundi hito ngahaw nga gab-i gin-abrehan hin usa nga anghel han Ginoo an mga portahan han prisohan ngan ginpagawas an mga apostoles, ngan nagsiring ha ira,

en: And when they heard this , they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison-house to have them brought.
war: “Kadto ngan tindog kamo didto ha Templo ngan pagsumati an mga tawo mahitungod hini nga bag-o nga kinabuhi.”

en: But the officers that came found them not in the prison; and they returned, and told,
war: Gintuman ini han mga apostoles, ngan han maagahon pa sinmulod hira han Templo ngan nagtikang hin pagtutdo.

en: saying, The prison-house we found shut in all safety, and the keepers standing at the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
war: An Labaw nga Padi ngan han iya mga kaupod nagtawag han ngatanan nga katigurangan nga Judiyo ngadto hin usa nga katirok han Labaw nga Hukmanan. Niyan nagsugo hira hin pagkuha han mga apostoles ha prisohan basi umatubang ha ira.

en: Now when the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were much perplexed concerning them whereunto this would grow.
war: Kundi han pagkadto didto han mga opisyal, waray na didto an mga apostoles. Sanglit binmalik hira ngadto han Labaw nga Hukmanan ngan nagsumat,

en: And there came one and told them, Behold, the men whom ye put in the prison are in the temple standing and teaching the people.
war: “Han pag-abot namon ha prisohan, hinkit-an namon nga trinangkahan ini hin maupay ngan binantayan an mga portahan han ngatanan nga mga gwardya; kundi han pag-abrehi na namon han mga portahan, waray namon hinkit-an nga tawo ha sulod!”

en: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them, but without violence; for they feared the people, lest they should be stoned.
war: Han pakabati hini han kapitan han mga gwardya han Templo, ngan han mga puno han kapadian, nahipausa hira kon ano an nahinabo han mga apostoles.

en: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council. And the high priest asked them,
war: Niyan inmabot in usa ka tawo nga nagsiring ha ira, “An mga tawo nga iyo ginpriso aadto na ha Templo nagtututdo han mga tawo!”

en: saying, We strictly charged you not to teach in this name: and behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.
war: Sanglit kinmadto ha Templo an kapitan upod an iya mga sakop, ngan gindakop nira an mga apostoles. Kundi waray hira gumamit hin kusog kay nahadlok hira nga bangin pagbatoon hira han mga tawo.

en: But Peter and the apostles answered and said, We must obey God rather than men.
war: Ginpasulod nira an mga apostoles, ginpaatubang han Labaw nga Hukmanan, ngan ginpakianhan hira han Labaw nga Padi.

en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew, hanging him on a tree.
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Amon kamo gindid-an hin mahigpit nga diri kamo magtutdo ha ngaran hini nga tawo, kundi kitaa an iyo ginbuhat! Iginpasarang niyo ha bug-os nga Jerusalem an iyo pagturon-an, ngan karuyag pa niyo nga kami an pagbasolon han iya pagkamatay!”

en: Him did God exalt with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
war: Binmaton hi Pedro ngan an iba nga mga apostoles, “Kinahanglan pagsugton namon an Dyos, diri an mga tawo.

en: And we are witnesses of these things; and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
war: Nagbanhaw kan Jesus an Dyos han amon kaapoy-apoyan kahuman niyo pataya hiya pinaagi hin pagraysangan ha iya ha kros.

en: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were minded to slay them.
war: Ngan ginbanhaw hiya han Dyos ngadto ha iya tuo sugad nga Pangulo ngan Magtaralwas, hin paghatag ha mga tawo han Israel hin higayon hin pagbasol, ngan basi mapasaylo an ira mga sala.

en: But there stood up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in honor of all the people, and commanded to put the men forth a little while.
war: Mga saksi kami hini nga mga butang—kami ngan an Espiritu Santo nga amo an hatag han Dyos hadton mga nagsusugot ha iya.”

en: And he said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves as touching these men, what ye are about to do.
war: Han pakabati hini han mga kaapi han Labaw nga Hukmanan, uraura gud an ira kasina, nga karuyag nira ipapatay an mga apostoles.

en: For before these days rose up Theudas, giving himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nought.
war: Kundi tinmindog in usa ha ira, usa nga Parisiyo nga ginngaranan nga Gamaliel, usa nga magturutdo han Balaod, nga tinahod kaupay han ngatanan nga mga tawo. Nagsugo hiya nga pagawson anay an mga apostoles,

en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the enrolment, and drew away some of the people after him: he also perished; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
war: ngan ginsiring niya an Labaw nga Hukmanan: “Mga taga-Israel, panginano kamo hin maupay han iyo pagbubuhaton hini nga mga tawo.

en: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will be overthrown:
war: May-ada hadto tawo nga Teudas an ngaran, nga napadako nga pagkatawo, ngan tinmampo ha iya in mga upat ka gatos nga mga tawo. Kundi ginpatay hiya ngan nagkaburublag an ngatanan niya nga mga sakop, ngan nakawang an iya panlimbasog.

en: but if it is of God, ye will not be able to overthrow them; lest haply ye be found even to be fighting against God.
war: Ha panahon liwat han pagsensos pinmakita hi Judas nga taga-Galilea, ngan nakakabig hiya hin damo nga mga tawo, kundi ginpatay liwat hiya ngan nagkaburublag an ngatanan niya nga mga sakop.

en: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles unto them, they beat them and charged them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
war: Sanglit sugad hini yana nga hinabo, nasiring ako ha iyo nga ayaw kamo paghilabot hini nga mga tawo. Pabay-i niyo hira kay kon kanan tawo la ini nga ira ginlarang ngan ginbuhat, makakawang gud ini.

en: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the Name.
war: Kundi kon tikang sa Dyos ini, diri gud kamo makakadaog ha ira. Masabot pa la kamo nga nakikig-away kamo han Dyos!”

en: And every day, in the temple and at home, they ceased not to teach and to preach Jesus as the Christ.
war: Ginsunod han Labaw nga Hukmanan an sagdon ni Gamaliel.

en: Now in these days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, there arose a murmuring of the Grecian Jews against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
war: Waray pag-iha, han nagtitikadamo na an mga tinun-an, nagkamay-ada larolantugi an mga Judiyo nga Griego an yinaknan kontra han mga tuminungnong nga Judiyo. Nagkamay-ada pag-uba an mga Judiyo nga Griego an yinaknan kay napapasibay-an an ira mga balo nga kababayen-an han adlaw-adlaw nga panhatag han ira garastohon nga kwarta.

en: And the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not fit that we should forsake the word of God, and serve tables.
war: Sanglit gintirok han dose nga mga apostoles an bug-os nga hugpo han mga magtinuohon ngan ginsiring hira, “Diri maupay para ha amon nga bayaan namon an pagwali han pulong han Dyos tungod hin panimangno hin mga butang bahin hin salapi.

en: Look ye out therefore, brethren, from among you seven men of good report, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
war: Sanglit, kabugtoan, pagpili kamo dida ha iyo hin pito ka tawo nga maupay an kinabuhi ngan puno han Espiritu Santo ug kinaadman, ngan itatapod namon ha ira ini nga buruhaton.

en: But we will continue stedfastly in prayer, and in the ministry of the word.
war: Tungod hini magagamit namon an amon bug-os nga panahon hin pag-ampo ngan pagwali.”

en: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolaüs a proselyte of Antioch;
war: Naruyagan han bug-os nga hugpo an iginlarang han mga apostoles, sanglit ginpili nira hi Esteban nga puno hin pagtoo ngan han Espiritu Santo, ngan hira Felipe, Procuro, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, ug Nicolas na taga-Antioquia, usa nga Hentil nga nakabig ngadto ha tuluohan han mga Judiyo.

en: whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands upon them.
war: Gindara hira han hugpo ngadto han mga apostoles, ngan an mga apostoles nag-ampo ngan nagpandong han ira mga kamot ha ira.

en: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem exceedingly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
war: Ngan nagpadayon paglurab an pulong han Dyos. Nagtikadamo an mga magtinuohon ha Jerusalem ngan kadam-an nga kapadian nga Judiyo in tinmampo.

en: And Stephen, full of grace and power, wrought great wonders and signs among the people.
war: Hi Esteban nga usa ka tawo nga puno han grasya ug gahom han Dyos nagbuhat hin dagko nga mga milagro ngan mga urosahon dida han mga tawo.

en: But there arose certain of them that were of the synagogue called the synagogue of the Libertines, and of the Cyrenians, and of the Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and Asia, disputing with Stephen.
war: Kundi sinmupak ha iya in mga tawo nga kaapi han sinagoga han ginngangaranan nga Talwas nga mga tawo, nga may mga Judiyo nga taga-Cirene ngan taga-Alejandria. Nakiglantugi kan Esteban hira ngan iba pa nga mga Judiyo nga taga-Cilicia ngan taga-Asia.

en: And they were not able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spake.
war: Kundi an Espiritu naghatag kan Esteban hin dako nga kinaadman, sanglit waray gud hira makakabaton ha iya.

en: Then they suborned men, who said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
war: Sanglit nagsuhol hira hin mga tawo hin pagpasiring, “Nakabati kami ha iya nga nagpapakaraot kan Moises ngan han Dyos!”

en: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and seized him, and brought him into the council,
war: Dida hini nga paagi gintukso nira hin kasina kan Esteban an mga tawo, an katigurangan, ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod. Gindakop nira hi Esteban ngan gindara ngadto ha atubangan han Labaw nga Hukmanan.

en: and set up false witnesses, who said, This man ceaseth not to speak words against this holy place, and the law:
war: Niyan ginpasulod nira in mga tawo hin pagbuwa kontra ha iya. Nagsiring ini hira, “Pirme nagyiyinakan ini nga tawo kontra han aton baraan nga Templo ngan han Balaod ni Moises.

en: for we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered unto us.
war: Nakabati kami nga nagsiring hiya nga pagrurub-on hini nga Jesus nga taga-Nazaret ini nga Templo ngan pagliliwaton an ngatanan nga mga turumanon nga iginbilin ni Moises ha aton!”

en: And all that sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
war: Tinmutok kan Esteban an ngatanan nga nalingkod ha Labaw nga Hukmanan ngan kinmita hira nga an nawong ni Esteban sugad hin nawong hin usa nga anghel.

en: And the high priest said, Are these things so?
war: Nagpakiana kan Esteban an Labaw nga Padi, “Matuod ba ini?”

en: And he said,
war: Nagbaton hi Esteban: “Kabugtoan ngan mga ginikanan, pamatii ako niyo! Han waray pa hi Abraham nga aton ginikanan pag-ukoy didto ha Haran, nagpakita ha iya an Dyos han Kagamhanan didto ha Mesopotamia.

en: Brethren and fathers, hearken: The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Haran,
war: Ngan ginsiring hiya, ‘Bayai an imo panimalay ngan an imo nasod ngan kadto han tuna nga igpapakita ko ha imo.’

en: and said unto him, Get thee out of thy land, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall show thee.
war: Sanglit binayaan niya an tuna han Caldea ngan nag-ukoy hiya didto ha Haran. Han kamatay han amay ni Abraham, ginpabalhin hiya han Dyos nganhi hini nga tuna nga inuokyan niyo yana.

en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldæans, and dwelt in Haran: and from thence, when his father was dead, God removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell:
war: Waray pa hadto maghatag an Dyos kan Abraham hin bisan ano nga bahin hito nga tuna, nga iya kalugaringon nga bahin, bisan na man la usa ka dangaw nga tuna. Kundi nagsaad an Dyos nga ighahatag ini ha iya, ngan hiya na ngan an iya mga sumurunod an magtatag-iya hini. Waray pa mga anak hi Abraham han pagsaad han Dyos hini.

en: and he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: and he promised that he would give it to him in possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
war: Amo ini an siring han Dyos ha iya: ‘Mag-uokoy an imo mga tulin didto ha langyaw nga tuna diin magigin mga oripon ngan pagraraogdaogon hira sulod hin 400 ka tuig.

en: And God spake on this wise, that his seed should sojourn in a strange land, and that they should bring them into bondage, and treat them ill, four hundred years.
war: Kundi sisirotan ko an mga tawo nga pagsisirbehan nira, ngan katapos, magawas hira hito nga tuna ngan magsisingba hira ha akon dinhe hini nga dapit.’

en: And the nation to which they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
war: Ngan iginhatag han Dyos kan Abraham an seremonyas han pagtori sugad nga tigaman han ginsabotan. Sanglit gintori ni Abraham hi Isaac ha ikawalo ka adlaw tikang hiya matawo; gintori liwat ni Isaac hi Jacob, ngan gintori ni Jacob an iya dose nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an nga amo an mga patriyarka.

en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob, and Jacob the twelve patriarchs.
war: “Naawa kan Jose an mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Jacob ngan iginbaligya nira hiya nga oripon didto ha Ehipto. Kundi nag-upod ha iya an Dyos,

en: And the patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt: and God was with him,
war: ngan nagtalwas ha iya han ngatanan nga kakurian niya. Han pag-atubang ni Jose kan Paraon nga hadi han Ehipto, gintagan hiya han Dyos hin maupay nga ginawian ug kinaadman. Ginhimo ni Paraon hi Jose nga gobernador han nasod ngan han hadianon nga panimalay.

en: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
war: Niyan nagkamay-ada kagutom ha bug-os nga Ehipto ngan ha Canaan, nga nakahatag hin dako nga kakurian, ngan waray sadang makaon an aton mga kaapoy-apoyan.

en: Now there came a famine over all Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
war: Sanglit han pakabati ni Jacob nga may trigo didto ha Ehipto, ginsugo niya ngadto an iya mga anak nga aton kaapoy-apoyan. Amo adto an ira syahan nga pagduaw.

en: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent forth our fathers the first time.
war: Han ikaduha nira nga pagkadto, nagpakilala hi Jose han iya kabugtoan, ngan nakilala ni Paraon an panimalay ni Jose.

en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s race became manifest unto Pharaoh.
war: Sanglit nagpatugon hi Jose kan Jacob nga amay niya, nga pakadtoon ha Ehipto hiya ngan an bug-os niya nga panimalay; 75 ka tawo hira ngatanan.

en: And Joseph sent, and called to him Jacob his father, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
war: Ngan kinmadto hi Jacob ha Ehipto diin namatay hiya ngan an iya mga anak.

en: And Jacob went down into Egypt; and he died, himself and our fathers;
war: Gindara an ira mga lawas ngadto ha Siquem ngan iginlubong hira didto han lubnganan nga ginpalit ni Abraham tikang han panimalay ni Hamor.

en: and they were carried over unto Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver of the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
war: “Han tikahirani na an panahon hin pagtuman han Dyos han iginsaad niya kan Abraham, nagdamo na hin duro an aton mga tawo didto ha Ehipto.

en: But as the time of the promise drew nigh which God vouchsafed unto Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
war: Niyan may sinmaliwan hin paghadi ha Ehipto nga diri nakilala kan Jose.

en: till there arose another king over Egypt, who knew not Joseph.
war: Ginlimbongan niya an aton kaapoy-apoyan ngan iya ginraogdaog hira, ngan ginpirit hira hin pagbutang ha gawas han ira mga balay han ira mga minasus-an basi ini hira magkamatay.

en: The same dealt craftily with our race, and ill-treated our fathers, that they should cast out their babes to the end they might not live.
war: Hini manta nga panahon natawo hi Moises, usa nga bata nga makalilipay gud pagkit-on. Sulod hin tulo ka bulan ginmangnoan hiya han iya mga kag-anak didto han ira balay.

en: At which season Moses was born, and was exceeding fair; and he was nourished three months in his father’s house:
war: Ngan han pagbutangan na ha iya ha gawas han balay, gin-angkon ngan ginmangnoan hiya han anak nga babaye ni Paraon sugad hin iya kalugaringon nga anak.

en: and when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
war: Gintutdoan hi Moises han ngatanan nga kinaadman han mga taga-Ehipto, ngan nagin bantogan hiya ha pulong ug ha buhat.

en: And Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians; and he was mighty in his words and works.
war: “Han 40 na ka tuig an edad ni Moises naghunahuna hiya hin pagduaw han iya mga igkasi-Israelita.

en: But when he was well-nigh forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
war: Hinkit-an niya in usa ha ira nga ginkakastigo hin Ehiptohanon; sanglit inugopan ini niya ngan ginpatay niya an Ehiptohanon. (

en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, smiting the Egyptian:
war: Naghunahuna hiya nga makakasabot an iya kalugaringon nga mga tawo nga gagamiton hiya han Dyos hin pagtalwas ha ira; kundi waray hira makasabot.)

en: and he supposed that his brethren understood that God by his hand was giving them deliverance; but they understood not.
war: Han pagkabuwas, hinkit-an niya in duha nga Israelita nga nag-aaway ngan gintinguha niya hin pagtuhay ha ira. Nagsiring hiya, ‘Mga sangkay ko, pamatii daw ako niyo! Magbugto la kamo; kay ano nga nag-aaway man kamo?’

en: And the day following he appeared unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
war: Kundi an nagkakastigo han iya kaaway nagtikwang la kan Moises ngan nagpakiana, ‘Hin-o an naghimo ha imo nga punoan ngan maghurukom ha amon?

en: But he that did his neighbor wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
war: Buot mo ba patayon ako sugad han pagpatay mo han Ehiptohanon kakulop?’

en: Wouldest thou kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian yesterday?
war: Han pakabati hini ni Moises, pinmalagiw hiya ha Ehipto ngan nag-ukoy didto ha tuna han Madian. Didto magkamay-ada hiya duha nga anak nga lalake.

en: And Moses fled at this saying, and became a sojourner in the land of Midian, where he begat two sons.
war: “Pag-agi hin 40 ka tuig, nagpakita kan Moises in usa nga anghel dida hin naglalaga nga tanom, didto ha kamingawan hirani han Bukid Sinai.

en: And when forty years were fulfilled, an angel appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
war: Nahipausa hi Moises han iya hinkit-an, ngan hinmarani hiya han tanom hin pag-usisa. Kundi hinbatian niya an tingog han Ginoo nga nasiring,

en: And when Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold, there came a voice of the Lord,
war: ‘Amo ako an Dyos han imo kaapoy-apoyan, an Dyos ni Abraham, ni Isaac, ug ni Jacob.’ Kinmurog hi Moises hin kahadlok ngan waray na mangahas hin pagkita.

en: I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob. And Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
war: Nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, ‘Hukasa an imo mga sandalyas kay baraan nga tuna an imo tinitindogan.

en: And the Lord said unto him, Loose the shoes from thy feet: for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
war: Hinkit-an ko an mapait nga pag-antos han akon mga tawo didto ha Ehipto, ngan hinbatian ko an ira mga araba, sanglit linmusad ako hin pagtalwas ha ira. Hala na, ipapadara ko ikaw ngadto ha Ehipto.’

en: I have surely seen the affliction of my people that is in Egypt, and have heard their groaning, and I am come down to deliver them: and now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
war: “Amo ini nga Moises an iginsalikway han mga tawo han Israel ngan ginpakianhan, ‘Hin-o an naghimo ha imo nga punoan ngan maghurukom ha amon?’ Amo hiya an ginsugo han Dyos nga punoan ngan magtaralwas han mga tawo nga binuligan han anghel nga nagpakita ha iya dida han naglalaga nga tanom.

en: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? him hath God sent to be both a ruler and a deliverer with the hand of the angel that appeared to him in the bush.
war: Nangulo hiya han mga tawo hin paggawas ha Ehipto ngan nagbuhat hiya hin mga milagro ngan mga urosahon didto ha Ehipto ngan ha Dagat nga Pula, ngan didto ha kamingawan sulod hin 40 ka tuig.

en: This man led them forth, having wrought wonders and signs in Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
war: Amo ini nga Moises an nagsiring ha mga tawo han Israel, ‘Magpapadara ha iyo an Dyos hin manaragna sugad han pagpadara niya ha akon, ngan magigin usa hiya han iyo kalugaringon nga mga tawo.’

en: This is that Moses, who said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall God raise up unto you from among your brethren, like unto me.
war: Amo ini hiya an kaupod han mga tawo han Israel nga nagkatirok didto ha kamingawan; didto hiya kaupod han aton kaapoy-apoyan ngan han anghel nga nagyakan ha iya didto ha Bukid Sinai. Kinarawat niya an buhi nga mga mensahe han Dyos basi ihatag ha aton.

en: This is he that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel that spake to him in the mount Sinai, and with our fathers: who received living oracles to give unto us:
war: “Kundi nagdumiri hin pagsugot ha iya an aton kaapoy-apoyan. Ginsalikway nira hiya ngan karuyag nira makabalik unta ngadto ha Ehipto.

en: to whom our fathers would not be obedient, but thrust him from them, and turned back in their hearts unto Egypt,
war: Sanglit ginsiring nira hi Aaron, ‘Ighimo kami hin mga diyosdiyos nga mag-uuna ha amon. Diri kami maaram kon ano an nahinabo hadto nga Moises nga nagpagawas ha amon tikang ha Ehipto.’

en: saying unto Aaron, Make us gods that shall go before us: for as for this Moses, who led us forth out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.
war: Ngan naghimo hira hin diyosdiyos nga hitsora hin lalaki nga baka; ginhalaran nira ini, ngan nagrayhak hira hin pagsaurog han ira ngahaw ginhimo.

en: And they made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
war: Sanglit tinalikdan hira han Dyos ngan ginpasagdan nga magsingba han mga kabiton-an ha kalangitan, sumala han iginsurat ha basahan han mga manaragna nga nasiring:

en: But God turned, and gave them up to serve the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets,
war: ‘Katawhan han Israel! Diri adto para ha akon

en: Did ye offer unto me slain beasts and sacrifices
war: nga nag-ihaw ngan naghalad kamo hin kahayopan

en: Forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
war: sulod hin 40 ka tuig didto ha kamingawan.

en: And ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch,
war: Tulda adto han diyosdiyos nga hi Molok nga iyo gindara,

en: And the star of the god Rephan,
war: ngan an ladawan han iyo bitoon nga diyosdiyos nga hi Refan;

en: The figures which ye made to worship them:
war: mga ladawan hira nga ginhimo niyo basi pagsingbahon.

en: And I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
war: Sanglit ipabibihag ko kamo ngadto ha unhan pa han Babilonia.’

en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he appointed who spake unto Moses, that he should make it according to the figure that he had seen.
war: “An aton kaapoy-apoyan may-ada didto ha kamingawan Tulda diin nagpapakita an Dyos. Ginhimo adto ni Moises sugad han iginsiring han Dyos ha iya, sumala han surubdan nga iginpakita ha iya han Dyos.

en: Which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered on the possession of the nations, that God thrust out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
war: Niyan gindara han aton kaapoy-apoyan ini nga Tulda nga ira kinarawat tikang han ira mga ginikanan ha ira pag-upod-upod kan Josue ngan pagtag-iya han tuna nga ira naagaw tikang han mga nasod nga gintabog han Dyos dida han ira pagsulong. Ngan nagpabilin didto an Tulda tubtob han panahon ni David.

en: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
war: Nakalipay han Dyos hi David, ngan naghangyo hiya han Dyos nga tugotan hiya hin pagtindog hin urokyan han Dyos ni Jacob.

en: But Solomon built him a house.
war: Kundi hi Solomon na an nagtindog hini nga balay.

en: Howbeit the Most High dwelleth not in houses made with hands; as saith the prophet,
war: “Kundi diri nag-uokoy an Labi ka Harangdon nga Dyos ha mga balay nga gintindog hin mga tawo; sumala han siring han manaragna:

en: The heaven is my throne,
war: ‘An langit amo an akon trono, nasiring an Ginoo,

en: And the earth the footstool of my feet:
war: ngan an tuna amo an taramakan han akon mga tiil.

en: What manner of house will ye build me? saith the Lord:
war: Ano nga balay an iyo hihimoon para ha akon?

en: Or what is the place of my rest?
war: Hain man an dapit nga akon pag-uokyan?

en: Did not my hand make all these things?
war: Diri ba ako ngahaw an naghimo hini ngatanan nga mga butang?’

en: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Spirit: as your fathers did, so do ye.
war: “Pagkamatig-a han iyo mga ulo! Pagkadiri matinuohon han iyo mga kasingkasing! Pagkabungol niyo han mensahe han Dyos! Pareho gud kamo han iyo mga ginikanan: dayuday sinusupak niyo an Espiritu Santo!

en: Which of the prophets did not your fathers persecute? and they killed them that showed before of the coming of the Righteous One; of whom ye have now become betrayers and murderers;
war: May-ada ha manaragna nga waray pagpakurii han iyo mga ginikanan? Ginpatay nira an mga surugoon han Dyos nga hadto pa nagpahibaro mahitungod han pag-abot han iya matadong nga Surugoon. Ngan yana iyo ginlingo ngan ginpatay hiya.

en: ye who received the law as it was ordained by angels, and kept it not.
war: Hi kamo an kinmarawat han Balaod han Dyos nga iginhatag pinaagi hin mga anghel, kundi waray ini niyo pagtumana!”

en: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
war: Han namamati kan Esteban an mga sakop han Labaw nga Hukmanan, duro gud an ira kasina ngan nanligot an ira mga ngipon tungod hin kapungot ha iya.

en: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
war: Kundi hinmangad ha langit hi Esteban nga puno han Espiritu, ngan nakita niya an himaya han Dyos ngan hi Jesus nga natindog ha tuo han Dyos.

en: and said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Kitaa, nakita ako nga nabuksan an langit ngan an Anak han Tawo nga natindog ha tuo han Dyos!”

en: And Saul was consenting unto his death.
war: Hito manta nga adlaw nagtikang hin pag-antos hin mabangis nga pagpakurii an singbahan ha Jerusalem. Nagkaburublag an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon, labot han mga apostoles, ngadto han mga lalawigan ha Judea ug ha Samaria.

en: And there arose on that day a great persecution against the church which was in Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria, except the apostles.
war: Ginlubong hi Esteban hin pira nga mga tawo nga mag-inampoon, ngan nagmasulub-on gud hira tungod hin dako nga pagkabido nira ha iya.

en: And devout men buried Stephen, and made great lamentation over him.
war: Kundi gintinguha ni Saulo hin pagpukan han singbahan; ginbalaybalay niya hin pagsiksik han mga magtinuohon nga lalake ug babaye, ngan iya ini hira gindanas ngan ginsulod ha prisohan.

en: But Saul laid waste the church, entering into every house, and dragging men and women committed them to prison.
war: An nagkaburublag nga mga magtinuohon napakadto ha magkalainlain nga dapit ngan nagpasangyaw han mensahe.

en: They therefore that were scattered abroad went about preaching the word.
war: Kinmadto hi Felipe ha syudad ha Samaria ngan didto iginwali niya ha mga tawo an Mesiyas.

en: And Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and proclaimed unto them the Christ.
war: Namati hin maupay an mga tawo han iginsiring ni Felipe. Namati hira ha iya, ngan nakakita hira han mga milagro nga iya ginbuhat.

en: And the multitudes gave heed with one accord unto the things that were spoken by Philip, when they heard, and saw the signs which he did.
war: Nagkagawas nga naggogoliat an magraot nga mga espiritu tikang hin damo nga mga tawo. Damo nga mga paralitiko ngan mga piay in nagkauupay.

en: For from many of those that had unclean spirits, they came out, crying with a loud voice: and many that were palsied, and that were lame, were healed.
war: Sanglit nagkamay-ada dako nga kalipay ha bug-os nga Samaria.

en: And there was much joy in that city.
war: Nag-ukoy didto hadto nga syudad in usa ka tawo nga ginngaranan nga Simon. Nakapahiburong hiya han mga Samaritano sulod hin pira ka panahon tungod han iya salamangka. Nagpatoo hiya nga gamhanan hiya,

en: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who beforetime in the city used sorcery, and amazed the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
war: ngan pinamatian gud hiya han ngatanan nga mga tawo han katilingban. Nagsiring hira, “Amo hiya an gahom han Dyos nga ginngangaranan, ‘An Dako nga Gahom’.”

en: to whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is that power of God which is called Great.
war: Sulod hin maiha nga panahon nakapahiburong hiya ha ira tungod han iya salamangka, sanglit pinamatian gud hiya nira.

en: And they gave heed to him, because that of long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
war: Kundi han pagtoo na nira han iginsangyaw ni Felipe mahitungod han Maupay nga Sumat han Ginhadian han Dyos ngan han ngaran ni Jesu-Cristo, ginbunyagan hira, kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an.

en: But when they believed Philip preaching good tidings concerning the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
war: Tinmoo man liwat hi Simon, ngan kahuman pagbunyagi ha iya, nag-upodupod hiya kan Felipe. Ngan nahipausa hiya han pakakita niya han mga urosahon ngan mga milagro nga ginbuhat.

en: And Simon also himself believed: and being baptized, he continued with Philip; and beholding signs and great miracles wrought, he was amazed.
war: Han pakabati han mga apostoles ha Jerusalem nga kinmarawat han pulong han Dyos an mga tawo ha Samaria, iginpadara nira hi Pedro ug Juan ngadto ha ira.

en: Now when the apostles that were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
war: Han pag-abot nira, nag-ampo hira para han mga magtinuohon basi makarawat nira han Espiritu Santo.

en: who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit:
war: Kay waray pa man kumunsad an Espiritu Santo ha bisan usa ha ira; ginbunyagan la hira ha ngaran han Ginoo nga Jesus.

en: for as yet it was fallen upon none of them: only they had been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
war: Niyan iginpandong nira Pedro ug Juan an ira mga kamot ha ira, ngan kinarawat nira an Espiritu Santo.

en: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
war: Hinkit-an ni Simon nga iginhatag ha mga tawo an Espiritu Santo dida han pagpandongi ha ira han mga kamot han mga apostoles. Sanglit ginhugay niya hin salapi hira Pedro ug Juan,

en: Now when Simon saw that through the laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Spirit was given, he offered them money,
war: ngan ginsiring, “Tagi man ako niyo hini nga gahom, basi bisan hin-o an akon pagpandongan, makarawat liwat han Espiritu Santo.”

en: saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay my hands, he may receive the Holy Spirit.
war: Kundi ginbaton hiya ni Pedro, “Maghikaraot unta ikaw upod an imo kwarta tungod han imo paghunahuna nga mapapalit mo hin kwarta an hatag han Dyos!

en: But Peter said unto him, Thy silver perish with thee, because thou hast thought to obtain the gift of God with money.
war: Waray ka bahin o labot han amon buruhaton kay diri matadong an imo kasingkasing ha atubangan han Dyos.

en: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right before God.
war: Sanglit pagbasoli ini nga maraot mo nga panuyo, ngan pag-ampo ha Ginoo nga pasayloon ka tungod han imo pakahunahuna hin sugad hini.

en: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray the Lord, if perhaps the thought of thy heart shall be forgiven thee.
war: Kay kinikita ko nga duro gud an imo kaawa ngan napripriso ka han sala.”

en: For I see that thou art in the gall of bitterness and in the bond of iniquity.
war: Nagsiring hi Simon kanda Pedro ug Juan, “Alayon hin pag-ampo ha akon ngadto ha Ginoo basi an mga butang nga ginyakan niyo diri nahinabo ha akon!”

en: And Simon answered and said, Pray ye for me to the Lord, that none of the things which ye have spoken come upon me.
war: Katapos nira pagpamatuod ngan pagsangyaw han mensahe han Ginoo, binmalik ha Jerusalem hira Pedro ug Juan. Iginwali liwat nira an Maupay nga Sumat ha damo nga mga baryo han Samaria nga ira inagian.

en: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel to many villages of the Samaritans.
war: Nagsiring kan Felipe in usa nga anghel han Ginoo, “Pag-andam ngan kadto ha timogan, ha dalan nga tikang ha Jerusalem tipakadto ha Gaza.” (Diri na ginagamit ini nga dalan.)

en: But an angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza: the same is desert.
war: 27-28 Sanglit nag-andam hi Felipe ngan kinmadto. Niyan may usa nga yunuko nga taga-Etiopia nga tipauli na. Usa hiya nga importante nga opisyal ug tisurero ni Candace o Rayna han Etiopia. Kinmadto hiya ha Jerusalem hin pagsingba han Dyos, ngan nagtitipauli na nga sakay han iya karuwahe. Samtang nagsasakay hiya, nagbibinasa hiya han basahan nga sinurat ni Isaias nga manaragna.

en: And he arose and went: and behold, a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship;
war: Nagsiring kan Felipe an Espiritu Santo, “Kadtoa ngan duoka ito nga karuwahe.”

en: and he was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
war: Dinmalagan hin paghirani hi Felipe ngan hinbatian niya nga nagbabasa an yunuko han basahan ni manaragna Isaias. Niyan nagpakiana hi Felipe ha iya, “Nakakasabot ka ba han imo ginbabasa?”

en: And the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
war: Nagbaton an opisyal, “Uunanhon ko hin pakasabot kon waray magtutdo hini ha akon?” Ngan ginhangyo niya hi Felipe nga sumakay han karuwahe sapit ha iya.

en: And Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
war: Amo ini an bahin han Kasuratan nga iya ginbabasa:

en: And he said, How can I, except some one shall guide me? And he besought Philip to come up and sit with him.
war: “Sugad hiya hin karnero nga gindara basi pag-ihawon.

en: Now the passage of the scripture which he was reading was this,
war: Sugad hiya hin nati nga karnero nga waray aringasa kon gin-aarotan.

en: He was led as a sheep to the slaughter;
war: Ginpakaalohan hiya ngan waray tagi hin katadongan.

en: And as a lamb before his shearer is dumb,
war: Waray makakagsumat mahitungod han iya katulinan,

en: So he openeth not his mouth:
war: kay natapos na man an iya kinabuhi dinhe ha tuna.”

en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away:
war: Nagsiring kan Felipe an opisyal, “Sumati ako kon hin-o an hinnanabihan hini han manaragna. Hiya ba, o lain ba nga tawo?”

en: His generation who shall declare?
war: Sanglit gin-asoyan hiya ni Felipe han Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod kan Jesus tikang gud dinhe hini nga bahin han Kasuratan.

en: For his life is taken from the earth.
war: Samtang nagpapadayon hira ha dalan, inmabot hira hin dapit nga may-ada tubig, ngan nagsiring an opisyal, “Iini na in tubig; ano pa man in nakakaulang hin pagbunyag ha akon?”

en: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other?
And Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this scripture, preached unto him Jesus.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Felipe, “Mabubunyagan ka kon kinasingkasing gud an imo pagtoo.”

en: And as they went on the way, they came unto a certain water; and the eunuch saith, Behold, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
war: Binmaton hiya, “Oo, natoo ako nga hi Jesu-Cristo amo an Anak han Dyos.”)
Ginpaukoy han opisyal an karuwahe, linmugsong hira Felipe ngan an opisyal ngadto han tubig, ngan ginbunyagan hiya ni Felipe.

en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
war: Han paghaw-as nira han tubig, gindara hi Felipe han Espiritu han Ginoo ngan waray na hiya hikit-i han opisyal. Kundi nagpadayon hin pagsakay nga malipayon an opisyal.

en: But Saul, yet breathing threatening and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
war: Hini nga panahon nagpadayon hi Saulo han iya mapintas nga mga panarhog hin pagpatay han mga tinun-an han Ginoo. Kinmadto hiya han Labaw nga Padi,

en: and asked of him letters to Damascus unto the synagogues, that if he found any that were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
war: ngan nangaro hin mga surat nga magpapakilala ha iya didto ha mga sinagoga han mga Judiyo ha Damasco, basi kon hiagian niya didto in bisan hin-o nga lalake o babaye nga mga sakop han Dalan han Ginoo, makakahimo hiya hin pagdakop ngan ibabalik niya ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: And as he journeyed, it came to pass that he drew nigh unto Damascus: and suddenly there shone round about him a light out of heaven:
war: Han nagtitikahirani na hi Saulo han syudad han Damasco, tigda la nga nalukop hiya hin kapawa nga tikang ha langit.

en: and he fell upon the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
war: Natumba hiya ngan hinbatian niya in tingog nga nasiring ha iya, “Saulo, Saulo, kay ano nga ginpapakurian mo ako?”

en: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said , I am Jesus whom thou persecutest:
war: Nagpakiana hiya, “Hin-o ka ba, Ginoo?”

en: but rise, and enter into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
war: Binmaton an tingog, “Amo ako hi Jesus nga imo ginpapakurian.

en: And the men that journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing the voice, but beholding no man.
war: Buhat ngan pakadto ha syudad, ngan didto pagsusumatan ka kon ano an imo pagbubuhaton.”

en: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw nothing; and they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
war: An mga tawo nga kaupod ni Saulo waray makagkiwa ug makagtingog; hinbatian nira an tingog kundi waray nira hinkit-an nga tawo.

en: And he was three days without sight, and did neither eat nor drink.
war: Binmuhat hi Saulo ngan ginpukrat niya an iya mga mata, kundi waray na hiya makakita, sanglit gintugwayan hiya ngan gindara hiya nira ngadto ha Damasco.

en: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and the Lord said unto him in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here , Lord.
war: Sulod hin tulo ka adlaw waray hiya pakakita, ngan hito nga panahon waray hiya kumaon o uminom.

en: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judas for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus: for behold, he prayeth;
war: May-ada didto ha Damasco usa nga tinun-an nga Ananias an ngaran. Pinaagi hin panan-awon nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, “Ananias!”

en: and he hath seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.
war: Ngan binmaton hiya, “Iini ako, Ginoo.”

en: But Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard from many of this man, how much evil he did to thy saints at Jerusalem:
war: Nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo, “Pag-andam ngan pakadto ha Matadong nga Dalan ngadto han balay ni Judas ngan pagpakiana mahitungod hin usa ka tawo nga taga-Tarsos, nga Saulo an ngaran. Nag-aampo hiya.

en: and here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call upon thy name.
war: Samtang nag-aampo hiya, hinkit-an niya ha usa nga panan-awon in usa ka tawo nga Ananias an ngaran nga sinmulod ngan iginpandong an iya mga kamot ha iya, basi makakita na liwat hiya.”

en: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles and kings, and the children of Israel:
war: Binmaton hi Ananias, “Ginoo, damo na in nagsumat ha akon mahitungod hini nga tawo, mahitungod han ngatanan nga magpakaharadlok nga ginbuhat niya ha imo mga tawo didto ha Jerusalem.

en: for I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
war: Ngan kinmanhi hiya ha Damasco dara in gahom tikang han mga puno han kapadian, hin pagdakop han ngatanan nga natawag han imo ngaran.”

en: And Ananias departed, and entered into the house; and laying his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, who appeared unto thee in the way which thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mayest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.
