en: For herein is the saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
war: Matuod an darahunon, ‘Usa an nagtatanom, iba an nag-aani.’

en: I sent you to reap that whereon ye have not labored: others have labored, and ye are entered into their labor.
war: Ginsugo ko kamo hin pag-ani dida hin uma nga waray niyo pagkabudlayi; iba in nagkabudlay hito, ngan kamo an nagpapahimulos han ira ginkabudlayan.”

en: And from that city many of the Samaritans believed on him because of the word of the woman, who testified, He told me all things that ever I did.
war: Tinmoo kan Jesus in damo han mga Samaritano hito nga bungto kay nagsiring an babaye, “Ginsumatan ako niya han ngatanan nga akon nabuhat.”

en: So when the Samaritans came unto him, they besought him to abide with them: and he abode there two days.
war: Sanglit han pag-abot han mga Samaritano, naghangyo hira ha iya nga magpabilin hiya dida ha ira. Ngan nagpabilin didto hi Jesus hin duha ka adlaw.

en: And many more believed because of his word;
war: Damo pa in tinmoo tungod han iya mensahe,

en: and they said to the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy speaking: for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Saviour of the world.
war: ngan ginsumatan nira an babaye, “Natoo na kami yana, diri tungod han imo iginsiring, kundi tungod han hinbatian namon ngahaw ha iya, ngan maaram kami nga hiya amo an tinuod nga Magtaralwas han kalibutan.”

en: And after the two days he went forth from thence into Galilee.
war: Katapos hin duha ka adlaw didto, linmakat hi Jesus ngan pinmakadto ha Galilea.

en: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honor in his own country.
war: Hiya ngahaw an nagsiring, “Diri tinutuod an manaragna dida han iya kalugaringon nga tuna.”

en: So when he came into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
war: Han pag-abot niya ha Galilea ginkarawat hiya han mga tawo didto, kay nagpakakita hira han ngatanan nga nabuhat niya ha panahon han Pyesta han Paglabay, han paghingadto nira ha Jerusalem ha panahon han pyesta.

en: He came therefore again unto Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha Cana, ha Galilea, diin ginhimo niya nga bino an tubig. May-ada didto usa nga opisyal han bungto nga may anak nga lalake nga masakit didto ha Capernaum.

en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son; for he was at the point of death.
war: Han paghibaro niya nga inmabot hi Jesus ha Galilea tikang ha Judea, kinmadto hiya kan Jesus ngan ginhangyo niya nga masingadto ha Capernaum hin pagtambal han iya anak nga himaratyon.

en: Jesus therefore said unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will in no wise believe.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Waray gud ha iyo matoo labot kon hikit-an niyo in dagko nga mga orosahon.”

en: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
war: Nagbaton an opisyal, “Tana gad, upod ha akon nga diri pa napatay an akon anak.”

en: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. The man believed the word that Jesus spake unto him, and he went his way.
war: Ginasiring hiya ni Jesus, “Kadto na, mabubuhi an imo anak.”

en: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, saying, that his son lived.
war: Tinmoo an tawo han mga pulong ni Jesus ngan linmakat hiya.

en: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to amend. They said therefore unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
war: Dida ha dalan, han tipauli hiya, ginsugat hiya han iya mga surugoon upod an sumat nga buhi an iya anak.

en: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
war: Ginpakianhan niya hira kon ano nga oras nahiolian an iya anak. Nagbaton hira, “Nalunasan hiya han iya hiranat kakulop han ala una.”

en: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judæa into Galilee.
war: Nahinumdom an amay nga amo gud nga takna an pagsiring ni Jesus ha iya, “Mabubuhi na an imo anak.” Sanglit, tinmoo hiya ngan an bug-os niya nga panimalay.

en: After these things there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
war: Katapos hini, nagpyesta an mga Judiyo ngan napakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.

en: Now there is in Jerusalem by the sheep gate a pool, which is called in Hebrew Bethesda, having five porches.
war: Didto ha Jerusalem, hirani han Portahan han mga karnero, may usa nga linaw nga parigoan, nga may lima nga mga balkon. Betsata an ngaran hini ha Hebreohanon.

en: In these lay a multitude of them that were sick, blind, halt, withered.
war: Nakada hini nga mga balkon in damo nga mga magsakit—mga buta, mga piay, ngan mga lulid. [Naghuhulat hira nga bumantad an tubig,
kay may panahon nga nalugsong ha linaw in usa nga anghel han Ginoo ngan inuukay niya an tubig. An una nga makalugsong nga masakit, katapos maukay an tubig, nauupay han bisan ano nga iya sakit.]

en: And a certain man was there, who had been thirty and eight years in his infirmity.
war: May didto usa nga tawo nga 38 ka tuig na an iya kasakit.

en: When Jesus saw him lying, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him, Wouldest thou be made whole?
war: Hinkit-an hiya nga nahigda didto, ngan maaram hi Jesus nga maiha na hin duro an kasakit han tawo; sanglit ginsiring hiya, “Karuyag mo ba mag-upay?”

en: The sick man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
war: Binmaton an masakit, “Waray man nagdadara ha akon ngadto ha linaw kon inuokay na an tubig. Samtang tilugsong pa la ako, hin-uunhan na ako han iba.”

en: Jesus saith unto him, Arise, take up thy bed, and walk.
war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan, ngan lakat.”

en: And straightway the man was made whole, and took up his bed and walked.
war: Naupay dayon an tawo; gindara niya an iya higdaan, ngan linmakat.

en: Now it was the sabbath on that day.
war: Nahinabo ini ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway,

en: So the Jews said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath, and it is not lawful for thee to take up thy bed.
war: sanglit ginsiring han mga punoan nga Judiyo an tawo nga naupay, “Adlaw nga Iparahuway yana, ngan supak ha aton Balaod an pagdara han imo higdaan.”

en: But he answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
war: Binmaton hiya, “Ginsiring ako han tawo nga nagtambal ha akon, ‘Dad-a an imo higdaan ngan lakat.’”

en: They asked him, Who is the man that said unto thee, Take up thy bed , and walk?
war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Hin-o ini nga tawo nga nagsugo ha imo hin pagdara han imo higdaan ngan lakat?”

en: But he that was healed knew not who it was; for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in the place.
war: Kundi waray makakilala an natambal nga tawo kon hin-o an nagtambal ha iya, kay nasalipdan hi Jesus han damo nga mga tawo nga nakadto didto han iya paggawas.

en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing befall thee.
war: Katapos hini, iginkatapo hiya ni Jesus didto han Templo ngan ginsiring hiya, “Kitaa maupay ka na; bayai na an imo sala, kay bangin lugod labaw pa kamaraot an mahinabo ha imo.”

en: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him whole.
war: Ngan linmakat an tawo ngan iya ginsumatan an mga punoan nga Judiyo nga hi Jesus an nagtambal ha iya.

en: And for this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, because he did these things on the sabbath.
war: Tungod hini nagtikang hira pagdumot kan Jesus, kay ginbuhat niya ini nga pagtambal ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh even until now, and I work.
war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Dayuday nagbubuhat an akon Amay, sanglit kinahanglan liwat magbuhat ako.”

en: For this cause therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only brake the sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
war: Ini nga iya siring nakaaghat han mga punoan nga Judiyo pag-iparatay ha iya; diri la nga ginsupak niya an balaod han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, kundi ginsiring pa niya nga iya kalugaringon nga Amay an Dyos, ngan dida hini, nakikigtupong hiya han Dyos.

en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father doing: for what things soever he doeth, these the Son also doeth in like manner.
war: Sanglit ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: diri nagbubuhat an Anak hin iya la kalugaringon; nagbubuhat hiya han nakikita niya nga ginbubuhat han iya Amay. Kon ano an ginbubuhat han Amay, amo man liwat an ginbubuhat han Anak.

en: For the Father loveth the Son, and showeth him all things that himself doeth: and greater works than these will he show him, that ye may marvel.
war: Kay hinihigugma han Amay an Anak ngan ginpapakita an Anak han ngatanan nga ginbubuhat han Amay ngahaw. Ipapakita niya han iya Anak in darudagko pa nga mga buruhaton kay hini, ngan mahipapausa kamo ngatanan.

en: For as the Father raiseth the dead and giveth them life, even so the Son also giveth life to whom he will.
war: Sugad nga ginbabanhaw han Amay an mga minatay ngan tinatagan hira hin kinabuhi, ha amo man nga paagi, nahatag an Anak hin kinabuhi hadton iya karuyag tagan.

en: For neither doth the Father judge any man, but he hath given all judgment unto the Son;
war: Diri na maghuhukom an Amay bisan kan kanay. Iginhatag na niya ngadto han iya Anak an bug-os nga katungod hin paghukom,

en: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He that honoreth not the Son honoreth not the Father that sent him.
war: basi magpasidungog han Anak an ngatanan, sugad han ira pagpasidungog han Amay. Bisan hin-o nga diri nagpapasidungog han Anak, diri man nagpapasidungog han Amay nga amo an nagsugo ha iya.

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth him that sent me, hath eternal life, and cometh not into judgment, but hath passed out of death into life.
war: “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: may-ada na dayon nga kinabuhi an bisan hin-o nga namamati han akon mga pulong, ngan natoo ha iya nga nagsugo ha akon. Diri na hiya paghuhukman, kay inmagi na hiya han kamatayon ngadto ha kinabuhi.

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour cometh, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God; and they that hear shall live.
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: Tiarabot an panahon, ngan inmabot na ini—nga makakabati an mga minatay han tingog han Anak han Dyos, ngan mabubuhi adton makabati hini nga tingog.

en: For as the Father hath life in himself, even so gave he to the Son also to have life in himself:
war: Sugad nga an Amay, ha iya ngahaw, amo an tinikangan han kinabuhi, ha sugad man nga paagi, ginhimo niya an iya Anak nga magin tinikangan han kinabuhi.

en: and he gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
war: Ngan iginhatag ngadto han Anak an katungod hin paghukom, kay Anak han Tawo man hiya.

en: Marvel not at this: for the hour cometh, in which all that are in the tombs shall hear his voice,
war: Ayaw kamo hipausa hini; tiarabot an panahon nga makakabati han iya tingog an ngatanan nga mga minatay ha lubnganan,

en: and shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of judgment.
war: ngan magkakaguwa hira han ira mga lubnganan; mabangon ngan mabubuhi adton nagbuhat hin mag-upay, ngan mabangon ngan pagsisirotan adton nagbuhat hin magraot.

en: I can of myself do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is righteous; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
war: “Waray ko mahihimo ha akon la kalugaringon; naghuhukom la ako sumala han iginsiring han Dyos ha akon, sanglit matadong an akon paghukom, kay diri ako nagtitinguha hin pagbuhat han akon karuyag, kundi an karuyag la han nagsugo ha akon.

en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
war: “Kon magsaksi ako ha akon la ngahaw, diri angay karawaton sugad nga tinuod nga pruyba an akon iginsiring.

en: It is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
war: Kundi may-ada usa labot ha akon, nga nagsasaksi para ha akon, ngan maaram ako nga matuod an iginsisiring niya mahitungod ha akon.

en: Ye have sent unto John, and he hath borne witness unto the truth.
war: Ginpadara niyo an iyo mga sinugo ngadto kan Juan, ngan nagyakan hiya ha ngaran han kamatuoran.

en: But the witness which I receive is not from man: howbeit I say these things, that ye may be saved.
war: Diri nga nagkikinahanglan ako hin kanan tawo pagsaksi; ginsusumat ko la ini, basi matalwas unta kamo.

en: He was the lamp that burneth and shineth; and ye were willing to rejoice for a season in his light.
war: Sugad hi Juan hin suga nga naglalaga ngan malamrag, ngan naruyag kamo ha usa ka dali hin pagpahimulos han iya kapawa.

en: But the witness which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father hath given me to accomplish, the very works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
war: Kundi may-ada ko saksi para ha akon, nga labaw pa kay han pagsaksi ni Juan: an mga buhat nga akon gintutuman, an mga buhat nga ginpapatuman ha akon han Amay, mga saksi ini hira para ha akon, ngan nagpapahayag nga ginsugo ako han Amay.

en: And the Father that sent me, he hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
war: Ngan nagsasaksi liwat para ha akon an Amay nga nagsugo ha akon. Waray gud niyo hibatii an iya tingog, o hikit-i an iya nawong;

en: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he sent, him ye believe not.
war: ngan waray niyo tipigi ha iyo mga kasingkasing an iya mensahe, kay diri man kamo natoo han ginsugo niya.

en: Ye search the scriptures, because ye think that in them ye have eternal life; and these are they which bear witness of me;
war: Nag-aaram kamo han Kasuratan kay naghuhunahuna kamo nga hiaagian niyo dida ha ira an dayon nga kinabuhi. Ngan nagpapamatuod ini hira ngahaw mahitungod ha akon!

en: and ye will not come to me, that ye may have life.
war: Kundi diri niyo karuyag kumadi ha akon basi maangkon niyo an kinabuhi.

en: I receive not glory from men.
war: “Diri ako nag-uungara nga dayawon ako hin mga tawo.

en: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in yourselves.
war: Kundi nakilala ako ha iyo; maaram ako nga waray kamo gugma para han Dyos ha iyo mga kasingkasing.

en: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
war: Kinmanhi ako ha ngaran han akon Amay, kundi waray kamo kumarawat ha akon. Kon may kumanhi ha iya la kalugaringon nga ngaran, kakarawaton lugod hiya niyo.

en: How can ye believe, who receive glory one of another, and the glory that cometh from the only God ye seek not?
war: Karuyag niyo an paggidayawdayaw, kundi waray lugod niyo pagtinguhaa an pagdayaw nga natikang ha usa la nga Dyos: sanglit uunanhon hin pakatuo niyo?

en: Think not that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, on whom ye have set your hope.
war: Kundi ayaw kamo paghunahuna nga isusumbong ko kamo ngadto han akon Amay. Hi Moises, nga amo an iyo ginlaoman, hiya an magsusumbong ha iyo.

en: For if ye believed Moses, ye would believe me; for he wrote of me.
war: Kon tinuod nga natoo kamo kan Moises, matoo unta kamo ha akon, kay nagsurat hiya mahitungod ha akon.

en: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
war: Katapos hini, binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha tabok han Lanaw han Galilea (o Lanaw han Tiberias).

en: And a great multitude followed him, because they beheld the signs which he did on them that were sick.
war: Nagsunod ha iya in kadam-an nga mga tawo, kay hinkit-an nira an iya mga milagro hin panambal han mga magsakit.

en: And Jesus went up into the mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
war: Sinmagka hi Jesus hin pungtod ngan linmingkod upod an iya mga tinun-an.

en: Now the passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
war: Hirani na an Pyesta han Paglabay han mga Judiyo.

en: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude cometh unto him, saith unto Philip, Whence are we to buy bread, that these may eat?
war: Han pagtan-aw ni Jesus, hinkit-an niya in kadam-an nga mga tawo nga tipakada ha iya, sanglit nagpakiana hiya kan Felipe, “Hain man kita pakakapalit hin igo nga ipapakaon hini ngatanan nga mga tawo?” (

en: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
war: Ginsiring ini niya hin pagsari kan Felipe; ha tinuod, maaram hiya nga daan kon ano an iya bubuhaton.)

en: Philip answered him, Two hundred shillings’ worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one may take a little.
war: Binmaton hi Felipe, “Bisan talagudti la an ipanhatag ha kada usa, magkikinahanglan gud ini ngatanan hin kapin hin kanan P400.00 nga tinapay.”

en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,
war: Nagsiring hi Andres nga bugto ni Simon Pedro, nga usa han iya mga tinun-an,

en: There is a lad here, who hath five barley loaves, and two fishes: but what are these among so many?
war: “May-ada dinhe lalakehay nga may lima ka bug-os nga sebada nga tinapay ngan hin duha nga isda. Kundi ano man la ini para hin sugad kadamo nga mga tawo?”

en: Jesus said, Make the people sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Papanlingkora an mga tawo.” (Banwaon adto nga dapit.) Sanglit nagkalingkod an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga maabot hin harani lima ka yukot an kalalaken-an.

en: Jesus therefore took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to them that were set down; likewise also of the fishes as much as they would.
war: Ginkuha ni Jesus an tinapay, nagpasalamat sa Dyos, ngan igindurot ini ngadto han mga tawo nga nagkakalingkod didto. Amo man an ginbuhat niya han duha nga isda, ngan natagan an ngatanan tubtob han ira karuyag.

en: And when they were filled, he saith unto his disciples, Gather up the broken pieces which remain over, that nothing be lost.
war: Han busog na hira ngatanan, ginsiring niya an iya tinun-an, “Tiroka niyo an mga nanhisalin, basi waray makarag.”

en: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which remained over unto them that had eaten.
war: Sanglit gintirok nira an ngatanan, ngan napuno nira in dose nga basket han mga nanhisalin tikang ha lima ka bug-os nga tinapay nga pinangaon han mga tawo.

en: When therefore the people saw the sign which he did, they said, This is of a truth the prophet that cometh into the world.
war: Nagsiring an mga tawo didto nga nagpakakita hini nga ginbuhat ni Jesus, “Amo na gud ini an Manaragna nga mapakanhi ha kalibutan!”

en: Jesus therefore perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again into the mountain himself alone.
war: Nakasabot hi Jesus nga tidaraop na hira hin pagkuha ha iya ngan pipiriton hiya basi himoon hiya nga hadi nira. Sanglit kinmadto na liwat hiya, nga nag-uusaan la, ha kapungtoran.

en: And when evening came, his disciples went down unto the sea;
war: Han tipagsisirom na, nanlugsong an iya mga tinun-an ngadto han lanaw.

en: and they entered into a boat, and were going over the sea unto Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.
war: Sinmakay hira hin sakayan, ngan binmalik pagtabok han lanaw tipakadto ha Capernaum. Nagab-ihan hira, kundi waray pa aabot hi Jesus.

en: And the sea was rising by reason of a great wind that blew.
war: Hini nga takna nagmadlos, ngan nagmabalod hin duro.

en: When therefore they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they behold Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the boat: and they were afraid.
war: Nakapalawod na an mga tinun-an hin mga lima o unom ka kilometro, han paghikit-i nira kan Jesus nga naglalakat ha bawbaw han tubig, nagtitikahirani han sakayan, ngan duro gud an ira kahadlok.

en: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Ako ini, ayaw kamo kahadlok!”

en: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat: and straightway the boat was at the land whither they were going.
war: Nalipay hira pagpasakay ha iya; ngan dinmuong hira dayon ha dapit nga ira kinakadtoan.

en: On the morrow the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, save one, and that Jesus entered not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples went away alone
war: Pagkabuwas, hinkit-an han mga tawo nga nakadto ha tabok han lanaw nga uusa na la an nahibilin nga sakayan. Nahibaro hira nga diri upod hi Jesus, kundi an iya la mga tinun-an an ginmikan.

en: (howbeit there came boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks):
war: May iba nga mga sakayan nga tikang ha Tiberias dinmuong hirani han dapit nga pinangaonan han tinapay katapos magpasalamat an Ginoo.

en: when the multitude therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
war: Pakakita han mga tawo nga waray didto hi Jesus o an iya mga tinun-an, sinmakay hira hin mga sakayan ngan kinmadto ha Capernaum hin pagbiling ha iya.

en: And when they found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
war: Han paghiagii kan Jesus han mga tawo didto ha tabok han lanaw, nagsiring hira ha iya, “Magturutdo, kakan-o ka pa abot nganhi?”

en: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw signs, but because ye ate of the loaves, and were filled.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: ginbibiling ako niyo kay kinmaon kamo han tinapay ngan nagkabubusog kamo, diri tungod nga hinsabtan niyo an mga tigaman han akon gahom.

en: Work not for the food which perisheth, but for the food which abideth unto eternal life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him the Father, even God, hath sealed.
war: Ayaw kamo pagkabudlay tungod han pagkaon nga nadudunot, kundi pagkabudlay lugod kamo tungod han pagkaon nga nagpapadayon ha kinabuhi nga waray kataposan. Ihahatag ini ha iyo han Anak han Tawo, kay iginbutang na ha iya han Dyos nga Amay an karig-onan han iya kagamhanan.”

en: They said therefore unto him, What must we do, that we may work the works of God?
war: Sanglit nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Ano man an sadang namon buhaton basi makatuman kami han mga ipinapagbuhat ha amon han Dyos?”

en: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Amo ini an karuyag han Dyos ipabuhat ha iyo: sarig kamo han iya ginsugo.”

en: They said therefore unto him, What then doest thou for a sign, that we may see, and believe thee? what workest thou?
war: Nagpakiana liwat hira, “Ano nga tigaman han imo gahom an imo bubuhaton basi namon hikit-an, ngan sumarig kami ha imo? Ano man an bubuhaton mo?

en: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written, He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.
war: Nangaon han mana didto ha kamingawan an amon mga ginikanan, sumala han siring han kasuratan: ‘Gintagan hira niya hin tinapay nga tikang ha langit.’”

en: Jesus therefore said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, It was not Moses that gave you the bread out of heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread out of heaven.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: diri tikang ha langit nga pagkaon an iginhatag ni Moises ha iyo; an akon Amay an nahatag ha iyo han tinuod nga pagkaon nga tikang ha langit.

en: For the bread of God is that which cometh down out of heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
war: Kay an pagkaon nga ihinahatag han Dyos amo hiya nga linmusad tikang ha langit, ngan nahatag hin kinabuhi ha kalibutan.”

en: They said therefore unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
war: Ngan naghangyo hira ha iya, “Dayuday tagi kami hini nga pagkaon.”

en: Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall not hunger, and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
war: Nagsumat hi Jesus ha ira, “Ako amo an pagkaon nga nahatag han kinabuhi. An napakadi ha akon diri na gud gugutomon; ngan an nasarig ha akon diri na gud uuhawon.

en: But I said unto you, that ye have seen me, and yet believe not.
war: Ginsiring ko na kamo nga bisan kon hinkit-an ako niyo, diri la gihapon kamo natoo ha akon.

en: All that which the Father giveth me shall come unto me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
war: Napakadi ha akon an bisan hin-o nga itinutubyan ha akon han Amay. Diri ko gud isasalikway an bisan hin-o nga mapakadi ha akon,

en: For I am come down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
war: kay linmusad ako tikang ha langit diri pagtuman han akon kalugaringon nga kaburot-on, kundi han kaburot-on han nagsugo ha akon.

en: And this is the will of him that sent me, that of all that which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up at the last day.
war: Karuyag han nagpadara ha akon nga buhaton ko ini: nga waray mawara hin bisan usa han ngatanan nga iya igintubyan ha akon, kundi nga banhawon ko hira ngatanan ha kataposan nga adlaw.

en: For this is the will of my Father, that every one that beholdeth the Son, and believeth on him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
war: Kay amo ini an karuyag han akon Amay: nga makaangkon han dayon nga kinabuhi an ngatanan nga nakilala han Anak ngan natoo ha iya; ngan babanhawon ko hira ha kataposan nga adlaw.”

en: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, I am the bread which came down out of heaven.
war: Nagtikang pagnginurutob kontra kan Jesus an mga Judiyo, kay nagsiring man hiya, “Ako an pagkaon nga linmusad tikang ha langit.”

en: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how doth he now say, I am come down out of heaven?
war: Sanglit nagsiring hira, “Diri ba ini hi Jesus nga anak ni Jose? Nakilala kita han iya mga kag-anak; kay ano nga nasiring man hiya yana nga linmusad hiya tikang ha langit?”

en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ayaw kamo pagnginurutob.

en: No man can come to me, except the Father that sent me draw him: and I will raise him up in the last day.
war: Waray makakakadi ha akon labot kon kabigon hiya ngadi ha akon han Amay nga nagsugo ha akon; ngan babanhawon ko hiya ha kataposan nga adlaw.

en: It is written in the prophets, And they shall all be taught of God. Every one that hath heard from the Father, and hath learned, cometh unto me.
war: Nagsurat an mga manaragna, ‘Tututdoan han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga tawo.’ An ngatanan nga namamati han Amay ngan nahibabaro tikang ha iya napakadi ha akon.

en: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he that is from God, he hath seen the Father.
war: Diri karuyag sidngon hini nga may-ada na nakakita han Amay; hiya la nga tikang han Dyos an nakakita han Amay.

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth hath eternal life.
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod; may-ada na dayon nga kinabuhi adton natoo.

en: I am the bread of life.
war: Amo ako an pagkaon nga nahatag han kinabuhi.

en: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
war: Nangaon han mana didto ha kamingawan an iyo mga ginikanan, kundi nagkamatay hira.

en: This is the bread which cometh down out of heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
war: Kundi diri na mamamatay an nakaon han pagkaon nga tikang ha langit.

en: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: yea and the bread which I will give is my flesh, for the life of the world.
war: Amo ako an pagkaon nga nahatag han kinabuhi nga tikang ha langit. Mabubuhi ha kadayonan an kumaon hini. Ngan an pagkaon nga ihahatag ko ha iya amo an akon unod, nga ihinahatag ko basi mabuhi an kalibutan.”

en: The Jews therefore strove one with another, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
war: Amo ini an nakatikang hin mapaso nga lantugi han mga Judiyo. Nagpakiana hira, “Uunanhon hini nga tawo pakahatag ha aton han iya unod basi kaonon ta?”

en: Jesus therefore said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man and drink his blood, ye have not life in yourselves.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: mawawaray kamo kinabuhi ha iyo ngahaw kon diri kamo kumaon han unod han Anak han Tawo ngan uminom han iya dugo.

en: He that eateth my flesh and drinketh my blood hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
war: May-ada dayon nga kinabuhi an makaon han akon unod ngan mainom han akon dugo, ngan babanhawon ko hiya ha kataposan nga adlaw.

en: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
war: Kay tinuod gud nga pagkaon an akon unod, ngan tinuod gud nga irimnon an akon dugo.

en: He that eateth my flesh and drinketh my blood abideth in me, and I in him.
war: An nakaon han akon unod ngan nainom han akon dugo aadi ha akon ngan aada ako ha iya.

en: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he that eateth me, he also shall live because of me.
war: Ginsugo ako han buhi nga Amay, ngan tungod ha iya buhi liwat ako. Ha amo man nga paagi, buhi liwat tungod ha akon an nakaon ha akon.

en: This is the bread which came down out of heaven: not as the fathers ate, and died; he that eateth this bread shall live for ever.
war: Sanglit amo ini an pagkaon nga linmusad tikang ha langit; diri ini sugad han pagkaon nga ginkaon han iyo mga ginikanan ngan katapos, nagkamatay hira. Mabubuhi ha kadayonan an nakaon hini nga tinapay.”

en: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
war: Ginsiring ini ni Jesus samtang nagtutdo hiya didto han sinagoga ha Capernaum.

en: Many therefore of his disciples, when they heard this , said, This is a hard saying; who can hear it?
war: Nakabati hini in damo han iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Makuri hin duro matugkad ini nga pagturon-an. Hin-o in makakasantop hini?”

en: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said unto them, Doth this cause you to stumble?
war: Bisan kon waray nagsumat, nahibaroan ni Jesus nga nagnginginurutob an iya mga tinun-an mahitungod hini: sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nakapaluya ba ini han iyo pagtoo ha akon?

en: What then if ye should behold the Son of man ascending where he was before?
war: Niyan, ano daw la kon mahibalik an iyo pagtoo kon kumita na kamo han Anak han Tawo nga masaka ngadto han dapit nga iya anay inokyan?

en: It is the spirit that giveth life; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I have spoken unto you are spirit, and are life.
war: An Espiritu han Dyos an nahatag hin kinabuhi; diri gud ito mahihimo hin gahom nga lawasnon. Espiritu ngan kinabuhi an iginhimangraw ko ha iyo nga mga pulong.

en: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who it was that should betray him.
war: Kundi may pira ha iyo nga diri natoo ha akon.” (Tikang pa ha tinikangan, maaram na nga daan hi Jesus kon hin-o an diri natoo, ngan kon hin-o an maglilingo ha iya.)

en: And he said, For this cause have I said unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it be given unto him of the Father.
war: Ngan nagsiring pa hiya, “Amo gud ini an hinungdan nga nagsiring ako ha iyo, nga waray gud makakadaop ha akon labot kon itugot han Amay nga mahimo ito niya.”

en: Upon this many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
war: Tungod hini, binmulag in damo han iya mga tinun-an ngan waray na bumunyog ha iya.

en: Jesus said therefore unto the twelve, Would ye also go away?
war: Sanglit nagpakiana hi Jesus han dose nga mga tinun-an, “Ngan kamo karuyag ba liwat niyo hin pagbaya ha akon?”

en: Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
war: Binmaton ha iya hi Simon Pedro, “Ngain pa man kami kakadto, Ginoo? Ikaw an may mga pulong nga nahatag han dayon nga kinabuhi.

en: And we have believed and know that thou art the Holy One of God.
war: Ngan yana natoo ngan maaram kami nga amo ka an Baraan nga tikang sa Dyos.”

en: Jesus answered them, Did not I choose you the twelve, and one of you is a devil?
war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Diri ba dose kamo nga akon ginpili? Kundi yawa an usa ha iyo!”

en: Now he spake of Judas the son of Simon Iscariot, for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
war: Naghinabi hiya mahitungod kan Judas, an anak ni Simon Iscariote, kay amo hiya an maglilingo kan Jesus, bisan kon usa hiya han dose nga mga tinun-an.

en: And after these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Judæa, because the Jews sought to kill him.
war: Katapos hini, nagsudoy hi Jesus ha Galilea. Waray hiya maruyag pagsudoy ha Judea, kay gin-iiparatay hiya didto han mga punoan nga Judiyo.

en: Now the feast of the Jews, the feast of tabernacles, was at hand.
war: Hirani na an kanan Judiyo Pyesta han mga Tabernakulo,

en: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that thy disciples also may behold thy works which thou doest.
war: sanglit nagsiring kan Jesus an iya kabugtoan, “Bayai ini nga dapit ngan pakadto ha Judea, basi hikit-an han imo mga tinun-an an imo mga ginbubuhat.

en: For no man doeth anything in secret, and himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou doest these things, manifest thyself to the world.
war: Kon karuyag hin tawo nga kilal-on hiya hin maupay, ipapadayag niya an iya ginbubuhat. Tungod nga nagbubuhat ka man hini nga mga butang, pagpakilala ha bug-os nga kalibutan!” (

en: For even his brethren did not believe on him.
war: Waray pagtoo ha iya bisan ngani an iya kabugtoan.)

en: Jesus therefore saith unto them, My time is not yet come; but your time is always ready.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Waray pa umabot an akon igo nga panahon, kundi pirme igo ha iyo an ngatanan nga panahon.

en: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that its works are evil.
war: Diri makakagdumot an kalibutan ha iyo, kundi nagdudumot ito ha akon, kay waray hunong an akon pagpamatuod nga maraot an iya mga paagi.

en: Go ye up unto the feast: I go not up unto this feast; because my time is not yet fulfilled.
war: Kamo na la in pasingadto ha pyesta; diri ako makadto hini nga pyesta; kay waray pa umabot an akon igo nga panahon.”

en: And having said these things unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
war: Iginyakan ini niya ha ira, ngan nagpabilin hiya ha Galilea.

en: But when his brethren were gone up unto the feast, then went he also up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
war: Pinmaorhe hi Jesus han iya kabugtoan hin pagkadto ha pyesta; waray hiya magpadayag, kundi hilit la an iya pagkadto.

en: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
war: Nagpinamiling ha iya an mga Judiyo didto han pyesta ngan nagpinakiana hira kon hain hiya.

en: And there was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him: some said, He is a good man; others said, Not so, but he leadeth the multitude astray.
war: May hin huringhuring han mga tawo mahitungod ha iya. May nagsiring, “Maupay hiya nga tawo.” Nagsiring an iba, “Diri, ginlilipatlipat la niya an mga tawo.”

en: Yet no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
war: Kundi tungod han ira kahadlok han mga punoan nga Judiyo, waray tawo nga ginmahom hin paghimangraw mahitungod ha iya.

en: But when it was now the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
war: Han nagkakatunga na an ira pagsaurog han pyesta, pinmakadto hi Jesus ha Templo ngan nagtutdo.

en: The Jews therefore marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
war: Nanhipausa an mga Judiyo ngan nagsiring, “Gin-unan-o hini nga tawo pakaangkon hin dako nga kinaadman, nga waray man ngani hiya makasulod hin eskwilahan?”

en: Jesus therefore answered them, and said, My teaching is not mine, but his that sent me.
war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Diri akon pagturon-an an igintututdo ko, kundi tikang sa Dyos nga nagsugo ha akon.

en: If any man willeth to do his will, he shall know of the teaching, whether it is of God, or whether I speak from myself.
war: Adton karuyag magtuman han ipinapagtuman han Dyos, mahibabaro kon an akon igintututdo tikang ba sa Dyos o tikang ba ha akon la kalugaringon nga pagburot-an.

en: He that speaketh from himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh the glory of him that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
war: An tawo nga naghihimangraw ha iya kalugaringon nga pagburot-an asay la gintitinguha an iya kadungganan. Kundi an nagtitinguha hin pagpasidungog han nagsugo ha iya, tangkod nga tawo, ngan waray gud ikakasiring nga buwa ha iya.

en: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you doeth the law? Why seek ye to kill me?
war: Waray ba ighatag ha iyo ni Moises an Balaod? Kundi waray usa ha iyo nga nagtutuman han Balaod. Kay ano nga gin-iiparatay man ako niyo?”

en: The multitude answered, Thou hast a demon: who seeketh to kill thee?
war: Nagbaton an mga tawo, “May-ada ka gud yawa! Hin-o ngani an nag-iiparatay ha imo?”

en: Jesus answered and said unto them, I did one work, and ye all marvel because thereof.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Usa pa la nga milagro an akon ginbuhat, ngan nahipausa na kamo ngatanan.

en: Moses hath given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers); and on the sabbath ye circumcise a man.
war: Tungod nga nagsugo hi Moises nga turion an iyo mga anak nga lalake (bisan diri hi Moises kundi an iyo mga ginikanan an nagtikang hito), nagtuturi kamo hin bata ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: If a man receiveth circumcision on the sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken; are ye wroth with me, because I made a man every whit whole on the sabbath?
war: Kon nagtuturi kamo ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway basi matuman an balaod ni Moises, kay ano nga nangangahalas kamo ha akon tungod nga gintambal ko in usa nga tawo ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway?

en: Judge not according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
war: Paghukom kamo sumala han tinuod nga lagda; ayaw na paghukom dara la han iyo hinkit-an.”

en: Some therefore of them of Jerusalem said, Is not this he whom they seek to kill?
war: Nagsiring in pira nga mga tawo ha Jerusalem, “Diri ba ini an tawo nga gin-iiparatay nira?

en: And lo, he speaketh openly, and they say nothing unto him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is the Christ?
war: Kitaa, nagyiyinakan hiya ha kadaygan, ngan waray na lugod nagyayakan hin pagriwa ha iya! Tungod ba ito nga maaram na gud an mga punoan nga amo na hiya an Mesiyas?

en: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when the Christ cometh, no one knoweth whence he is.
war: Kundi kon umabot na an Mesiyas, waray mahibabaro kon diin hiya tikang. Kundi maaram kita ngatanan kon diin tikang ini nga tawo.”

en: Jesus therefore cried in the temple, teaching and saying, Ye both know me, and know whence I am; and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
war: Han nagtututdo hi Jesus ha Templo, nagsiring hiya ha dako nga tingog, “Tinuod ba nga nakilala kamo ha akon, ngan maaram kon diin ako tikang? Kundi waray ako kumanhi ha akon la pagbuot. An may katungod hin pagsugo amo an nagsugo ha akon, kundi diri kamo nakilala ha iya.

en: I know him; because I am from him, and he sent me.
war: Nakilala ako ha iya, kay tikang ako ha iya, ngan hiya an nagsugo ha akon.”

en: They sought therefore to take him: and no man laid his hand on him, because his hour was not yet come.
war: Ngan gin-idarakop hiya nira, kundi waray naglabot ha iya, kay waray pa man umabot an iya takna.

en: But of the multitude many believed on him; and they said, When the Christ shall come, will he do more signs than those which this man hath done?
war: Kundi tinmoo ha iya in damo nga mga tawo, ngan nagsiring, “Kon umabot an Mesiyas, magbubuhat ba hiya hin labaw pa nga mga milagro kay han nabuhat hini nga tawo?”

en: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him; and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to take him.
war: Nakabati an mga Parisiyo han larolantugi han mga tawo hini nga mga butang mahitungod ha iya, sanglit nagsugo hin mga gwardya pagdakop kan Jesus an mga Parisiyo ngan an labaw nga kapadian.

en: Jesus therefore said, Yet a little while am I with you, and I go unto him that sent me.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Madaliay na la an akon pakig-urosa ha iyo, ngan mabalik na ako ngadto han nagsugo ha akon.

en: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, ye cannot come.
war: Mamimiling kamo ha akon, kundi diri kamo makakaagi ha akon; kay diri kamo makakakadto han akon kakadtoan.”

en: The Jews therefore said among themselves, Whither will this man go that we shall not find him? will he go unto the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
war: May hinsiring an mga punoan nga Judiyo, “Ngain daw la hiya kakadto nga diri naton hiya hiaagian? Makadto ba hiya ha syudad han mga Griego diin nag-uokoy an mga Judiyo, ngan magtutdo hiya han mga Griego?

en: What is this word that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me; and where I am, ye cannot come?
war: Ano ba an karuyag niya sidngon han iya pagsiring, ‘Mamimiling kamo ha akon, kundi diri kamo makakaagi ha akon?’ ngan ‘Diri kamo makakakadto han akon kakadtoan?’”

en: Now on the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me and drink.
war: An kataposan nga adlaw han pyesta amo an gidadakoi nga adlaw. Hito nga adlaw tinmindog hi Jesus ngan nagsiring hin dako nga tingog, “Kinahanglan kumadi ha akon ngan uminom an bisan hin-o nga inuuhaw.

en: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, from within him shall flow rivers of living water.
war: Sumala han siring han kasuratan, ‘Tikang ha kasingkasing hadton natoo ha akon maawas in tubig nga nahatag hin kinabuhi.’”

en: But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believed on him were to receive: for the Spirit was not yet given ; because Jesus was not yet glorified.
war: Iginsiring ini ni Jesus mahitungod han Espiritu nga kakarawaton hadton mga natoo ha iya. Hadto nga takna waray pa ihatag an Espiritu, kay waray pa man mamatay ngan mabanhaw hi Jesus.

en: Some of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, This is of a truth the prophet.
war: Han pakabati han damo nga mga tawo hini nga siring ni Jesus, nabuhag hira. May-ada nasiring, “Amo na gud ini an Manaragna!”

en: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, What, doth the Christ come out of Galilee?
war: Nagsiring liwat an iba, “Amo na hiya an Mesiyas!”

en: Hath not the scripture said that the Christ cometh of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?
war: Kundi nagsiring pa an iba, “Diri matikang ha Galilea an Mesiyas!

en: So there arose a division in the multitude because of him.
war: Nasiring an kasuratan nga magigin tulin ni David an Mesiyas, ngan matatawo ha Betlehem, an bungto nga gin-ukyan ni David.”

en: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
war: Sanglit tungod ha iya nagkabuhag an mga tawo.

en: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why did ye not bring him?
war: Karuyag magdakop kan Jesus an pira ha ira, kundi waray gud nagpasipara hin pagkapot ha iya.

en: The officers answered, Never man so spake.
war: Binmalik an mga gwardya ngadto han mga Parisiyo ngan mga puno han kapadian nga nagpakiana ha ira, “Kay ano nga waray man niyo dad-a hiya?”

en: The Pharisees therefore answered them, Are ye also led astray?
war: Nagbaton an mga gwardya, “Waray pa gud tawo nga naghimangraw hin sugad nga pagyakan hini nga tawo!”

en: Hath any of the rulers believed on him, or of the Pharisees?
war: Nagpakiana an mga Parisiyo, “Nalimbongan ba liwat kamo niya?

en: But this multitude that knoweth not the law are accursed.
war: May-ada na ba niyo hinbaroan nga usa han mga punoan o usa nga Parisiyo nga tinmoo ha iya?

en: Nicodemus saith unto them (he that came to him before, being one of them),
war: Diri nasabot ini nga mga tawo han Balaod ni Moises, sanglit ginpanhimaraot hira han Dyos!”

en: Doth our law judge a man, except it first hear from himself and know what he doeth?
war: Usa han mga Parisiyo amo hi Nicodemo nga nakigkita hadto kan Jesus. Nagsiring hiya ha ira,

en: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and see that out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
war: “Sumala han aton Balaod, diri kita makakaghukom hin tawo kon diri anay naton hibatian hiya ngan hikit-an kon ano an iya nabuhat.”

en: [And they went every man unto his own house:
war: Binmaton hira, “Aw ngay-an! Taga-Galilea ka ba liwat? Usisaha an Kasuratan ngan hibabaroan mo nga waray manaragna nga natikang ha Galilea.”

en: but Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
war: [Ngan nanguli an ngatanan, kundi napakadto hi Jesus ha Bukid han mga Olibo.

en: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
war: Han pagkabuwas han temprano pa, binmalik hiya ha templo. Ginalirongan hiya han mga tawo, ngan linmingkod hiya ngan nagtikang hin pagtutdo ha ira.

en: And the scribes and the Pharisees bring a woman taken in adultery; and having set her in the midst,
war: Gindara han mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan mga Parisiyo in usa nga babaye nga hindakpan nga nanlibog, ngan ginpatindog hiya ha atubangan nira ngatanan.

en: they say unto him, Teacher, this woman hath been taken in adultery, in the very act.
war: Nagsiring hira kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, hindakpan ini nga babaye nga nanlibog.

en: Now in the law Moses commanded us to stone such: what then sayest thou of her?
war: Ha aton Balaod, iginsugo ni Moises nga kinahanglan batoon tubtob han kamatay in sugad nga babaye. Yana, ano man an imo isisiring?”

en: And this they said, trying him, that they might have whereof to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
war: Iginsiring nira ini hin pagbitik ha iya, basi mahisumbong nira hi Jesus. Kundi tinmamod hi Jesus ngan nagsurat ha tuna pinaagi han iya tudlo.

en: But when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
war: Samtang nagpipinakiana hira, tinmukdaw hi Jesus ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Umona hin pagbato ha iya an waray sala ha iyo.”

en: And again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
war: Ngan tinmamod na liwat hiya ngan nagsurat ha tuna.

en: And they, when they heard it, went out one by one, beginning from the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman, where she was, in the midst.
war: Han pakabati nira hini, nagpatag-usa hira hin pagbaya, tikang han mga magurang. Nahibilin na la hi Jesus, ngan an babaye nga nakada pa harani ha iya.

en: And Jesus lifted up himself, and said unto her, Woman, where are they? did no man condemn thee?
war: Hinmangad hi Jesus ngan nagpakiana ha iya, “Hain naman hira, Mana? Waray ba nahibilin hin pagsirot ha imo?”

en: And she said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said, Neither do I condemn thee: go thy way; from henceforth sin no more.]
war: “Waray, bisan usa,” nagbaton an babaye.

en: Again therefore Jesus spake unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in the darkness, but shall have the light of life.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Diri liwat ako magsisirot ha imo. Hala, kadto na, kundi ayaw na pagpinakasala.”]

en: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest witness of thyself; thy witness is not true.
war: Naghimangraw na liwat hi Jesus ha ira, “Ako an kapawa han kalibutan. Magkakamay-ada kapawa han kinabuhi an bisan hin-o nga magsunod ha akon, ngan diri na gud hiya maglalakat ha kasisidman.”

en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Even if I bear witness of myself, my witness is true; for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye know not whence I come, or whither I go.
war: Nagsiring ha iya an mga Parisiyo, “Nagpapamatuod ka yana ha imo la ngahaw; diri kamatuoran an imo iginsisiring.”

en: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Bisan kon nagpapamatuod ako ha akon la ngahaw, matuod an akon iginsisiring, kay maaram ako kon diin ako tikang ngan kon tikain ako. Diri kamo maaram kon diin ako tikang, o kon tikain ako.

en: Yea and if I judge, my judgment is true; for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
war: Naghuhukom kamo hin tinawo gudla nga paagi; diri ako naghuhukom bisan kan kanay.

en: Yea and in your law it is written, that the witness of two men is true.
war: Kundi kon maghukom man lugaring ako, matuod an akon paghukom, kay diri man ako la an maghuhukom; kaupod ko an Amay nga nagsugo ha akon.

en: I am he that beareth witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
war: Nahisurat ha iyo Balaod nga kon nagkakauyon in duha nga mga saksi, matuod an ira iginsisiring.

en: They said therefore unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye know neither me, nor my Father: if ye knew me, ye would know my Father also.
war: Nagpapamatuod ako mahitungod ha akon, ngan nagpapamatuod man mahitungod ha akon an Amay nga nagsugo ha akon.”

en: These words spake he in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man took him; because his hour was not yet come.
war: Nagpakiana hira, “Hain man an Amay nimo?”

en: He said therefore again unto them, I go away, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sin: whither I go, ye cannot come.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri kamo nakilala ha akon ngan han akon Amay. Kon nakakilala pa kamo ha akon, makilala man liwat kamo han akon Amay.”

en: The Jews therefore said, Will he kill himself, that he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come?
war: Ginsiring ni Jesus ini ngatanan samtang magtututdo hiya ha Templo, ha kwarto nga burutangan han mga surudlan han halad. Ngan waray nagdakop ha iya, kay waray pa man umabot an iya takna.

en: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
war: Nagsiring liwat hi Jesus ha ira, “Malakat ako, ngan pagbibilngon ako niyo, kundi magkakamatay kamo dida han iyo mga sala. Diri kamo makakakadto han akon kakadtoan.”

en: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for except ye believe that I am he , ye shall die in your sins.
war: Sanglit nagsiring an mga punoan nga Judiyo, “Nasiring hiya nga diri kita makakakadto han iya kakadtoan. Karuyag ba sidngon hini nga mag-uunay hiya?”

en: They said therefore unto him, Who art thou? Jesus said unto them, Even that which I have also spoken unto you from the beginning.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Tikang kamo dinhe ha tuna, kundi tikang ako ha langit. Tikang kamo hini nga kalibutan, kundi diri ako tikang hini nga kalibutan.

en: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you: howbeit he that sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these speak I unto the world.
war: Sanglit nagsumat ako ha iyo nga mamamatay kamo dida han iyo mga sala. Ngan magkakamatay kamo dida han iyo mga sala kon diri kamo tumoo nga ‘Ako Amo hi Ako’.”

en: They perceived not that he spake to them of the Father.
war: “Kay hin-o ka man ngay-an?” nagpakiana hira ha iya.

en: Jesus therefore said, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he , and that I do nothing of myself, but as the Father taught me, I speak these things.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Ada, amo ako an iginsumat ko na ha iyo tikang pa hadto.

en: And he that sent me is with me; he hath not left me alone; for I do always the things that are pleasing to him.
war: Damo pa unta an akon igsisiring ngan ighuhukom mahitungod ha iyo. Kundi an nagpadara ha akon diri buwaon, ngan iginsusumat ko la ha kalibutan an hinbatian ko tikang ha iya.”

en: As he spake these things, many believed on him.
war: Waray hira sabot nga naghihimangraw hiya ha ira mahitungod han Amay.

en: Jesus therefore said to those Jews that had believed him, If ye abide in my word, then are ye truly my disciples;
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Kon isahon na niyo an Anak han Tawo, hibabaroan niyo nga ‘Ako Amo Hi Ako’; ngan hibabaroan niyo nga diri ako nagbubuhat ha akon la kalugaringon, kundi nagyayakan la ako han igintutdo ha akon han Amay.

en: and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
war: Ngan kaupod ko an nagsugo ha akon; waray ako niya pagpabay-i nga mag-usaan, kay dayuday ko binubuhat an nakakalipay ha iya.”

en: They answered unto him, We are Abraham’s seed, and have never yet been in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
war: Tinmoo kan Jesus in damo han mga nagpakabati hini nga mga iginsiring niya.

en: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Every one that committeth sin is the bondservant of sin.
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus ngadto han mga Judiyo nga tinmoo ha iya, “Kamo an tinuod ko nga mga tinun-an, kon tumanon niyo an akon igintutdo,

en: And the bondservant abideth not in the house for ever: the son abideth for ever.
war: ngan hibabaroan niyo an kamatuoran, ngan an kamatuoran an magtatalwas ha iyo.”

en: If therefore the Son shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
war: Nagbaton hira, “Mga tulin kami ni Abraham, ngan waray pa gud kami maoripon hin bisan hin-o, sanglit ano an karuyag mo sidngon han imo pagsiring, ‘Matatalwas kamo’?”

en: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; yet ye seek to kill me, because my word hath not free course in you.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: oripon han sala an ngatanan nga nakakasala.

en: I speak the things which I have seen with my Father: and ye also do the things which ye heard from your father.
war: Diri dayuday sakop han panimalay an oripon, kundi sakop ha kadayonan an anak.

en: They answered and said unto him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
war: Sanglit matatalwas gud kamo hin tinuod kon an Anak an magtalwas ha iyo.

en: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I heard from God: this did not Abraham.
war: Maaram ako nga mga tulin kamo ni Abraham, kundi gin-iiparatay ako niyo, kay diri man kamo nakarawat han akon pagturon-an.

en: Ye do the works of your father. They said unto him, We were not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
war: Naghihimangraw ako mahitungod han iginpakita ha akon han akon Amay, kundi binubuhat niyo an iginsumat ha iyo han iyo amay.”

en: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I came forth and am come from God; for neither have I come of myself, but he sent me.
war: Nagbaton hira ha iya, “Hi Abraham an amon amay.”

en: Why do ye not understand my speech? Even because ye cannot hear my word.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon tinuod nga mga anak kamo ni Abraham, bubuhaton unta niyo an mga buruhaton nga ginbuhat niya.

en: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father it is your will to do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and standeth not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father thereof.
war: An akon nabuhat amo la an pagsumat ha iyo han kamatuoran nga akon hinbatian tikang han Dyos, kundi gin-iiparatay ako niyo. Waray magbuhat hi Abraham hin sugad hini!

en: But because I say the truth, ye believe me not.
war: Ginbubuhat niyo an ginbuhat han amay niyo.”

en: Which of you convicteth me of sin? If I say truth, why do ye not believe me?
war: Nagbaton hira, “An Dyos la an amon Amay; kami an tinuod nga iya mga anak.”

en: He that is of God heareth the words of God: for this cause ye hear them not, because ye are not of God.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Kon matuod nga an Dyos an Amay niyo, mahigugma unta kamo ha akon, kay tinmikang ako sa Dyos ngan yana aanhi ako. Waray ako kumanhi ha akon la kalugaringon nga pagbuot, kundi ginsugo ako niya.

en: The Jews answered and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a demon?
war: Kay ano nga diri kamo nasabot han akon iginyayakan? Tungod kay diri kamo nailob hin pamati han akon mga mensahe.

en: Jesus answered, I have not a demon; but I honor my Father, and ye dishonor me.
war: Mga anak kamo han amay niyo, an Yawa, ngan naruruyag kamo pagsunod han ungara han amay niyo. Parapamatay hiya tikang pa ha tinikangan. Waray hiya dumapig han kamatuoran, kay waray man kamatuoran dida ha iya. Kon nagbubuwa hiya, nagbuhat la hiya sugad han iya kinaiya, kay buwaon man hiya, ngan amo hiya an amay han ngatanan nga buwa.

en: But I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
war: Nagsusumat ako han kamatuoran, sanglit diri kamo natuod ha akon.

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my word, he shall never see death.
war: Hin-o ha iyo in makakapamatuod nga salaan ako? Kon nagsusumat ako han kamatuoran, kay ano man nga diri kamo natuod ha akon?

en: The Jews said unto him, Now we know that thou hast a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my word, he shall never taste of death.
war: Namamati han mga pulong han Dyos an tawo nga tikang ha Dyos. Kundi diri kamo tikang ha Dyos, sanglit diri kamo namamati ha akon.”

en: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, who died? and the prophets died: whom makest thou thyself?
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo kan Jesus, “Diri ba tama an amon pagsiring nga Samaritano ka ngan sinasangkayan ka hin yawa?”

en: Jesus answered, If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing: it is my Father that glorifieth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God;
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri gad ako sinasangkayan hin yawa. Ginpapasidunggan ko la an akon Amay, kundi ginpapakaalohan ako niyo.

en: and ye have not known him: but I know him; and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be like unto you, a liar: but I know him, and keep his word.
war: Diri ako nagtitingoha hin dungog ha akon kalugaringon. May-ada hito nagtitinguha ngan naghuhukom ugop ha akon.

en: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day; and he saw it, and was glad.
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: diri na mapatay an bisan hin-o nga magtuman han akon pulong.”

en: The Jews therefore said unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
war: Nagsiring ha iya an mga Judiyo, “Yana hinsabtan na namon nga sinasangkayan ka hin yawa! Namatay ngani hi Abraham ngan an mga manaragna, kundi nasiring ka, ‘Diri na mapatay an bisan hin-o nga magtuman han akon pulong.’

en: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was born, I am.
war: Labaw ka pa ba kan Abraham nga amon amay? Namatay ngani hiya sugad man an mga manaragna, baga hin-o ka gud, ha imo paghunahuna?”

en: They took up stones therefore to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kon pasidunggan ko an akon kalugaringon, waray hinungdan an akon dungog. Nagpapasidungog ha akon an akon Amay—an ginsisiring niyo nga iyo Dyos.

en: And as he passed by, he saw a man blind from his birth.
war: Han naglalakat hi Jesus, nakakita hiya hin tawo nga daan buta tikang han iya katawo.

en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Rabbi, who sinned, this man, or his parents, that he should be born blind?
war: Nagpakiana ha iya an iya mga tinun-an, “Magturutdo, kanay man sala nga natawo hiya nga daan buta? Iya ba kalugaringon o kanan iya mga kag-anak?”

en: Jesus answered, Neither did this man sin, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Waray labot han iya pagkabuta an iya mga sala o an mga sala han iya mga kag-anak. Natawo hiya nga daan buta basi hikit-an an gahom han Dyos dida ha iya.

en: We must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
war: Kinahanglan tumanon ta an mga buruhaton han nagsugo ha akon, samtang nga adlaw pa; maabot an gab-i ngan waray na makakagtrabaho.

en: When I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
war: Ako an kapawa han kalibutan samtang aanhi pa ako ha kalibutan.”

en: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and anointed his eyes with the clay,
war: Katapos niya pagsiring hini, linmura hi Jesus ha tuna, naghimo hin lapok pinaagi han iya laway, ngan gindihogan niya an mga mata han buta,

en: and said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam (which is by interpretation, Sent). He went away therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
war: ngan iya sidngon, “Kadto na, ngan paghiram-os didto ha linaw han Siloe.” (“Ginsugo” an kahulogan hini nga ngaran.) Sanglit kinmadto an tawo, naghiram-os hiya, ngan binmalik nga nakita na.

en: The neighbors therefore, and they that saw him aforetime, that he was a beggar, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
war: Sanglit nagpakiana an iya mga amyaw ngan an mga tawo nga nakakita ha iya hadto, nga nakikilimos, “Diri ba amo ini an tawo nga hadto nalingkod didto ngan agsob makilimos?”

en: Others said, It is he: others said, No, but he is like him. He said, I am he .
war: May nagsiring, “Amo ini hiya,” kundi nagsiring an iba, “Diri hiya amo, kundi alid-agid la ha iya.”

en: They said therefore unto him, How then were thine eyes opened?
war: Sanglit nagsiring an tawo ngahaw, “Amo ako an tawo.”

en: He answered, The man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to Siloam, and wash: so I went away and washed, and I received sight.
war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Naunan-o man nga nakita ka na?”

en: And they said unto him, Where is he? He saith, I know not.
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Naghimo hin lapok an tawo nga Jesus an ngaran, ngan igindihog niya ha akon mata. Ngan ginpakadto ako niya ha Siloe hin paghiram-os. Sanglit napakadto ako, ngan han pakahiram-os ko la, nakakita ako.”

en: They bring to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
war: “Hain naman hiya?” nagpakiana hira.

en: Now it was the sabbath on the day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
war: “Ambot,” nagbaton hiya.

en: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. And he said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and I see.
war: Ngan gindara nira ngadto han mga Parisiyo an tawo nga hadto anay buta.

en: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, This man is not from God, because he keepeth not the sabbath. But others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such signs? And there was a division among them.
war: Adlaw adto nga Iparahuway han paghimo ni Jesus hin lapok ngan pagtambal niya han kanan tawo mga mata.

en: They say therefore unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, in that he opened thine eyes? And he said, He is a prophet.
war: Sanglit ginpakianhan liwat han mga Parisiyo an tawo kon naunan-o hin pakakita niya. Nagsumat hiya ha ira, “Gindihugan niya hin lapok an akon mga mata, naghiram-os ako, ngan yana nakita na ako.”

en: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight,
war: Nagsiring an pira han mga Parisiyo, “Diri mahihimo nga tikang sa Dyos an tawo nga nagbuhat hini, kay diri niya gintutuman an Balaod han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: and asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Uunanhon hin tawo nga makasasala pakahimo hin mga orosahon nga sugad hini?” Ngan nagkabahinbahin hira.

en: His parents answered and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
war: Sanglit ginpakianhan na liwat hiya han mga Parisiyo, “Nasiring ka man nga hiya an nagtambal han imo mga mata—niyan, ano man an imo isisiring mahitungod ha iya?”

en: but how he now seeth, we know not; or who opened his eyes, we know not: ask him; he is of age; he shall speak for himself.
war: “Manaragna hiya,” nagbaton hiya.

en: These things said his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man should confess him to be Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
war: Kundi diri karuyag tumuod an mga punoan nga Judiyo nga buta hiya anay ngan yana nakita na. Sanglit gintawag nira an iya mga kag-anak,

en: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
war: ngan ginpakianhan nira, “Iyo ba ini anak? Nasiring kamo nga natawo hiya nga daan buta, niyan ano man in kasugad nga nakita na man hiya yana?”

en: So they called a second time the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give glory to God: we know that this man is a sinner.
war: Nagbaton an iya mga kag-anak, “Maaram kami nga amon hiya anak, ngan natawo hiya nga daan buta.

en: He therefore answered, Whether he is a sinner, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
war: Kundi diri kami maaram kon naunan-o nga nakita na man hiya yana, ngan diri kami maaram kon hin-o an nagtambal han iya mata. Hiya na la in pakianhi kay may buot na man hiya, ngan makakabaton na man hiya para han iya kalugaringon!”

en: They said therefore unto him, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
war: Ginyakan ini han mga kag-anak kay nahadlok hira han mga punoan nga Judiyo nga nagkasarabot na nga daan hin pagpagawas ha sinagoga hin bisan hin-o nga magtug-an nga hi Jesus amo an Mesiyas.

en: He answered them, I told you even now, and ye did not hear; wherefore would ye hear it again? would ye also become his disciples?
war: Sanglit nagsiring an iya mga kag-anak, “May buot na man hiya; hiya na la an pakianhi.”

en: And they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are disciples of Moses.
war: Iginpatawag na liwat nira an tawo nga natawo nga daan buta ngan ginsiring, “Pagsaad ha atubangan han Dyos nga magsusumat ka hin kamatuoran! Maaram kami nga makasasala ini nga tawo nga nagtambal.”

en: We know that God hath spoken unto Moses: but as for this man, we know not whence he is.
war: “Diri ako maaram kon makasasala ba hiya o diri,” nagbaton an tawo. “An hinsabtan ko la amo ini: nakita na ako yana, kundi hadto buta ako.”

en: The man answered and said unto them, Why, herein is the marvel, that ye know not whence he is, and yet he opened mine eyes.
war: Nagpakiana hira, “Ano an ginbuhat niya ha imo? Gin-unan-o niya hin pagtambal han imo mga mata?”

en: We know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and do his will, him he heareth.
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo, kundi diri man kamo natuod. Kay ano nga iyo ini gin-uolit-okit? Bangin la naruruyag liwat kamo nga magin tinun-an niya?”

en: Since the world began it was never heard that any one opened the eyes of a man born blind.
war: Ginpakaraot hiya nira ngan ginsiring, “Ikaw an iya tinun-an, kundi mga tinun-an kami ni Moises.

en: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.
war: Maaram kami nga nakighimangraw an Dyos kan Moises; mahitungod hito nga tawo, diri ngani kami maaram kon diin hiya tikang!”

en: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Pagkaorosahon hini! Diri kamo maaram kon diin hiya tikang, kundi ginpakita niya an akon mga mata!

en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and finding him, he said, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
war: Maaram kita nga diri namamati an Dyos han mga makasasala; namamati hiya han mga tawo nga natahod ha iya ngan nagtutuman han karuyag niya ipabuhat ha ira.

en: He answered and said, And who is he, Lord, that I may believe on him?
war: Tikang pa han tinikangan han kalibutan, waray pa gud hinbatian nga may nakatambal han mga mata nga daan buta.

en: Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and he it is that speaketh with thee.
war: Waray gud mahihimo hito nga tawo kon diri hiya tikang ha Dyos.”

en: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
war: Binmaton hira, “Natawo ngan nagtubo ka ha sala—ngan karuyag mo magtutdo ha amon?” Ngan ginpagawas hiya nira ha sinagoga.

en: And Jesus said, For judgment came I into this world, that they that see not may see; and that they that see may become blind.
war: Hinbatian ni Jesus nga ginpagawas nira ha sinagoga an tawo. Hin-agian hiya ni Jesus ngan ginpakianhan, “Natoo ka ba han Anak han Tawo?”

en: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said unto him, Are we also blind?
war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Sumati gad ako kon hin-o hiya, basi makatoo ako ha iya!”

en: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye would have no sin: but now ye say, We see: your sin remaineth.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Hinkit-an mo na hiya, ngan amo hiya nga nakikighimangraw yana ha imo.”

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
war: “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: kawatan ngan tikasan an tawo nga diri naagi ha porta hin pagsulod han turil, kundi nagsasaka hin iba nga agian.

en: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
war: Magmarangno han mga karnero an tawo nga naagi ha porta.

en: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
war: Pinaaagi hiya han magbarantay han portahan; namamati an mga karnero han iya tingog kon gintatawag niya hira hin ira tagsatagsa nga ngaran, ngan pinagagawas niya hira han turil.

en: When he hath put forth all his own, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
war: Paghihigawas na nira, nag-uuna hiya ha ira, ngan nasunod an mga karnero ha iya kay nakilala han iya tingog.

en: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
war: Diri hira masunod hin iba; lugod makalagiw hira, kay diri nira kinikilala an iya tingog.”

en: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
war: Iginsumat ni Jesus ha ira ini nga pananglitan, kundi waray hira makasabot han karuyag sidngon han pananglitan.

en: Jesus therefore said unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
war: Sanglit nagsiring liwat hi Jesus, “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: amo ako an porta para han mga karnero.

en: All that came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
war: Mga kawatan ngan mga tikasan an ngatanan nga kinmanhi una ha akon; kundi waray mamati ha ira an mga karnero.

en: I am the door; by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and go out, and shall find pasture.
war: Amo ako an porta. Matatalwas an bisan hin-o nga masulod pinaaagi ha akon, masulod-guwa hiya ngan makakaagi hin panibsiban.

en: The thief cometh not, but that he may steal, and kill, and destroy: I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
war: Nasulod la an kawatan hin pangawat, panmatay, ngan panmungkag. Kinmanhi ako basi makaangkon hira han kinabuhi, an hura nga kinabuhi.

en: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep.
war: “Amo ako an maupay nga magmarangno han mga karnero. An maupay nga magmarangno andam pag-unong han iya kinabuhi tungod han mga karnero.

en: He that is a hireling, and not a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, beholdeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth, and the wolf snatcheth them, and scattereth them :
war: An sinuholan la, kay diri magmarangno ngan diri tag-iya han mga karnero, nabaya ha ira ngan nakalagiw kon nakita hiya hin lubo; sanglit tinatabag han lubo an mga karnero ngan nagsasarang hira.

en: he fleeth because he is a hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
war: Nakalagiw an sinuholan, kay sinuholan man la hiya ngan diri napaid han mga karnero.

en: I am the good shepherd; and I know mine own, and mine own know me,
war: 14-15 Amo ako an maupay nga magmarangno. Sugad nga nakilala an Amay ha akon ngan nakilala ako han Amay, ha amo man nga paagi, nakilala ako han akon karnero ngan nakilala man hira ha akon. Ngan andam ako hin pag-unong han akon kinabuhi tungod ha ira.

en: even as the Father knoweth me, and I know the Father; and I lay down my life for the sheep.
war: May-ada iba nakon nga mga karnero nga diri sakop hini nga panon. Kinahanglan sakopon ko liwat hira; mamamati hira han akon tingog, ngan mauusa na la hira nga panon ha ubos hin usa nga magmarangno.

en: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and they shall become one flock, one shepherd.
war: “Nahigugma an Amay ha akon kay andam man ako hin paghatag han akon kinabuhi basi mahibalik liwat ini ha akon.

en: Therefore doth the Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
war: Waray makakaagaw han akon kinabuhi; ihinahatag ko ini ha akon kalugaringon nga pagbuot. May-ada ko gahom hin pagtubyan han akon kinabuhi ngan may-ada ko liwat gahom hin pagbawi hini. Amo ini an ipinapagbuhat ha akon han akon Amay.”

en: No one taketh it away from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment received I from my Father.
war: Nagkabahin na liwat an mga Judiyo tungod hini nga mga pulong.

en: There arose a division again among the Jews because of these words.
war: Nagsiring in kadam-an ha ira, “Sinasangkayan hiya hin yawa ngan nakulangan ha hiya hin buot! Kay ano nga namamati pa kamo ha iya?”

en: And many of them said, He hath a demon, and is mad; why hear ye him?
war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Diri makakaghimangraw hin sugad hini in tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa! Uunanhon man hin yawa pagpakita han mga buta?”

en: Others said, These are not the sayings of one possessed with a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?
war: Inmabot an panahon han pagsaurog han Pyesta han Paghalad didto ha Jerusalem ngan panahon adto hin kathagkot,

en: And it was the feast of the dedication at Jerusalem:
war: ngan didto ha Templo naglalakat hi Jesus didto han Balkon ni Solomon.

en: it was winter; and Jesus was walking in the temple in Solomon’s porch.
war: Gin-alirongan hiya han mga Judiyo nga nagsiring, “Tubtob san-o an imo pagpinakulbai ha amon? Sumati kami hin tinuod kon amo ka an Mesiyas.”

en: The Jews therefore came round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou hold us in suspense? If thou art the Christ, tell us plainly.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo, kundi diri man kamo natuod ha akon. Saksi ha akon an gintuman ko nga mga buhat nga sugo han akon Amay;

en: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believe not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, these bear witness of me.
war: kundi diri kamo matuod kay diri man kamo akon mga karnero.

en: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep.
war: Namamati han akon tingog an akon mga karnero; nakilala ako ha ira, ngan nasunod hira ha akon;

en: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
war: Nahatag ako ha ira han dayon nga kinabuhi, ngan diri nagud hira mamamatay; ngan waray makakaagaw ha ira tikang ha akon.

en: and I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, and no one shall snatch them out of my hand.
war: Labaw han ngatanan an akon Amay nga amo an naghatag ha ira ha akon, ngan waray gud makakaagaw ha ira tikang han kamot han Amay.

en: My Father, who hath given them unto me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch them out of the Father’s hand.
war: Mag-usa la an Amay ug ako.”

en: I and the Father are one.
war: Nanmurot na liwat an mga Judiyo hin mga bato paglabay ha iya.

en: The Jews took up stones again to stone him.
war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Damo nga mga mag-upay an akon nabuhat ha iyo atubangan nga sugo han akon Amay; hain man hini nga mga buhat in pinasisikaran niyo hin pagbato ha akon?”

en: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I showed you from the Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “Ginbabato ka namon diri tungod hin ano man nga mag-upay nga mga buhat, kundi tungod han imo pagpasipara han Dyos! Nagpapaka-Dyos ka, nga tawo ka man la!”

en: The Jews answered him, For a good work we stone thee not, but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Di ba nahisurat ha iyo kalugaringon nga Balaod nga nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Mga dyos kamo’?

en: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
war: Maaram kita nga matuod ha kadayonan an iginsisiring han kasuratan, ngan gintawag han Dyos nga mga dyos adton mga tawo nga gintaporan han iya mga pulong.

en: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came (and the scripture cannot be broken),
war: Mahitungod ha akon, ginpili ako han Amay ngan ginsugo nganhi ha kalibutan. Sanglit uunanhon pakasiring niyo nga nagpapasipara ako han Dyos tungod han pagsiring ko nga amo ako an Anak han Dyos?

en: say ye of him, whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
war: Sanglit angay diri kamo tumoo ha akon kon diri ako nagbubuhat han mga buhat han akon Amay.

en: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
war: Kundi kon nagbubuhat man ako, bisan kon diri kamo natoo ha akon, kinahanglan tumoo kamo bisan na man la han akon mga buhat, basi hibaroan ngan masayoran niyo nga aadi ha akon an Amay, ngan aada ako ha iya.”

en: But if I do them, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.
war: Gin-idarakop na liwat hiya nira, kundi nakapudlos hiya tikang ha ira mga kamot.

en: They sought again to take him: and he went forth out of their hand.
war: Binmalik na liwat hi Jesus ngadto ha tabok han Salog han Jordan, ngadto han dapit diin nanmunyag hi Juan, ngan nagpabilin hiya didto.

en: And he went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was at the first baptizing; and there he abode.
war: Pinmakadto ha iya in damo nga mga tawo. Nagsiring hira, “Waray magbuhat hi Juan hin mga orosahon, kundi puros matuod an iginsiring niya mahitungod hini nga tawo.”

en: And many came unto him; and they said, John indeed did no sign: but all things whatsoever John spake of this man were true.
war: Ngan damo nga mga tawo didto in tinmoo kan Jesus.

en: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus of Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
war: May usa nga tawo nga hi Lazaro an ngaran. Nag-ukoy hiya ha Betania upod an iya kabugtoan nga kababayen-an, hira Maria ug Marta. (

en: And it was that Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
war: Amo ini nga Maria an nagbubo hin pahamot ha mga tiil han Ginoo ngan ginpahiran han iya buhok. Nasakit hi Lazaro nga iya bugto.)

en: The sisters therefore sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
