war: Nagpatugon ini nga magbugto nga kababayen-an ngadto kan Jesus nga sidngon hiya, “Ginoo, masakit an imo suok nga sangkay.”

en: But when Jesus heard it, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified thereby.
war: Han pakabati ni Jesus hini, nagsiring hiya, “Diri ikamamatay ni Lazaro ini nga sakit. Nahinabo ini basi pasidunggan an Dyos, ngan pinaagi hito, pasidunggan man liwat an Anak han Dyos.”

en: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
war: Hinigugma ni Jesus hira Marta, Maria, ug Lazaro.

en: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he abode at that time two days in the place where he was.
war: Han pakabati niya nga masakit hi Lazaro, duha anay ka adlaw an iya ginpalabay san-o hiya kumadto.

en: Then after this he saith to the disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.
war: Katapos, nagsiring hiya ngadto han iya mga tinun-an, “Tana, balik kita ha Judea.”

en: The disciples say unto him, Rabbi, the Jews were but now seeking to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
war: Nagbaton an mga tinun-an, “Magturutdo, diri pa la maiha nga gin-iibarato ka didto han mga Judiyo, ngan karuyag mo na liwat hin pagkadto?”

en: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If a man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Di ba may dose ka oras an usa ka adlaw? Sanglit diri mahipapakdol an tawo nga maglalakat ha kapaw-an, kay nakita hiya han kapawa hini nga kalibutan.

en: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because the light is not in him.
war: Kundi mahipapakdol hiya kon maglakat hiya ha gab-i, kay masirom man.”

en: These things spake he: and after this he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus is fallen asleep; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
war: Ginsiring ini ni Jesus ngan sinumpayan pa niya pagsiring, “Nakaturog hi Lazaro nga aton sangkay, kundi makadto ako hin pagpukaw ha iya.”

en: The disciples therefore said unto him, Lord, if he is fallen asleep, he will recover.
war: Nagbaton an mga tinun-an, “Ginoo, mag-uupay hiya kon nakaturog la hiya.”

en: Now Jesus had spoken of his death: but they thought that he spake of taking rest in sleep.
war: Karuyag sidngon ni Jesus nga patay na hi Lazaro; kundi naghunahuna an mga tinun-an nga nagsiring hi Jesus nga nakaturog la hiya.

en: Then Jesus therefore said unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
war: Sanglit ginsumatan hira ni Jesus hin waray lipodlipod, “Patay na hi Lazaro;

en: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
war: kundi tungod ha iyo nalilipay ako nga waray ako didto upod ha iya, basi tumoo kamo. Kadtoa ta hiya.”

en: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said unto his fellow-disciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
war: Nagsiring ngadto han iya mga igkasi tinun-an hi Tomas, an ginngangaranan nga Karuha, “Tana, bunyog kita ngatanan han Magturutdo, basi mamatay kita upod ha iya!”

en: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
war: Pag-abot ni Jesus, nasayran niya nga upat na ka adlaw nga iginlubong hi Lazaro.

en: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off;
war: Mga tulo la ka kilometro an Betania tikang ha Jerusalem,

en: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
war: ngan damo nga mga Judiyo an kinmadto hin pagliaw kanda Marta ug Maria mahitungod han kamatay han ira bugto.

en: Martha therefore, when she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary still sat in the house.
war: Han pakabati ni Marta nga tiarabot hi Jesus, kinmadto hiya hin pagtapo, samtang hi Maria nagpabilin ha balay.

en: Martha therefore said unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
war: Nagsiring hi Marta kan Jesus, “Ginoo, diri unta napatay an akon bugto kon nakanhi ka pa!

en: And even now I know that, whatsoever thou shalt ask of God, God will give thee.
war: Kundi maaram ako nga bisan yana, ihahatag ha imo han Dyos an bisan ano nga imo pangaroon ha iya.”

en: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
war: Ginsumatan hiya ni Jesus, “Mababanhaw an imo bugto.”

en: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
war: Nagbaton hi Marta, “Maaram ako nga mababanhaw hiya ha kataposan nga adlaw.”

en: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth on me, though he die, yet shall he live;
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Hi ako an pagkabanhaw ngan an kinabuhi. Mabubuhi an bisan hin-o nga natoo ha akon, bisan kon mamatay hiya;

en: and whosoever liveth and believeth on me shall never die. Believest thou this?
war: ngan diri na gud mamamatay an bisan hin-o nga buhi nga natoo ha akon. Natuod ka ba hini?”

en: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I have believed that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, even he that cometh into the world.
war: Nagbaton hiya, “Oo, Ginoo, natoo ako nga amo ka an Mesiyas, an Anak han Dyos, nga makanhi ha kalibutan.”

en: And when she had said this, she went away, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Teacher is here, and calleth thee.
war: 28-30 Katapos pagsiring hini ni Marta, binmalik hiya ngan gintawag hi Maria nga iya bugto. (Waray pa abot hi Jesus ha baryo, kundi nakadto pa han dapit nga ginkatapoan niya ngan hi Marta.) Ginhuringan niya hi Maria, “Hahani an Magturutdo ngan nagpipinakiana ha imo.” Pakabati ni Maria hini, binmuhat hiya ngan nagdagmit hin paggawas pagtapo kan Jesus.

en: And she, when she heard it, arose quickly, and went unto him.
war: Hinkit-an ngan ginsunod hiya han mga Judiyo nga nakadto ha ira balay hin pagliaw ha iya. Naghunahuna hira nga tikadto hiya ha lubnganan hin pagtangis didto.

en: (Now Jesus was not yet come into the village, but was still in the place where Martha met him.)
war: Inmabot hi Maria ha dapit diin nakadto hi Jesus. Pakakita niya kan Jesus, hinmapa hiya ha atubangan niya ngan nagsiring, “Ginoo, diri unta napatay an akon bugto kon nakanhi ka pa!”

en: The Jews then who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, supposing that she was going unto the tomb to weep there.
war: Hinkit-an hiya ni Jesus nga nagtatangis, sugad man an mga Judiyo nga upod niya; nabantad an iya kasingkasing ngan inalpan hiya hin kalooy.

en: Mary therefore, when she came where Jesus was, and saw him, fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
war: Nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Diin niyo iglubong hiya?”

en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
war: Nagbaton hira, “Kadi, Ginoo, ngan kitaa.”

en: and said, Where have ye laid him? They say unto him, Lord, come and see.
war: Nagtangis hi Jesus.

en: Jesus wept.
war: Sanglit nagsiring an mga Judiyo, “Kitaa, pagkadako han iya paghigugma kan Lazaro!”

en: The Jews therefore said, Behold how he loved him!
war: Kundi an iba ha ira nagsiring, “Hiya nga nakapakita han mga mata han buta, diri ba hiya takos makapugong han kamatayon ni Lazaro?”

en: But some of them said, Could not this man, who opened the eyes of him that was blind, have caused that this man also should not die?
war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ha lubnganan kay inalpan na liwat hiya hin kabido. Usa adto nga lungib nga sinadhan hin bato.

en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
war: Nagsugo hi Jesus, “Kuhaa niyo an bato!”

en: Jesus saith, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time the body decayeth; for he hath been dead four days.
war: Nagbaton hi Marta nga bugto han minatay, “Naninimaho na hiya yana, Ginoo, kay upat na ka adlaw tikang hiya iginlubong.”

en: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou believedst, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri ba nagsiring ako ha imo nga hikikit-an mo an gahom han Dyos kon tumoo ka?”

en: So they took away the stone. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou heardest me.
war: Ginkuha nira an bato. Hinmangad hi Jesus ngan nagsiring, “Nagpapasalamat ako ha imo, Amay ko, nga pinamamatian mo ako.

en: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the multitude that standeth around I said it, that they may believe that thou didst send me.
war: Maaram ako nga dayuday ka namamati ha akon, kundi iginyakan ko ini tungod hini nga mga tawo nga aanhi yana, basi tumoo hira nga ginsugo mo ako.”

en: And when he had thus spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
war: Katapos niya magsiring hini, ginmoliat hiya, “Lazaro! Gawas ngadi!”

en: He that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with grave-clothes; and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
war: Ginmawas an minatay nga inalikosan pa an iya mga tiil han mga dugnit hin paglubong, pati an iya nawong. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Hubari niyo ngan palakta hiya.”

en: Many therefore of the Jews, who came to Mary and beheld that which he did, believed on him.
war: Nakakita han ginbuhat ni Jesus in damo han mga Judiyo nga nagduaw kan Maria, ngan tinmoo hira ha iya.

en: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.
war: Kundi kinmadto han mga Parisiyo an iba ha ira hin pagsumat ha ira han ginbuhat ni Jesus.

en: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many signs.
war: Sanglit nakigkita han Labaw nga Hukmanan an mga puno han kapadian ngan mga Parisiyo ngan nagsiring, “Ano an aton bubuhaton? Nagbubuhat ini nga tawo hin damo nga mga orosahon!

en: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.
war: Kon pabay-an ta la hiya, matoo an ngatanan ha iya, ngan maabot an mga punoan nga Romano ngan bubungkagon an Templo ngan an aton bug-os nga nasod!”

en: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
war: Nagsiring an usa ha ira, nga Caifas an ngaran, nga amo an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig, “Waray gud kamo makasabot!

en: nor do ye take account that it is expedient for you that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
war: Diri ba kamo maaram nga mas maupay para ha iyo nga gabay usa la ka tawo an mamatay tungod han bungto, kay nga mabungkag an bug-os nga nasod?”

en: Now this he said not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for the nation;
war: Ginsiring ini niya diri ha iya kalugaringon nga pagbuot. Kundi tungod nga hiya an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig, ginpanagna niya nga kinahanglan mamatay hi Jesus para han mga Judiyo,

en: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God that are scattered abroad.
war: ngan diri la para ha ira, kundi pagtirok liwat ngan pag-urosa han ngatanan nga nagkakaburublag nga mga anak han Dyos.

en: So from that day forth they took counsel that they might put him to death.
war: Tikang hadto nga adlaw, nagkasarabot an mga punoan nga Judiyo hin pagpatay kan Jesus.

en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed thence into the country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim; and there he tarried with the disciples.
war: Sanglit waray na hiya magsudoy hin dayag ha Judea, kundi binmaya hiya ngan napakadto hin dapit nga hirani han kamingawan, ngadto hin bungto nga ginngangaranan nga Efraim. Nagpabilin hiya didto upod an iya mga tinun-an.

en: Now the passover of the Jews was at hand: and many went up to Jerusalem out of the country before the passover, to purify themselves.
war: Hiraniay na an Pyesta han Paglabay han mga Judiyo. Napakadto ha Jerusalem, san-o magpyesta, in damo nga mga tawo nga tikang ha kahuronan, pagtuman han seremonyas han paglinis sumala han Balaod.

en: They sought therefore for Jesus, and spake one with another, as they stood in the temple, What think ye? That he will not come to the feast?
war: Nagpinamiling kan Jesus an mga tawo. Han katirok na nira didto han Templo, naggiparupakiana hira, “Ano an iyo hunahuna? Diri ba hiya mapakanhi ha Pyesta?”

en: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given commandment, that, if any man knew where he was, he should show it, that they might take him.
war: Nagsugo na an mga puno han kapadian ngan mga Parisiyo nga adton maaram kon hain hi Jesus, kinahanglan magpahibaro dayon ha ira basi dakpon nira.

en: Jesus therefore six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, whom Jesus raised from the dead.
war: Unom pa ka adlaw san-o umabot an Pyesta han Paglabay, napakadto hi Jesus ha Betania, an bungto ni Lazaro nga ginbanhaw ni Jesus.

en: So they made him a supper there: and Martha served; but Lazarus was one of them that sat at meat with him.
war: Nag-andam hira didto hin panihapon para ha iya, ngan nagdurot hi Marta, samtang nakigsaro hi Lazaro kan Jesus.

en: Mary therefore took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odor of the ointment.
war: Ngan kinmuha hi Maria hin mga tunga hin kilo han gimamahali nga pahamot, nga hinimo tikang hin puro nga nardo. Ginbubo ini niya ha mga tiil ni Jesus, ngan ginpahiran niya han iya buhok. Nalukop an bug-os nga balay han alimyon hini nga pahamot.

en: But Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples, that should betray him, saith,
war: Nagsiring an usa han mga tinun-an ni Jesus, hi Judas Iscariote—an maglilingo ha iya,

en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred shillings, and given to the poor?
war: “Kay ano nga waray lugod ibaligya ini nga pahamot hin sais syintos pesos ngan ihatag an kwarta ha mga kablas?”

en: Now this he said, not because he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and having the bag took away what was put therein.
war: Ginsiring ini niya diri tungod nga napaid hiya han mga kablas, kundi tungod nga kawatan hiya. Hiya an tinaporan han supot han kwarta ngan naara hiya hin pagpasipara hin pagkuha hin kwarta.

en: Jesus therefore said, Suffer her to keep it against the day of my burying.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus, “Pasagdi la niyo hiya! Tugoti hiya pagbuhat hini kay gin-aandam niya ini para han adlaw han paglubong ha akon.

en: For the poor ye have always with you; but me ye have not always.
war: Dayuday kaupod niyo an mga kablas, kundi diri ako dayuday kaupod niyo.”

en: The common people therefore of the Jews learned that he was there: and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
war: Nakabati in kadam-an nga mga Judiyo nga nakadto hi Jesus ha Betania, sanglit napakadto hira, diri la tungod kan Jesus, kundi pagkita liwat kan Lazaro nga ginbanhaw ni Jesus.

en: But the chief priests took counsel that they might put Lazarus also to death;
war: Sanglit nagkasarabot an mga puno han kapadian hin pagpatay kan Lazaro;

en: because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
war: kay tungod ha iya damo nga mga Judiyo in nahibulag ha ira ngan tinmoo na kan Jesus.

en: On the morrow a great multitude that had come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
war: Pagkabuwas, hinbatian han kadam-an nga mga tawo nga kinmadto han Pyesta han Paglabay, nga maabot hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.

en: took the branches of the palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried out, Hosanna: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord, even the King of Israel.
war: Sanglit nanguha hira hin mga palwa ngan tinmapo hira kan Jesus; ngan naggogoliat hira, “Dayawon an Dyos! Dayawon hiya nga nakanhi ha ngaran han Ginoo! Dayawon an Hadi han Israel!”

en: And Jesus, having found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
war: Nakaagi hi Jesus hin asno ngan iya ginsakyan, sugad han nahisurat:

en: Fear not, daughter of Zion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.
war: “Ayaw kahadlok, syudad han Sion!

en: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
war: Aanhi naabot an imo Hadi

en: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, bare witness.
war: nga nasakay hin nati nga asno.”

en: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, for that they heard that he had done this sign.
war: Waray makasabot hini an iya mga tinun-an hadto nga takna; kundi han kabanhaw na ni Jesus, nahinumdom hira nga nahisurat ini mahitungod ha iya, ngan ginbuhat ini nira para ha iya.

en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Behold how ye prevail nothing; lo, the world is gone after him.
war: Nagsumat han nahinabo an mga tawo nga kaupod ni Jesus han pagtawaga niya kan Lazaro tikang ha lubnganan ngan pagbanhawa ha iya.

en: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast:
war: Sanglit gintapo hiya han kadam-an, kay hinbatian nira nga ginbuhat niya ini nga urosahon.

en: these therefore came to Philip, who was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
war: Ngan may hinsiring an mga Parisiyo, “Kitaa daw! Waray gud naton mahihimo! Kitaa, nagsusunod na ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo!”

en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: Andrew cometh, and Philip, and they tell Jesus.
war: May mga Griego nga kaupod han mga kinmadto ha Jerusalem hin pagsingba ha panahon han pyesta.

en: And Jesus answereth them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
war: Hinmarani hira kan Felipe nga taga-Betsaida, ha Galilea ngan nagsiring, “Karuyag namon makigkita kan Jesus.”

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a grain of wheat fall into the earth and die, it abideth by itself alone; but if it die, it beareth much fruit.
war: Kinmadto hi Felipe pagsumat kan Andres, ngan kinmadto hira nga duha pagsumat kan Jesus.

en: He that loveth his life loseth it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Inmabot na yana an takna nga pagpapasidunggan an Anak han Tawo.

en: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will the Father honor.
war: Nagsusumat ako ha iyo hin tinuod: an usa ka lugas nga trigo nagpapabilin hin ka usa la ka lugas nga trigo labot kon mahulog ha tuna ngan katak-opan. Kon katak-opan na, mabunga hin damo nga mga lugas.

en: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour. But for this cause came I unto this hour.
war: Mawawad-an han iya kalugaringon an nahigugma han iya kinabuhi; kundi makakaangkon lugod han kinabuhi nga dayon adton nagdudumot han iya kinabuhi dinhe hini nga kalibutan.

en: Father, glorify thy name. There came therefore a voice out of heaven, saying , I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
war: Kinahanglan magsunod ha akon an karuyag magsirbe ha akon, basi kon hain ako, aadto man an akon surugoon. Pagpapasidunggan han akon Amay an magsirbe ha akon.”

en: The multitude therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it had thundered: others said, An angel hath spoken to him.
war: “Mabidoon gud ako yana, ngan ano an akon isisiring? Masiring ba ako, ‘Amay ko, palabya anay ha akon ini nga takna’? Diri, kay amo ini an hinungdan nga kinmanhi ako, basi karawaton ko ini nga takna hin pag-antos.

en: Jesus answered and said, This voice hath not come for my sake, but for your sakes.
war: Amay ko, paghimayaa an imo ngaran!”

en: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
war: Ngan nagyakan in tingog tikang ha langit, “Ginhimaya ko na ini, ngan paghihimayaon ko na liwat.”

en: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto myself.
war: Nakabati han tingog an kadam-an nga nagkakatukdaw didto, ngan nagsiring, “Nagdalugdog!” An iba nagsiring, “Nagyakan ha iya in usa nga anghel!”

en: But this he said, signifying by what manner of death he should die.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri tungod ha akon nga nagyakan ini nga tingog, kundi tungod ha iyo.

en: The multitude therefore answered him, We have heard out of the law that the Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
war: Ginhuhukman na yana an kalibutan; pupukanon na yana an punoan hini nga kalibutan.

en: Jesus therefore said unto them, Yet a little while is the light among you. Walk while ye have the light, that darkness overtake you not: and he that walketh in the darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
war: Kakabigon ko ngadi ha akon an ngatanan nga mga tawo, kon isahon na ako tikang ha tuna.” (

en: While ye have the light, believe on the light, that ye may become sons of light.
war: Ha pagsiring niya hini, iginpasabot niya an paagi han kamatayon nga iya pag-aantoson.)

en: These things spake Jesus, and he departed and hid himself from them.
war: Nagbaton an kadam-an, “Nagsusumat an aton Balaod nga mabubuhi ha kadayonan an Mesiyas. Niyan naunan-o man nga nasiring ka nga kinahanglan isahon an Anak han Tawo? Hin-o man ini nga Anak han Tawo?”

en: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they believed not on him:
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Halipotay na la nga panahon an pag-upod ha iyo han kapawa. Pagpadayon ha iyo dalan samtang aada pa ha iyo an kapawa, basi diri kamo abotan han kasisidman; kay an naglalakat ha kasisidman diri maaram kon tipakain hiya.

en: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake,
war: Sanglit too kamo han kapawa, samtang aada pa ha iyo ini, basi mahimo kamo nga mga anak han kapawa.”

en: Lord, who hath believed our report?
war: Katapos ni Jesus magsiring hini, linmakat hiya ngan tinmago.

en: And to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
war: Bisan kon ginbuhat niya ini ngatanan nga mga urosahon ha atubangan nira, waray gihapon hira tumoo ha iya,

en: For this cause they could not believe, for that Isaiah said again,
war: basi matuman an iginsiring ni Isaias nga manaragna:

en: He hath blinded their eyes, and he hardened their heart;
war: “Ginoo, hin-o in tinmuod

en: Lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart,
war: han iginsumat namon nga mensahe?

en: And should turn,
war: Hin-o an ginpakita han Ginoo han iya gahom?”

en: And I should heal them.
war: Tungod hini waray hira makatoo, kay nagsiring liwat hi Isaias:

en: These things said Isaiah, because he saw his glory; and he spake of him.
war: “Ginbuta han Dyos an ira mga mata,

en: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess it , lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
war: ngan ginsadhan an ira mga hunahuna,

en: for they loved the glory that is of men more than the glory that is of God.
war: basi diri kumita an ira mga mata,

en: And Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
war: ngan diri makasantop an ira mga hunahuna,

en: And he that beholdeth me beholdeth him that sent me.
war: ngan diri hira dumanggop ha akon,

en: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me may not abide in the darkness.
war: nasiring an Dyos,

en: And if any man hear my sayings, and keep them not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
war: basi tambalon ko hira.”

en: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my sayings, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I spake, the same shall judge him in the last day.
war: Ginsiring ini ni Isaias kay hinkit-an niya an gahom ni Jesus, ngan nagyakan hiya mahitungod ha iya.

en: For I spake not from myself; but the Father that sent me, he hath given me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
war: Bisan pa ngani, damo gihapon nga mga punoan nga Judiyo in tinmoo kan Jesus; kundi tungod han mga Parisiyo, waray hira magpadayag hin paghimangraw ha kadam-an, basi diri hira pagawason ha sinagoga.

en: And I know that his commandment is life eternal; the things therefore which I speak, even as the Father hath said unto me, so I speak.
war: Ginpalabi nira an pagdayaw ha ira han mga tawo kay han pagdayaw ha ira han Dyos.

en: Now before the feast of the passover, Jesus knowing that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own that were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
war: Bisperas na adto han Pyesta han Paglabay. Maaram na hi Jesus nga inmabot na an iya takna hin pagbaya hini nga kalibutan ngan hin pagkadto han Amay. Dayuday ginhigugma niya an iya mga sakop dinhe ha kalibutan, ngan ginhigugma niya hira tubtob gud ha kataposan.

en: And during supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son , to betray him,
war: Tarangka ha panihapon hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an. Ginlarang na han Yawa nga maglilingo kan Jesus hi Judas nga anak ni Simon Iscariote.

en: Jesus , knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came forth from God, and goeth unto God,
war: Maaram hi Jesus nga itinubyan ha iya han Amay an bug-os nga gahom, ngan maaram hiya nga tikang hiya ha Dyos, ngan tikadto na hiya sa Dyos.

en: riseth from supper, and layeth aside his garments; and he took a towel, and girded himself.
war: Sanglit binmuhat hi Jesus ngan maglubas han iya bawbaw nga bado, ngan magbagkos hin twalya.

en: Then he poureth water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
war: Inmipis hiya hin tubig ngada ha palanggana ngan nagtikang hin panmusa han mga tiil han mga tinun-an, ngan ginpahiran han twalya nga iya iginbagkos.

en: So he cometh to Simon Peter. He saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
war: Hinmarani kan Simon Pedro nga nagsiring ha iya, “Ginoo, mamumusa ka ba han akon mga tiil?”

en: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt understand hereafter.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri ka pa maaram yana kon ano an akon ginbubuhat, kundi hibabaroan mo ini onina.”

en: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro, “Diri gud ako matugot nga mamusa ka han akon mga tiil!”

en: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kon diri ako mamusa han imo mga tiil, diri ka na magigin tinun-an ko.”

en: Jesus saith to him, He that is bathed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
war: Nagbaton hi Simon Pedro, “Kon amo man ini, Ginoo, diri la an akon mga tiil, kundi ilakip liwat hin paghugas an akon mga kamot ngan ulo!”

en: For he knew him that should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “An human na kumarigos, malinis na an iya bug-os nga lawas, sanglit diri na kinahanglan maghugas pa ha iya ngahaw, kundi an iya mga tiil na la. Malinis na kamo kundi diri ngatanan.” (

en: So when he had washed their feet, and taken his garments, and sat down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
war: Maaram na hi Jesus kon hin-o an maglilingo ha iya, sanglit nagsiring hiya, “Malinis na kamo kundi diri ngatanan.”)

en: Ye call me, Teacher, and, Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
war: Katapos niya pamusa han ira mga tiil, nagsul-ot na liwat hi Jesus han iya bawbaw nga bado, ngan binmalik ha iya lingkoran ha lamesa. Nagpakiana hiya, “Nasayod ba kamo han ginbuhat ko ha iyo?

en: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.
war: Natawag kamo ha akon nga magturutdo ngan Ginoo, ngan may kamatuoran, kay amo gud ito ako.

en: For I have given you an example, that ye also should do as I have done to you.
war: Sanglit kon ako nga iyo Ginoo ngan Magturutdo namusa han iyo mga tiil, angay man liwat kamo maggiparupamusa han iyo mga tiil.

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord; neither one that is sent greater than he that sent him.
war: Gintagan ko kamo hin susbaranan, basi sugaron niyo hin pagbuhat han ginbuhat ko ha iyo.

en: If ye know these things, blessed are ye if ye do them.
war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: waray oripon nga labaw han iya agaron; waray sinugo nga labaw han nagsugo ha iya.

en: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth my bread lifted up his heel against me.
war: Yana maaram na kamo hini nga kamatuoran; palaran kamo kon buhaton ini niyo!

en: From henceforth I tell you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he .
war: “Diri ako naghihimangraw mahitungod ha iyo ngatanan; nakilala ako han akon mga ginpili. Kundi kinahanglan matuman an kasuratan nga nasiring, ‘Kinmontra ha akon an tawo nga sinmaro ha akon.’

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
war: Ginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo nga hi ‘Ako Amo Ako.’

en: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in the spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
war: Nagsusumat ako ha iyo hin tinuod: an bisan hin-o nga nakarawat han akon sinusugo, nakarawat man ha akon; ngan an nakarawat ha akon, nakarawat man han nagsugo ha akon.”

en: The disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
war: Katapos ni Jesus magsiring hini, inalpan hiya hin dako nga kabido, ngan nagsiring hin dayag, “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: maglilingo ha akon in usa ha iyo.”

en: There was at the table reclining in Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
war: Naggipasirosiplat hira nga nanhiburong kon hin-o gud an iya karuyag sidngon.

en: Simon Peter therefore beckoneth to him, and saith unto him, Tell us who it is of whom he speaketh.
war: Nalingkod sapit ni Jesus an hinigugma niya nga tinun-an.

en: He leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
war: Nagsenyas hi Simon Pedro ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Pakianhi daw hiya kon hin-o an iya hinnanabihan.”

en: Jesus therefore answereth, He it is, for whom I shall dip the sop, and give it him. So when he had dipped the sop, he taketh and giveth it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
war: Sanglit sinmiring kan Jesus adto nga tinun-an ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o man hiya, Ginoo?”

en: And after the sop, then entered Satan into him. Jesus therefore saith unto him, What thou doest, do quickly.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Itutunlob ko an tinapay ngan ihahatag ko ini ha iya; amo hiya an tawo.” Sanglit kinmuha hiya hin pinit nga tinapay, iya ini gintunlob, ngan iginhatag kan Judas nga anak ni Simon Iscariote.

en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
war: Han pakakarawat gud la ni Judas han tinapay, sinmulod dayon ha iya hi Satanas. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Dagmit ngan tumana an kinahanglan mo buhaton!”

en: For some thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus said unto him, Buy what things we have need of for the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
war: Waray nakasabot han mga nakada ha lamesa kay ano nga ginsiring ini ni Jesus ha iya.

en: He then having received the sop went out straightway: and it was night.
war: Tungod nga hi Judas man an tinaporan han supot han kwarta, nakahunahuna an iba nga mga tinun-an nga ginsugo hiya ni Jesus hin pagpalit han ira kinahanglanon para han pyesta, o bangin ginsugo hiya paghatag ngadto han mga kablas.

en: When therefore he was gone out, Jesus saith, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him;
war: Ginkarawat ni Judas an tinapay ngan ginmawas hiya dayon. Gab-i adto.

en: and God shall glorify him in himself, and straightway shall he glorify him.
war: Han paggawas na ni Judas, nagsiring hi Jesus, “Iginpapakita na yana an himaya han Anak han Tawo, ngan pinaagi ha iya, ginpapakita liwat an himaya han Dyos.

en: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say unto you.
war: Kon iginpapakita an himaya han Dyos pinaagi ha iya, magpapakita man an Dyos han himaya han Anak han Tawo ha iya ngahaw, ngan bubuhaton ito niya dayon.

en: A new commandment I give unto you, that ye love one another; even as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
war: Mga anak ko, gutiay na la nga panahon an akon pakig-urosa ha iyo. Mamimiling kamo ha akon; kundi susumatan ko kamo yana han akon iginsiring ngadto han mga Judiyo, ‘Diri kamo makakadto han akon kakadtoan.’

en: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
war: Ihinahatag ko ha iyo in bag-o nga sugo: magsihigugmaay kamo. Kinahanglan magsihigugmaay kamo sugad han akon paghigugma ha iyo.

en: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow afterwards.
war: Kon magsihigugmaay kamo, mahibabaro an ngatanan nga akon kamo mga tinun-an.”

en: Peter saith unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee even now? I will lay down my life for thee.
war: Nagpakiana ha iya hi Simon Pedro, “Ngain ka man kakadto, Ginoo ?”

en: Jesus answereth, Wilt thou lay down thy life for me? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri ka pa yana makakasunod ngadto han akon kakadtoan, kundi masunod ka ha akon onina.”

en: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, believe also in me.
war: Nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Ayaw kamo kabaraka ngan kagupong. Too kamo han Dyos ngan too man kamo ha akon.

en: In my Father’s house are many mansions; if it were not so, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.
war: Damo in mga kwarto didto han balay han akon Amay, ngan makadto ako hin pag-andam hin dapit para ha iyo. Diri ako magsusumat hini ha iyo kon diri pa ini tinuod.

en: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I come again, and will receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
war: Ngan katapos ko kadto ngan pag-andam hin dapit para ha iyo, mabalik ako ngan pauupdon ko kamo ha akon, basi kon hain ako aadto man liwat kamo.

en: And whither I go, ye know the way.
war: Maaram na kamo kon uunanhon niyo pagsangpot ngadto han akon kakadtoan.”

en: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; how know we the way?
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Tomas, “Ginoo, diri kami maaram kon tikain ka; uunanhon man namon paghibaro han dalan nga tipakadto?”

en: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the Father, but by me.
war: Nagbaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Amo ako an dalan, an kamatuoran, ngan an kinabuhi; waray makakadto han Amay kon diri pinaagi ha akon.”

en: If ye had known me, ye would have known my Father also: from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Yana nga nakakilala na kamo ha akon, makilala man kamo han akon Amay; ngan tikang yana nakilala na kamo ha iya, ngan hinkit-an na hiya niyo.”

en: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Felipe, “Ginoo, ipakita ha amon an Amay ngan igo na ito para ha amon.”

en: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and dost thou not know me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; how sayest thou, Show us the Father?
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kamaiha na nga kaupod-upod ako niyo ngatanan; diri ka pa gihapon nakilala ha akon, Felipe? Nakakita na han Amay an bisan hin-o nga nakakita ha akon. Sanglit kay ano nga nasiring ka, ‘Ipakita ha amon an Amay’?

en: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I say unto you I speak not from myself: but the Father abiding in me doeth his works.
war: Diri ka ba natoo, Felipe, nga aada ako han Amay ngan an Amay aadi ha akon?” Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Diri natikang ha akon an mga pulong nga iginhimangraw ko ha iyo. Nagbubuhat an Amay nga aadi ha akon han iya kalugaringon nga mga buruhaton.

en: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
war: Tuohi niyo nga aada ako han Amay ngan an Amay aadi ha akon; kon diri man, tuohi ako niyo tungod hini nga mga buhat.

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto the Father.
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: magbubuhat man han mga buruhaton nga akon ginbubuhat an bisan hin-o nga natoo ha akon—tinuod, magbubuhat hiya hin larolabaw pa, kay makadto ako han Amay.

en: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
war: Ngan bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha akon ngaran, basi pagdayawon an Amay pinaagi han Anak.

en: If ye shall ask anything in my name, that will I do.
war: Bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga pangaroon niyo ha akon ngaran.

en: If ye love me, ye will keep my commandments.
war: “Kon nahigugma kamo ha akon, magtutuman kamo han akon mga sugo.

en: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may be with you for ever,
war: Pangangaroon ko han Amay, ngan tatagan kamo niya hin lain nga Parabulig, an Espiritu han kamatuoran, nga magpapabilin ha iyo ha kadayonan.

en: even the Spirit of truth: whom the world cannot receive; for it beholdeth him not, neither knoweth him: ye know him; for he abideth with you, and shall be in you.
war: Diri makarawat ha iya an kalibutan, kay diri nakita o nakilala an kalibutan ha iya. Kundi nakilala kamo ha iya, kay nagpapabilin nga nag-uokoy hiya dida ha iyo.

en: I will not leave you desolate: I come unto you.
war: “Diri ko kamo babayaan nga mag-uusaan; mabalik ako ngada ha iyo.

en: Yet a little while, and the world beholdeth me no more; but ye behold me: because I live, ye shall live also.
war: Ha diri maiha diri na makita ha akon an kalibutan, kundi makita kamo ha akon; ngan mabubuhi kamo kay buhi man ako.

en: In that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
war: Kon umabot na ito nga adlaw, hibabaroan niyo nga aada ako han akon Amay, ngan aadi kamo ha akon, sugad nga aada ako ha iyo.

en: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself unto him.
war: “Nahigugma ha akon an bisan hin-o nga makarawat ngan magtuman han akon mga sugo. Hihigugmaon han akon Amay adton nahigugma ha akon; hihigugmaon ko man hiya ngan magpapakilala ako ha iya.”

en: Judas (not Iscariot) saith unto him, Lord, what is come to pass that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
war: Nagpakiana hi Judas (diri hi Judas Iscariote), “Ginoo, uunanhon hin pagpakilala mo han imo kalugaringon ha amon, ngan diri ngadto ha kalibutan?”

en: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my word: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Magtutuman han akon mensahe an bisan hin-o nga nahigugma ha akon. Hihigugmaon hiya han akon Amay, ngan makada kami ha iya, ngan mag-uokoy kami dida ha iya.

en: He that loveth me not keepeth not my words: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
war: Diri nagtutuman han akon mga pulong an bisan hin-o nga diri nahigugma ha akon. Diri akon an mensahe nga hinbatian niyo, kundi natikang han Amay nga nagsugo ha akon.

en: These things have I spoken unto you, while yet abiding with you.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo samtang upod pa ako niyo.

en: But the Comforter, even the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said unto you.
war: Kundi an Parabulig, an Espiritu Santo, nga susugoon han Amay ha akon ngaran, amo an magtututdo ha iyo han ngatanan nga mga butang, ngan magpapahinumdom ha iyo han ngatanan nga akon iginsumat ha iyo.

en: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
war: “Ibibilin ko ha iyo an kalinaw; ihahatag ko ha iyo an akon kalinaw. Ihahatag ko ini ha iyo diri sugad han paghatag han kalibutan. Ayaw kamo kabaraka ngan kalisang; ayaw kamo kahadlok.

en: Ye heard how I said to you, I go away, and I come unto you. If ye loved me, ye would have rejoiced, because I go unto the Father: for the Father is greater than I.
war: Hinbatian ako niyo nga nasiring ha iyo, ‘Mabaya ako, kundi mabalik ako ha iyo.’ Kon nahigugma kamo ha akon, maglilipay unta kamo nga makadto ako han Amay, kay larolabaw hiya ha akon.

en: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe.
war: Iginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo.

en: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world cometh: and he hath nothing in me;
war: Diri na ako maghihimangraw ha iyo hin maiha, kay maabot na an punoan hini nga kalibutan. Waray hiya gahom ha akon,

en: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
war: kundi kinahanglan mahibaro an kalibutan nga nahigugma ako han Amay; sanglit ginbubuhat ko an ngatanan nga iginsugo niya ha akon.

en: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
war: “Amo ako an tinuod nga balagon, ngan an akon Amay an magmarangno.

en: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he taketh it away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he cleanseth it, that it may bear more fruit.
war: Binabanggi niya an ngatanan nga sanga nga diri nabunga. Tinatag-an niya hin paghawan an kada sanga nga nabunga, basi mamunga hin darodamo.

en: Already ye are clean because of the word which I have spoken unto you.
war: Nalinisan na kamo pinaagi han mensahe nga akon iginhimangraw ha iyo.

en: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me.
war: Pabilin kamo didi ha akon, ngan magpapabilin man ako dida ha iyo. Diri makakabunga in sanga ha iya la kalugaringon; mahihimo la ini kon sumpay han puno an sanga. Ha sugad nga kaagi, diri kamo makakabunga, labot kon magpabilin kamo didi ha akon.

en: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.
war: “Ako an balagon ngan kamo an mga sanga. Mabunga hin damo an bisan hin-o nga magpabilin didi ha akon, ngan ako dida ha iya, kay waray niyo mahihimo kon bulag kamo ha akon.

en: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
war: Ilinalabog ha gawas an bisan hin-o nga diri nagpapabilin ha akon, ngan nauuga sugad hin sanga; gintitirok in sugad nga mga sanga, ngan ilinalabog ha kalayo, ngan sunogon.

en: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatsoever ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
war: Kon magpabilin kamo didi ha akon, ngan magpabilin an akon mga pulong dida ha iyo, mangangaro kamo hin bisan ano nga inuungara niyo, ngan katutumanan kamo.

en: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; and so shall ye be my disciples.
war: Ginhihimaya an akon Amay tungod han iyo pamunga hin damo; ngan pinaagi hini, nagigin mga tinun-an ko kamo.

en: Even as the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you: abide ye in my love.
war: Hinihigugma ko kamo sugad gud han paghigugma ha akon han Amay; pagpabilin kamo didi han akon gugma.

en: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
war: Kon tumanon niyo an akon mga sugo, magpapabilin kamo ha akon gugma, sugad gud han pagtuman ko han mga sugo han akon Amay ngan nagpapabilin ako dida han iya gugma.

en: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi mahingada ha iyo an akon kalipay, ngan basi mahingpit an iyo kalipay.

en: This is my commandment, that ye love one another, even as I have loved you.
war: Amo ini an akon sugo: pagsihigugmaay kamo, sugad han paghigugma ko ha iyo.

en: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
war: An gidadakoi nga gugma nga maaangkon hin usa ka tawo tungod han iya kasangkayan, amo an pagtubyan han iya kinabuhi para ha ira.

en: Ye are my friends, if ye do the things which I command you.
war: Ngan kasangkayan ko kamo, kon buhaton niyo an akon iginsusugo ha iyo.

en: No longer do I call you servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I heard from my Father I have made known unto you.
war: Diri ko na kamo tatawgon nga mga surugoon, kay diri maaram an surugoon han ginbubuhat han iya agaron. Lugod, tatawagon ko kamo nga mga sangkay, kay iginsumat ko ha iyo an ngatanan nga hinbatian ko tikang han akon Amay.

en: Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
war: Waray kamo magpili ha akon; ako an nagpili ha iyo, ngan nagtudlok ha iyo nga magkalakat kamo ngan mamunga hin damo, mga bunga nga nagpapadayon. Sanglit ihahatag ha iyo han Amay an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha iya, ha akon ngaran.

en: These things I command you, that ye may love one another.
war: Sanglit amo ini an igsusugo ko ha iyo: paggihigugmaay kamo.”

en: If the world hateth you, ye know that it hath hated me before it hated you.
war: “Kon magdumot ha iyo an kalibutan, kinahanglan hisabotan niyo nga una ako pagdumtan han kalibutan.

en: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
war: Kon kanan kalibutan pa kamo, mahigugma unta ha iyo an kalibutan sugad nga iya kalugaringon. Kundi ginpili ko kamo tikang hini nga kalibutan, ngan diri na kamo sakop han kalibutan; sanglit magdudumot ha iyo an kalibutan.

en: Remember the word that I said unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.
war: Hinumdomi an iginsiring ko ha iyo: ‘Waray oripon nga labaw han iya agaron.’ Kon ginpakurian ako nira, pagpapakurian man liwat kamo nira; kon gintuman nira an akon mensahe, pagtutumanon man liwat nira an iyo mensahe.

en: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
war: Kundi bubuhaton nira ini ngatanan ha iyo, kay akon man kamo sakop; kay diri hira nakilala han nagsugo ha akon.

en: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no excuse for their sin.
war: Diri unta hira salaan kon waray pa ako kumanhi ngan maghimangraw ha ira; kundi yana, waray na hira baribad han ira sala.

en: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
war: An bisan hin-o nga nagdudumot ha akon, nagdudumot man han akon Amay.

en: If I had not done among them the works which none other did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
war: Diri unta hira salaan kon waray ko pa buhata ha butnga nira an mga buhat nga waray pagbuhata hin bisan hin-o; kundi yana, hinkit-an na nira an akon ginbuhat, ngan gindudumtan nira ako ngan an akon Amay.

en: But this cometh to pass , that the word may be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
war: Kundi kinahanglan mahinabo ini, basi matuman an iginsurat dida han ira Balaod: ‘Gindumtan ako nira hin waray la hinungdan.’

en: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall bear witness of me:
war: “Maabot an Parabulig, an Espiritu han kamatuoran, nga natikang han Amay. Susugoon ko hiya nganhi ha iyo tikang han Amay, ngan magpapamatuod hiya mahitungod ha akon.

en: and ye also bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
war: Ngan magpapamatuod liwat kamo mahitungod ha akon, kay nagin kaupod ko man kamo tikang pa gud ha tinikangan.

en: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be caused to stumble.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi diri lumuya an iyo pagtoo ha akon.

en: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the hour cometh, that whosoever killeth you shall think that he offereth service unto God.
war: Paiiwason kamo nira ha ira mga sinagoga. Maabot an panahon nga an magpapatay ha iyo makakahunahuna nga nag-aalagad hiya han Dyos.

en: And these things will they do, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
war: Bubuhaton nira ha iyo ini nga mga butang, kay waray hira makakilala han Amay o ha akon.

en: But these things have I spoken unto you, that when their hour is come, ye may remember them, how that I told you. And these things I said not unto you from the beginning, because I was with you.
war: Kundi iginsumat ko ini ha iyo, basi kon buhaton na nira ini, mahinunumdom kamo nga iginsumat ko ini ha iyo.

en: But now I go unto him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
war: “Waray ko igsumat ha iyo ini nga mga butang ha tinikangan, kay kaupod pa man ako niyo.

en: But because I have spoken these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
war: Kundi yana, makadto na ako han nagsugo ha akon; kundi waray ha iyo napakiana ha akon, ‘Tikain ka?’

en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is expedient for you that I go away; for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I go, I will send him unto you.
war: Ngan yana nga ginsumatan ko na kamo, nagmamabidoon kamo.

en: And he, when he is come, will convict the world in respect of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
war: Kundi susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: mauruupay para ha iyo nga malakat ako, kay kon diri ako lumakat, diri makanhi ha iyo an Parabulig. Kundi kon lumakat ako, ipadadara ko hiya nganhi ha iyo.

en: of sin, because they believe not on me;
war: Ngan kon umabot na hiya, magpapamatuod hiya ha mga tawo han kalibutan nga mga sayop hira mahitungod han sala, mahitungod han pagkamatadong, ngan mahitungod han paghukom han Dyos.

en: of righteousness, because I go to the Father, and ye behold me no more;
war: Sayop hira mahitungod han sala, kay diri hira natoo ha akon;

en: of judgment, because the prince of this world hath been judged.
war: mahitungod han pagkamatadong, kay makadto ako han Amay ngan diri na kamo makita ha akon;

en: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
war: mahitungod han paghukom, kay ginhukman na an punoan hini nga kalibutan.

en: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but what things soever he shall hear, these shall he speak: and he shall declare unto you the things that are to come.
war: “Damo pa gad an akon igsurumat ha iyo, kundi diri pa ini niyo maaakos yana.

en: He shall glorify me: for he shall take of mine, and shall declare it unto you.
war: Kundi kon umabot na an Espiritu han kamatuoran, igtututdo kamo niya ngadto han ngatanan nga kamatuoran. Diri hiya maghihimangraw ha iya la kalugaringon, kundi maghihimangraw hiya han hinbabatian, ngan magsusumat han mga butang nga tiarabot.

en: All things whatsoever the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he taketh of mine, and shall declare it unto you.
war: Paghihimayaon ako niya, kay natikang ha akon an igsusumat niya ha iyo.

en: A little while, and ye behold me no more; and again a little while, and ye shall see me.
war: Akon an ngatanan nga kanan Amay; sanglit nagsiring ako nga natikang ha akon an igsusumat ha iyo han Espiritu.

en: Some of his disciples therefore said one to another, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye behold me not; and again a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
war: “Ha diri maiha, diri na kamo makita ha akon; ngan ha diri liwat maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon.”

en: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? We know not what he saith.
war: Nagsiring ngadto han iba an pira han iya mga tinun-an: “Ano ba an kahulogan hini nga iya siring, ‘Ha diri maiha, diri na kamo makita ha akon, ngan diri maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon’; ngan nasiring liwat hiya, ‘Kay makadto ako han Amay.’”

en: Jesus perceived that they were desirous to ask him, and he said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, A little while, and ye behold me not, and again a little while, and ye shall see me?
war: Nagpakiana pa hira, “Ano an buot niya sidngon han ‘diri maiha’? Diri kita nasabot han iya ginyiyinakan!”

en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
war: Nahibaro hi Jesus nga karuyag hira pumakiana ha iya, sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nagsiring ako, ‘Ha diri maiha diri na kamo makita ha akon, ngan diri maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon.’ Amo ba ini an iyo ginpaparopakiana?

en: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but when she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for the joy that a man is born into the world.
war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: magtatangis ngan magngunguyngoy kamo, kundi maglilipay an kalibutan; magmamabidoon kamo, kundi magigin kalipayan an iyo kabidoan.

en: And ye therefore now have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one taketh away from you.
war: Mabidoon in babaye kon tipagaranak pa la hiya, kay inmabot na an takna han iya pag-antos; kundi kon natatawo na an bata, hinngangalimtan niya an iya gin-antos, kay malipayon na hiya nga may natawo nga bata nganhi ha kalibutan.

en: And in that day ye shall ask me no question. Verily, verily, I say unto you, If ye shall ask anything of the Father, he will give it you in my name.
war: Amo man ini dida ha iyo: mabidoon kamo yana, kundi makikigkita liwat ako ha iyo, ngan magmamalipayon gud kamo hin kalipay nga waray makakaagaw ha iyo.

en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be made full.
war: “Kon umabot na adto nga adlaw diri na kamo mangangaro ha akon hin bisan ano. Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: ihahatag ha iyo han Amay an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha iya ha akon ngaran.

en: These things have I spoken unto you in dark sayings: the hour cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in dark sayings, but shall tell you plainly of the Father.
war: Ngada yana waray pa kamo mangaro hin bisan ano ha akon ngaran; pangaro ngan makarawat kamo, basi mahingpit an iyo kalipay.

en: In that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you;
war: “Iginsumat ko ha iyo ini nga mga butang pinaagi hin mga pananglitan. Kundi maabot in panahon nga diri na ako magamit hin mga pananglitan, kundi magyayakan ako ha iyo hin yano nga mga pulong mahitungod han Amay.

en: for the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came forth from the Father.
war: Kon umabot na adto nga adlaw mangangaro kamo ha iya ha akon ngaran; ngan diri ako nasiring nga mangangaro ako ha iya para ha iyo,

en: I came out from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go unto the Father.
war: kay nahigugma ha iyo an Amay ngahaw. Nahigugma hiya ha iyo kay nahigugma man kamo ha akon ngan tinmoo kamo nga tinmikang ako han Dyos.

en: His disciples say, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no dark saying.
war: Tikang gud ako han Amay ngan kinmanhi ako ha kalibutan; ngan yana mabaya na ako han kalibutan ngan mabalik ako ngadto han Amay.”

en: Now know we that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
war: Ngan nagsiring an iya mga tinun-an, “Kitaa, dayag na kaupay an imo pagyakan, ngan diri ka na nagamit hin mga pananglitan.

en: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
war: Maaram na kami yana nga sayod ka han ngatanan; diri ka nagkikinahanglan nga may magpinakiana pa ha imo. Nakakapatoo ini ha amon nga tikang ka han Dyos.”

en: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Natoo na ba kamo yana?

en: These things have I spoken unto you, that in me ye may have peace. In the world ye have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
war: Maabot an panahon, ngan aanhi na, nga magkakaburublag kamo ngatanan, kada usa, ha iya kalugaringon nga urukyan, ngan babayaan ako nga mag-uusaan. Kundi diri tinuod nga nag-uusaan la ako, kay kaupod ko an Amay.

en: These things spake Jesus; and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that the Son may glorify thee:
war: Katapos ni Jesus maghimangraw hini, hinmangad hiya ha langit ngan nagsiring, “Amay ko, inmabot na an takna. Paghimayaa an imo Anak, basi paghimayaon ka man han imo Anak.

en: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.
war: Kay gintagan mo man hiya hin gahom hin pagmando han ngatanan nga mga tawo basi humatag hiya han dayon nga kinabuhi ngadto han ngatanan nga igintubyan mo ha iya.

en: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, even Jesus Christ.
war: Ngan amo ini an dayon nga kinabuhi; nga kumilala ha imo an mga tawo, nga ikaw la an matuod nga Dyos, ngan kumilala kan Jesu-Cristo nga imo ginsugo.

en: I glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.
war: Iginpakita ko ha tuna an imo himaya; ginhuman ko na an iginpabuhat mo ha akon.

en: And now, Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
war: Amay ko, himayaa ako yana ha imo atubangan sugad han himaya nga akon hadto han kaupod pa ako nimo, han waray pa himoa an kalibutan.

en: I manifested thy name unto the men whom thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.
war: “Iginpakilala ko ikaw han mga tawo nga imo ginkuha ha kalibutan. Imo hira, ngan gintubyan mo hira ha akon. Gintuman nira an imo pulong,

en: Now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:
war: ngan yana maaram hira nga tikang ha imo an ngatanan nga iginhatag mo ha akon.

en: for the words which thou gavest me I have given unto them; and they received them , and knew of a truth that I came forth from thee, and they believed that thou didst send me.
war: Igintutdo ko ha ira an mensahe nga iginhatag mo ha akon, ngan ginkarawat ini hira. Maaram hira nga tikang ako ha imo, ngan natoo hira nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.

en: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:
war: “Nag-aampo ako para ha ira. Diri ako nag-aampo para han kalibutan, kundi para han mga tawo nga igintubyan mo ha akon, kay imo man hira.

en: and all things that are mine are thine, and thine are mine: and I am glorified in them.
war: Imo an ngatanan nga akon, ngan akon man an ngatanan nga imo; ngan napapasidunggan ako tungod ha ira.

en: And I am no more in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we are .
war: Yana makada na ako ha imo; mabaya na ako han kalibutan, kundi hahani pa hira ha kalibutan. Baraan nga Amay, panalipdi hira pinaagi han gahom han imo ngaran, an ngaran nga ihinatag mo ha akon, basi magkaurosa hira sugad nga uusa la kita.

en: While I was with them, I kept them in thy name which thou hast given me: and I guarded them, and not one of them perished, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
war: Ginpanalipdan ko hira pinaagi han gahom han imo ngaran nga ihinatag mo ha akon, samtang kaupod pa ako nira. Ginbantayan ko hira, ngan waray usa ha ira nga nawara, labot han tawo nga kinahanglan mawara, basi matuman an kasuratan.

en: But now I come to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
war: Kundi yana makada na ako ha imo, ngan ginhihimangraw ko ini nga mga butang dinhe ha kalibutan, basi matugob gud hira han akon kalipayan.

en: I have given them thy word; and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
war: Iginhatag ko ha ira an imo mensahe ngan nagdumot ha ira an kalibutan, kay diri man hira kanan kalibutan, sugad gud nga diri man ako kanan kalibutan.

en: I pray not that thou shouldest take them from the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil one .
war: Diri ako nahangyo nga kuhaon mo hira ha kalibutan, kundi nga panalipdan mo hira han Yawa.

en: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
war: Diri hira kanan kalibutan, sugad gud nga diri man ako kanan kalibutan.

en: Sanctify them in the truth: thy word is truth.
war: Ihalad hira ngada ha imo pinaagi han kamatuoran; an imo pulong amo an kamatuoran.

en: As thou didst send me into the world, even so sent I them into the world.
war: Ginpadara ko hira nganhi ha kalibutan sugad han pagsugoa mo ha akon nganhi ha kalibutan.

en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
war: Ngan tungod ha ira ihinahalad ko ha imo an akon kalugaringon, basi hira liwat magin tinuod man nga iginhalad ha imo.

en: Neither for these only do I pray, but for them also that believe on me through their word;
war: “Nag-aampo ako diri para la ha ira, kundi para liwat hadton mga matoo ha akon tungod han ira mensahe.

en: that they may all be one; even as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be in us: that the world may believe that thou didst send me.
war: Nag-aampo ako nga magkaurosa unta hira ngatanan. Amay, mahiusa unta hira ha aton, sugad gud nga aadi ka ha akon ngan aada ako ha imo, basi tumoo an kalibutan nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.

en: And the glory which thou hast given me I have given unto them; that they may be one, even as we are one;
war: Gintagan ko hira han amo nga himaya nga ihinatag mo ha akon, basi magkaurosa hira sugad nga uusa la kita;

en: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that thou didst send me, and lovedst them, even as thou lovedst me.
war: ako dida ha ira ngan ikaw dadi ha akon, basi magkaurosa unta hira hin hingpit, basi makasabot unta an kalibutan nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon, ngan nahigugma ka ha ira sugad han imo paghigugma ha akon.

en: Father, I desire that they also whom thou hast given me be with me where I am, that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
war: “Amay, igintubyan mo hira ha akon, ngan karuyag ko nga hira mahiusa ha akon bisan kon hain ako, basi hikit-an nira an akon himaya, an himaya nga ihinatag mo ha akon; kay ginhigugma mo ako han waray pa hihimoa an kalibutan.

en: O righteous Father, the world knew thee not, but I knew thee; and these knew that thou didst send me;
war: Matadong nga Amay, diri nakilala ha imo an kalibutan, kundi nakilala ako ha imo, ngan maaram ini hira nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.

en: and I made known unto them thy name, and will make it known; that the love wherewith thou lovedst me may be in them, and I in them.
war: Iginpakilala ko ikaw ha ira, ngan ipadadayon ko hin pagpakilala ha imo, basi maangkon man nira an gugma mo para ha akon, ngan mag-ukoy man ako dida ha ira.”

en: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where was a garden, into which he entered, himself and his disciples.
war: Katapos ni Jesus mag-ampo hini, linmakat hiya upod an iya mga tinun-an ngan tinmabok han sapa nga Kidron an ngaran. May tanaman didto hadto nga dapit, ngan sinmulod ngadto hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an.

en: Now Judas also, who betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus oft-times resorted thither with his disciples.
war: Agsob hi Jesus makig-urosa han iya mga tinun-an didto, sanglit maaram hini nga dapit an malingo nga Judas.

en: Judas then, having received the band of soldiers , and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
war: Sanglit kinmadto hi Judas hini nga tanaman upod in mga sondalo ngan mga gwardya han Templo nga ginsugo han mga puno han kapadian ngan mga Parisiyo. Dara nira in mga hinganiban, mga parol, ngan mga sulo.

en: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were coming upon him, went forth, and saith unto them, Whom seek ye?
war: Maaram hi Jesus han ngatanan nga mahinanabo ha iya, sanglit gintapo niya ngan ginpakianhan hira, “Hin-o an iyo ginbibiling?”

en: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he . And Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
war: Nagbaton hira, “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”

en: When therefore he said unto them, I am he , they went backward, and fell to the ground.
war: “Amo ako,” nagsiring hiya.

en: Again therefore he asked them, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
war: Natindog didto upod ha ira an malingo nga Judas.

en: Jesus answered, I told you that I am he ; if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
war: Han pagsiring la ni Jesus, “Amo ako,” inmisol hira ngan nagkatutumba ha tuna.

en: that the word might be fulfilled which he spake, Of those whom thou hast given me I lost not one.
war: Ginpakianhan na liwat hira ni Jesus, “Hin-o gud an iyo ginbibiling?”

en: Simon Peter therefore having a sword drew it, and struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. Now the servant’s name was Malchus.
war: Nagbaton hira, “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”

en: Jesus therefore said unto Peter, Put up the sword into the sheath: the cup which the Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo nga amo ako, sanglit kon ako an iyo tuyo, palakta niyo inin iba.” (

en: So the band and the chief captain, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,
war: Ginsiring niya ini basi matuman an iya iginyakan, “Amay, waray ako kawad-i bisan usa han imo iginhatag ha akon.”)

en: and led him to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
war: May espada hi Simon Pedro; hinulbot ini niya ngan tigbason an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an tuo nga talinga han oripon. Malco an ngaran han oripon.

en: Now Caiaphas was he that gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus kan Pedro, “Ibalik ha takob an imo espada! Naghuhunahuna ka ba nga diri ko iimnon an kupa hin pag-antos nga iginhatag ha akon han akon Amay?”

en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple. Now that disciple was known unto the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
war: Gindakop ngan gingapos hi Jesus han mga sondalo nga upod han ira kapitan, ngan han mga gwardya nga Judiyo.

en: but Peter was standing at the door without. So the other disciple, who was known unto the high priest, went out and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
war: Gindara hiya nira, syahan ngadto kan Anas nga ugangan ni Caifas nga amo an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig.

en: The maid therefore that kept the door saith unto Peter, Art thou also one of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.
war: Hi Caifas an nagsagdon han mga Judiyo nga maoruopay pa nga usa la nga tawo an mamatay para han ngatanan nga katawhan.

en: Now the servants and the officers were standing there , having made a fire of coals; for it was cold; and they were warming themselves: and Peter also was with them, standing and warming himself.
war: Sinmunod kan Jesus hi Simon Pedro ngan hin usa nga tinun-an. Kilala kaupay han Labaw nga Padi adto nga usa nga tinun-an, sanglit binmunyog hiya kan Jesus ngadto ha bungsaran han balay han Labaw nga Padi.

en: The high priest therefore asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his teaching.
war: Nagpabilin hi Pedro ha gawas, ha may portahan. Ginmawas an tinun-an nga kilala han Labaw nga Padi, nakighimangraw han daragita nga nakada han portahan ngan ginpasulod hi Pedro.

en: Jesus answered him, I have spoken openly to the world; I ever taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where all the Jews come together; and in secret spake I nothing.
war: Nagpakiana kan Pedro ini nga daragita nga bantay han portahan, “Diri ka ba usa han mga tinun-an hito nga tawo?”

en: Why askest thou me? ask them that have heard me , what I spake unto them: behold, these know the things which I said.
war: “Diri,” nagbaton hi Pedro.

en: And when he had said this, one of the officers standing by struck Jesus with his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
war: Tungod han kahagkot nagtap-ong an mga surugoon ngan mga gwardya nga nagkatukdaw hira palibot han tap-ong nga nagdadangdang ha ira ngahaw. Tinmig-ob hi Pedro ha ira basi kapasuan hiya.

en: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus an Labaw nga Padi mahitungod han iya mga tinun-an ngan mahitungod han iya pagturon-an.

en: Annas therefore sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Dayuday dayag an akon pagyakan ha ngatanan. Ginbuhat ko an ngatanan nga pagtutdo didto ha mga sinagoga ngan ha Templo, diin napakadto didto an ngatanan nga mga Judiyo. Waray gud ako magyakan hin bisan ano nga diri dayag ha iyo.

en: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore unto him, Art thou also one of his disciples? He denied, and said, I am not.
war: Kay ano nga ako an iyo ginpapakianhan? Asay niyo pakianhi an mga tawo nga nagpakabati ha akon. Pakianhi hira kon ano an akon iginsumat ha ira, sayod hira han akon iginyakan.”

en: One of the servants of the high priest, being a kinsman of him whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
war: Han pagsiring hini ni Jesus, gintampalo hiya hin usa han mga gwardya nga nakadto ngan sidngon, “Kamailob mo hin pagyakan hin sugad ngadto han Labaw nga Padi!”

en: Peter therefore denied again: and straightway the cock crew.
war: Nagbaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Kon may iginyakan ko nga sayop, sumati an ngatanan nga hahani kon ano an akon ginyakan. Kundi kon matadong man an akon ginyakan, kay ano nga gintampalo mo ako?”

en: They lead Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Prætorium: and it was early; and they themselves entered not into the Prætorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the passover.
war: Ngan iginpadara ni Anas hi Jesus nga ginapos pa, ngadto kan Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi.

en: Pilate therefore went out unto them, and saith, What accusation bring ye against this man?
war: Han natindog pa hi Pedro nga nagdadangdang harani han tap-ong, nagpakiana ha iya an iba, “Diri ka ba usa han mga tinun-an hito nga tawo?”

en: They answered and said unto him, If this man were not an evil-doer, we should not have delivered him up unto thee.
war: Naglirong hiya ngan nagsiring, “Diri!”

en: Pilate therefore said unto them, Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law. The Jews said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
war: Sinmagbang hin pagpakiana in usa han mga oripon han Labaw nga Padi, nga urupod han ginpalongan ni Pedro, “Diri ba ikaw an hinkit-an ko nga kaupod niya didto han tanaman?”

en: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying by what manner of death he should die.
war: Ngan nagsiring na liwat hi Pedro, “Diri,” ngan hito ngahaw nga takna tinmugaok in manok.

en: Pilate therefore entered again into the Prætorium, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
war: Han agaaga pa, gindara nira hi Jesus tikang han balay ni Caifas ngadto han palasyo han gobernador. Waray sumulod han palasyo an mga Judiyo kay diri nira karuyag magtalapas han balaod han ira tuluohan hiunong han paglinis, basi makakaon hira han panihapon han Paglabay.

en: Jesus answered, Sayest thou this of thyself, or did others tell it thee concerning me?
war: Sanglit ginmawas na la hi Pilato ngadto ha ira ngan nagpakiana, “Ano in iyo sumbong kontra hini nga tawo?”

en: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
war: Nagbaton hira, “Diri unta namon hiya gindadara nganhi ha imo kon waray pa hiya makagtalapas.”

en: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
war: Nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Dad-a hiya ngan usisaha niyo sumala han iyo kalugaringon nga balaod.”

en: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end have I been born, and to this end am I come into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “Diri itinutugot ha amon hin pagpatay bisan kan kanay.” (

en: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth?
war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginyakan ni Jesus han paghimangraw niya kon ano nga paagi mamamatay hiya.)

en: And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find no crime in him.
war: Sinmulod liwat ha palasyo hi Pilato ngan gintawag hi Jesus. Nagpakiana hiya kan Jesus, “Ikaw ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?”

en: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kalugaringon mo ba ini nga pakiana, o ginsumatan ka ba hin iba mahitungod ha akon?”

en: They cried out therefore again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
war: Nagbaton hi Pilato, “Kay ano, Judiyo ba ako? An imo kalugaringon nga mga tawo ngan an ira mga puno han kapadian an nagtubyan ha imo nganhi ha akon. Ano ba in nabuhat mo?”

en: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
war: Ngan ipinakuha ni Pilato hi Jesus ngan iginpalatob hiya ha ira.

en: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and arrayed him in a purple garment;
war: Naghimo an mga sondalo hin korona tikang hin tunokon nga mga sanga ngan iginsul-ot ha iya ulo. Ginbadoan hiya nira hin panapton nga pula,

en: and they came unto him, and said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they struck him with their hands.
war: gindaop hiya, ngan ginsiring, “Mabuhi an Hadi han mga Judiyo!” Ngan gintampalo hiya nira.

en: And Pilate went out again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him out to you, that ye may know that I find no crime in him.
war: Ginmawas na liwat hi Pilato ngan sidngon an mga tawo, “Tan-awa, dadad-on ko hiya nganhi ha iyo basi niyo hibaroan nga waray ko hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya.”

en: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold, the man!
war: Ngan ginmawas hi Jesus nga nakakasul-ot han tunokon nga korona ngan han panapton nga pula. Nagsiring hi Pilato ngadto han mga tawo, “Kitaa, iini an tawo!”

en: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him , crucify him ! Pilate saith unto them, Take him yourselves, and crucify him: for I find no crime in him.
war: Han pakakita la ha iya han mga puno han kapadian ngan mga gwardya, naggoliat hira, “Igraysang hiya ha kros! Igraysang hiya ha kros!”

en: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by that law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
war: Nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Kuhaa hiya niyo ngan igraysang hiya ha kros. Waray ko hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya.”

en: When Pilate therefore heard this saying, he was the more afraid;
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “May-ada kami balaod nga nagsusumat nga kinahanglan hiya mamatay, kay nagpaka-Anak han Dyos hiya.”

en: and he entered into the Prætorium again, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
war: Labi na nga nahadlok hi Pilato han pakabati niya hini.

en: Pilate therefore saith unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to release thee, and have power to crucify thee?
war: Binmalik hiya pagsulod ngadto han palasyo ngan nagpakiana kan Jesus, “Tikang ka ba diin?”

en: Jesus answered him, Thou wouldest have no power against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath greater sin.
war: Kundi waray magbaton hi Jesus.

en: Upon this Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou release this man, thou art not Cæsar’s friend: every one that maketh himself a king speaketh against Cæsar.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Pilato, “Diri ka ba nabaton ha akon? Tigamni nga may-ada ko gahom hin pagtalwas ha imo ngan hin pagraysang ha imo ha kros.”

en: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment-seat at a place called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “May-ada ka gahom ha akon tungod la nga iginhatag ini han Dyos ha imo; sanglit darudako nga salaan an nagtubyan ha akon ngada ha imo.”

en: Now it was the Preparation of the passover: it was about the sixth hour. And he saith unto the Jews, Behold, your King!
war: Han pakabati hini ni Pilato, nagtalingoha hiya pagbiling hin paagi hin pagbuhi kan Jesus. Kundi naggoliat an mga Judiyo, “Kon buhian mo hiya, diri ka ngay-an sangkay han Emperador! Kaaway han Emperador an bisan hin-o nga napakahadi!”

en: They therefore cried out, Away with him , away with him , crucify him! Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.
war: Han pakabati ni Pilato hini nga mga pulong, iginawas niya hi Jesus, ngan linmingkod ha lingkoran han maghurukom dida han dapit han ginngangaranan “An Plataporma nga bato.” (“Gabata” an ngaran hini ha Hebreo.)

en: Then therefore he delivered him unto them to be crucified.
war: Tikaurudto na adto han bisperas han Paglabay. Nagsiring hi Pilato ngadto han mga Judiyo, “Iini an iyo hadi!”

en: They took Jesus therefore: and he went out, bearing the cross for himself, unto the place called The place of a skull, which is called in Hebrew Golgotha:
war: Naggoliat hira, “Pataya hiya! Pataya hiya! Igraysang hiya ha kros!”
